aescripts-deep-glow-2: Produces a natural, exponentially decaying cinematic glow from highlights; v2 adds image-based glow, per-channel RGB radius, lens-dirt textures, multi-color tinting, and filmic tone mapping.
Bright edges and highlights bloom into a wide, softly decaying halo, and can borrow color and texture from another image for lens dirt and multi-color tinting, avoiding the flatness of stacked blurs.
aescripts-ae-glass: Adds real-time glass refraction, frosted blur, edge light, and spectral dispersion to shapes, text, masks, logos, or pre-comps — no displacement map required.
Content behind the object refracts, magnifies, and softens in real time, with directional edge highlights and rainbow dispersion — for clear liquid glass, frosted UI cards, or glass logos.
aescripts-lockdown: Tracks deforming or planar surfaces in AE with a 2D/3D mesh, builds stabilized comps for painting and texturing, and exports the mesh and tracking data to 3D software via Alembic.
Tattoos, paint, patterns, or composites bend with skin, cloth, and object surfaces; you can also flatten a surface to paint on it, then snap the result back onto the original motion.
aescripts-autofill: Grows fills along layer boundaries and velocity maps without per-frame masks or keyframes; great for logo reveals, handwriting, energy flows, looping gradients, and VJ visuals.

Color or gradients spread organically from a start point along alpha outlines to progressively write or reveal logos and illustrations; can be layered into energy waves, pulses, and looping flows that bridge disconnected elements.
aescripts-shadow-studio-3: Ray-traces directional or point-light shadows from layer alpha, simulating global illumination, ambient occlusion, subsurface scattering, glossy reflections, extrusion, and bevels.

Flat text, icons, or alpha shapes take on thickness with light and shadow — soft long shadows, colored reflections, inner shadows, edge occlusion, and translucent material light; can be pixel or toon styled.
aescripts-thicc-stroke: Free variable-width gradient stroke plugin with mask and shape support, unlimited width control points, 2-4+ color gradients, looping colors, endpoint styles, and full Trim Path.

Paths become tapered multi-color ribbon strokes with colors flowing or looping along the curve; trimming grows width and color together — great for neon trails, data lines, and hand-drawn line animation.
aescripts-composite-brush: Brush directly on the frame to include or exclude colors, building hard, soft, or hair masks; then recolor, grade, suppress spill, or output alpha to key the selection.

A few strokes isolate a person, clothing, or a color range with soft edges and hair detail intact; the selection can be cleanly recolored, faded, or keyed from the background without hand-drawing masks.
aescripts-quick-chromatic-aberration-3: GPU-accelerated per-channel shift, rotation, scale, and blur simulating real lens chromatic aberration; v3 adds 360° hue, opacity, lens distortion, skew, and multi-iteration passes.
Objects and high-contrast edges split into red/green/blue or custom-hue fringes; subtle settings add a real-lens feel to clean CG, while strong settings create distorted, smeared glitch frames.
aescripts-crtx: Simulates CRT beam, phosphor persistence, scan structure, aperture grille, glass surface, and analog instability driven by motion, luminance, and edges, with RF, Composite, S-Video, and RGB signal paths.

The frame looks like a real CRT capture: highlights bloom from phosphor overload, colors bleed along the signal direction leaving trails, and detail is cut by scanlines and aperture grilles; curved glass, RF snow, VHS head-switch noise, sync tearing, and rolling frames are all available.
aescripts-datamosh-2: Directly manipulates I-frames and motion vectors in video compression, scheduling Remove, Hijack, Swap and more on the timeline; includes 60+ algorithms and a grayscale Mosh Map for local glitch intensity.

Pixels from the previous shot stick into the next and get dragged by new motion, melting subjects and backgrounds into flowing blocks, repeated trails, or directional sweeps; another video's motion can be hijacked, breaking, boiling, or sliding only chosen areas.
aescripts-displacer-pro: GPU-accelerated advanced displacement with hue, saturation, luminance, or RGB channel drivers for translation, rotation, and scale, plus texture gamma, softening, easing, iterations, time-based motion blur, and chromatic aberration.

Textures push, twist, and locally magnify or shrink the frame — far beyond simple horizontal/vertical displacement; iterations build smoother fluid warps and smears, and chromatic aberration adds prismatic breaks, liquify, or intense displacement transitions.
aescripts-pastiche2: Rearranges hundreds of arbitrary layers into a collage driven by the source's shape, alpha, or luminance, with position, scale, rotation, and opacity controlling density; automatically morphs between collage outlines as the source changes.

Large numbers of photos, icons, text, or animated layers gather into logos, portraits, and arbitrary silhouettes — individual pieces up close, a complete image from afar; scattered elements can fly into formation or reshuffle between two outlines with seamless loops.
aescripts-volumax-7: Turns a single portrait or landscape photo into a 2.5D scene you can push a camera through, using a depth map; v7 offers Portrait, Landscape, Smart, AI AutoDepth, and Projector workflows, plus optional 3D particles.

A still photo gains foreground/midground/background parallax, letting the camera orbit or push in, with soft volume on faces and landscapes; floating dust, feathers, and particles further deepen the space.
aescripts-mettle-freeform-pro: Sculpts flat layers into dimensional surfaces with mesh warping, 3D displacement, and primitives, driven by noise, images, or video, with a Generator for array copies.

Flat photos rise into mountains, faces, or abstract sculptures and morph smoothly between two faces; lighting and reflections reveal true relief, and footage can be split into rows of primitives or wrapped into 360° landscapes.
aescripts-mettle-shapeshifter-ae: Generates true 3D objects from text, shape layers, and masks inside AE, with shape morphing, linear/spherical displacement, bend-inflate-twist, lights, shadows, reflections, refraction, and object replication.

Flat lettering or logos become lit, reflective, dimensional forms that morph organically between outlines; also works for glass, water, X-ray, fog-drenched objects, and densely replicated abstract 3D backgrounds.
aescripts-plexus-3: Builds points, lines, and real-time triangular faces from modular objects, connecting them by inter-particle distance; sources include geometry, text, paths, and OBJ sequences for complex 3D network animation.

Floating light points auto-connect into lines and translucent triangles as they approach, forming tech networks, neural nodes, data nebulae, or abstract low-poly structures with clear spatial depth as the camera moves through.
aescripts-stardust: Node-based compositing of emitters, particles, Replicas, force fields, models, text, masks, and physics in one 3D space; particles or models can become OpenVDB volumes to render smoke and volumetric light.

Ranges from simple light dots, streams, and shattered text to massive replicated 3D models, colliding crowds, sparks, and abstract structures; volume mode fuses particle clouds into lit, dimensional smoke, fog, and explosion clouds.
aescripts-beauty-box-video: Automatically detects and tracks skin tones to build a mask, then smooths only the skin, softens wrinkles and blemishes, and reduces shine; GPU-accelerated real-time retouching that keeps eyes, lips, and hair sharp.

Faces become more even and clean, with fine lines, marks, and highlights gently reduced while contours and features stay sharp; strength ranges from barely-visible natural retouching to fuller studio makeup without turning the face into plastic.
aescripts-flicker-free-3: Analyzes up to 39 frames of luminance variation to fix time-lapse exposure jumps, high-frame-rate slow motion, LED/power-cycle rolling bands, and old-film flicker while preserving original color and detail as much as possible.
Flickering frames return to a steady exposure, with horizontal brightness bands and periodic pulses smoothed away; unlike time-axis blurring, moving objects and texture stay sharp.
aescripts-bao-boa: Spline deformer that bends any layer precisely along mask paths, with per-segment vertex alignment, rotation, twist, local non-deformation, 3D extrusion, and camera/light response.

Arms, snakes, ribbons, pipes, or full textures bend naturally along curves with texture conforming to each segment; areas like palms can stay undistorted, or the layer extrudes into a lit, dimensional 3D bent object.
aescripts-bao-mask-avenger-2: Per-vertex control of AE mask points and tangents — position, keyframes, easing, expressions, and 3D depth — linkable to nulls or track points; v2 bakes to background for preview caching.

Each control point of one mask moves, offsets in time, or enters 3D space independently, letting outlines track objects precisely or fold in 3D; smart interpolation keeps shape volume stable during deformation.
aescripts-bao-layer-sculptor: Draws one or more masks where you want control, then animates them to bend any layer precisely; the In-betweener auto-fills intermediate shapes, or creates moving morphs between chosen times and reference masks.

The image reshapes like soft skin, pushed, pulled, pinched, and remolded by the specified outlines — only the needed areas deform; tracked masks sculpt live-action faces, bodies, or objects over time without distorting the whole mesh.
aescripts-motion-upscaler: Local AI trained for 3D renders, anime, cartoons, and motion graphics upscales PNG sequences, multiple images, or video by 2x/3x/4x; reads AE projects directly and preserves alpha completely.

Low-res line art, character edges, and graphic detail scale into cleaner, sharper high-resolution versions; transparency edges stay intact — no black fill, blur, or damage — ideal for sprites, cartoons, and alpha-bearing CG sequences.
aescripts-ai-motion-blur: Local AI estimates frame motion and adds adjustable, natural motion blur — for high shutter speeds, overly sharp digital footage, time-lapse, animation, and abstract renders; motion vectors can also be exported.

Fast-moving subjects, objects, and camera edges gain continuous streaks along their true motion instead of frame-by-frame freezing; time-lapses flow better, and CG and motion graphics gain more natural speed and cinematic quality.
aescripts-blace-2: Local AI automatically detects one or more faces in footage and blurs them in real time — works right after applying the effect; v2 adds hardware acceleration and faster, more accurate detection at large frame sizes.

The blur stays glued to faces as people move, turn, or leave the frame, forming stable privacy masks; suitable for news anonymization, street interviews, documentaries, and footage with many faces to censor.
aescripts-motion-tools-pro: A workflow command center with up to four independent custom panels, integrating 30+ scripts and smart widgets: keyframe copying, easing and palette management, anchor adjustment, sequenced animation, GIF optimization, and an expression library with custom tool authoring; new versions add rigid-body physics and layer distribution.
Doesn't generate a single effect itself, but accelerates offset entrances, custom easing, unified palettes, regular dot grids, and colliding scatter animation in your designs.
aescripts-beatedit-for-after-effects: A professional beat tracker analyzes music and writes markers so 2D/3D properties or time remapping bounce to the beat, repeat keyframes, and stagger layers; select every Nth beat, random beats, or subdivided rhythms.

Text, graphics, camera zooms, and cuts land precisely on drum hits, bouncing, flashing, entering in turn, or replaying in rhythm; choosing different beats creates both downbeat emphasis and intricate rhythm variations from the same song.
aescripts-ease-and-wizz: Applies Robert Penner easing equations via expressions to any animated property, with Bounce, Elastic, Back, Expo, Cubic, and more, plus mixing curves; recalculates live when keyframes move.

Objects show vivid rhythms — landing bounces, rubber-band rebounds, overshoot-and-pull-back, violent acceleration, or gentle deceleration — and position, scale, rotation, and color all share the same motion language.
aescripts-flow: Tune keyframe easing in a normalized visual curve editor, with overshoot/undershoot, applying as expressions, copying CSS cubic-bezier values, and saving, sharing, and managing multiple curve libraries.
Dragging the curve turns linear motion into crisp stops, smooth arrivals, quick launches, or overshoot-and-bounce; saved curves keep motion consistent across a project or team.
aescripts-overlord-2: Sends selected layers directly between Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, and After Effects, creating editable text, shapes, gradients, masks, and styles; preserves Figma frame density and converts components into Essential Graphics pre-comps.

Vector art, text, and layered images from design files appear in AE with original layout, and paths and type stay animatable and editable without splitting files; complex components rasterize cleanly, and Photoshop animation exports as layered frame sequences.
aescripts-rubberhose-3: Builds bendable, stretchable Shape Layer hose limbs quickly from two endpoint controllers, or from drawn paths; v3 adds unlimited bend points, Hose Parenting, Stretchy Bones, style presets, and pre-comp reuse.

Arms, fingers, tails, ropes, or tentacles bend in smooth arcs between two controllers; extra bend points create S-curves and dog-legs. Lines stay clean and rubber-hose-like, or take custom fills, outlines, and joint shapes.
aescripts-squash-stretch-free-pro-v2: A behavior library that quickly adds squash, stretch, bounce, flip, and rotation dynamics to layers or text, auto-adjusting to object size, position, time, and existing keyframes; output is editable keyframes, not live expressions. Free V2 includes 40 behaviors and 135 sounds; Pro V2 expands to 171 behaviors, 349 sounds, plus extra plugin support and manual Squash & Stretch, Oomph, Flip, Rotate controls, transitions, gallery, text splitting, pre-comp trimming, and layer staggering.

Icons, logos, text, and character parts gain weighty squash-and-stretch, bounce in/out, overshoot rebounds, and playful transitions; Pro can distribute multiple behaviors randomly across layers or text characters, words, and lines.
aescripts-explode-shape-layers-3: Splits every group inside a Shape Layer into independently animatable layers, or merges multiple Shape Layers back into new ones; supports nested groups and preserves expressions, keyframe easing, and layer in/out points. Also converts Illustrator or text layers to shapes, removes empty artboards on import, and batch-selects or replaces fills and strokes.
Complex logos, icons, or glyphs separate into components that stagger, diverge, and morph piece by piece, then can be merged again for management; the tool itself doesn't change the visual style.
aescripts-limber-2: Turns vector, raster, AI, pre-comp, path, or Puppet Pin assets into limbs animated in IK, FK, and FreeK modes; supports stretching, Anti-pop, perspective foreshortening, Auto-flop, and three-segment limbs.

Character arms and legs switch between IK's stable foot placement, FK's natural arcs, and FreeK's dimensional front-facing motion; elbows and knees avoid sudden flips, and stretching plus foreshortening makes walks, cross-body moves, and camera-facing actions smoother.
aescripts-buttcapper: One-click batch-set of butt caps (flat, round, or projecting) on selected shape strokes; modifier keys change joins (miter, round, or bevel), and a width-maintaining expression can be applied.
Line ends switch quickly between clean cuts, capsule rounds, and outward extensions; corners become sharp, rounded, or chamfered, and stroke thickness stays consistent when the layer is scaled.
aescripts-comp-replicator-csv-driven-bat: Mass-produces and customizes AE comps from CSV/TSV/TXT spreadsheet data, replacing text and layer footage, searching sources by filename or importing from paths, and duplicating full nested comp structures automatically; hands off to Render Queue or Media Encoder, or copies existing render items — for localization, title versions, and mass-personalized videos.
Produces a series of videos with identical layouts but different names, languages, images, or product content from one template.
aescripts-joysticks-n-sliders: Builds a 2D joystick from five extreme poses (origin + up/down/left/right) with automatic interpolation, or blends any number of poses with sliders; supports shape paths, masks, Puppet Pins, and Switch Template asset swaps.

Dragging a joystick makes a character's head, eyes, brows, and mouth transition continuously between front, side, and up/down angles; multiple sliders stack gestures, expressions, and full-body poses, with lip-sync assets swapping automatically per direction.
aescripts-puppettools-3: Creates customizable controllers for Puppet Pins, Shape Paths, Mask Paths, or layer positions with custom look, size, name, and behavior; selects three consecutive layers to build a simple IK system in one click.

Control points on character meshes, masks, and vector outlines become clear, graspable controllers; moving hand or foot endpoints bends upper arms and forearms, or you can pull faces, clothing, and local shapes directly for puppet deformation.
aescripts-autosway: Creates adjustable sway along Puppet Pins or chained layers; Layer mode supports 2D/3D bending and twisting, with Decay to settle oscillation and Bake/Unbake switching to reduce computation.

Hair, branches, leaves, ropes, and character accessories sway from the fixed end to the tip with delay, as if driven by wind or inertia; chained layers bend and twist in space, and amplitude naturally decays once driving stops.
aescripts-pt-multiplane: Auto- or randomly arranges layered Photoshop/Illustrator artwork into a 3D multiplane along the Z axis, with scale expressions compensating depth so layer distance can be adjusted without changing the original camera view composition.

Overlapping foregrounds, characters, and backgrounds separate into different depths, producing classic documentary-style parallax as the camera pushes or pans; returning to the starting angle keeps original size and registration intact.
aescripts-newton-4: Turns any 2D layer into an object with density, friction, and elasticity, simulating gravity and collisions with seven body and seven joint types; v4 adds Waterlike buoyancy/drag, collision-triggered animation, portals, and loops, with editable keyframes as output.

Text, shapes, and footage fall, stack, bounce, and slide like real objects, or are linked by springs and wheels; they can float as if underwater, start animating only on collision, or pass through screen edges and portals to reappear.
aescripts-bodymovin-lottie: Exports supported Shape, text, mask, matte, gradient, Trim Paths, and some effects from AE comps as Lottie JSON, outputting PNG assets when needed; renders in SVG, Canvas, or HTML on the web via lottie.js, and natively in iOS and Android. Only a subset of AE features is supported, so check compatibility before production.

Clean, scalable vectors, strokes, gradients, path trims, and text animation remain interactive on web and apps, usually lighter than video; unsupported AE features may not export or need to be converted to raster assets.
aescripts-true-comp-duplicator: Duplicates selected comps with their full nested sub-comp hierarchy, creating shared copies for repeated references so new versions all point to the same duplicate; preserves or copies Project Panel folder structure, syncs expressions, and offers multiple copies, recursion depth, footage duplication, naming, and regex-based include/exclude rules.
No new effects appear on screen, but independent client versions, language versions, or design branches are created safely — editing nested content never touches the original comp.
aescripts-bg-renderer-max: Renders in the background using the AE render engine so you can keep editing; supports native multithreading and multiprocessing, independent render queues, remote progress monitoring, and email/automation notifications. Can render frame sequences then auto-encode to MP4 or ProRes, with CPU limits, pause, and custom FFmpeg commands.
Doesn't change the comp's visuals, but moves long renders to the background with clear per-job progress — ideal for batch rendering many versions, frame sequences, and delivery files.
aescripts-nexrender: Automates data-driven or personalized video generation from JSON jobs describing AEP, target comp, assets, and pre/post steps, via aerender on the command line. Open-source modules replace images, video, audio, text, and data, executing download, encode, copy, or upload before/after rendering; a Server/Worker + HTTP API architecture schedules jobs across Windows or macOS nodes. Developer-oriented automation that doesn't launch the AE GUI.

Batch-generates personalized videos with different text, images, and data from the same AE template; the visual result depends on the template — the tool handles unattended replacement, scheduling, rendering, and delivery.
aescripts-connect-layers-pro: Creates keyframe-free dynamic connecting lines between selected layers using Shape Layers and Path Expressions, with one-click Rope, Spanning Tree, or Triangulation; adjusts steps, arcs, Bezier, Penner easing, and dynamic curvature, plus circular/square/triangle/custom arrowheads, solid/gradient, Trim, Dash, Offset, Repeater, Round Corners, Twist, Wiggle, and Zig Zag; also supports AE 3D layers.
Lines stay glued and bend naturally as nodes move — for tech networks, relationship diagrams, triangular connections, arrowed flow lines, and ropes that swing or relax with physics simulation.
aescripts-iexpressions-3: Applies and configures 100+ AE Expressions through a GUI without reading or writing code, for dynamic templates, MOGRT, character rigs, and Shape animation; one-click layer/property linking, delay, baking to keyframes, and importing your own or online Expressions with auto-generated control interfaces — results work in AE or Premiere Pro without this plugin installed.

Quickly builds spring rebounds, wheel rotation, marker-triggered animation, waves and trailing paths, expanding shapes, symmetric graphics, arrows, and advanced color transitions; the actual look depends on the chosen Expression.
aescripts-ouroboros-2: Creates multiple strokes on a single Shape Path, colored by one control or randomized per line in width, opacity, length, offset, and speed. Each line can be trimmed, delayed, or staggered independently, with a master Start/End synced to the original Stroke; adds continuous flow, direction switches, endpoint dots, and unified Cap, Join, and Random Seed; also quickly builds centered lines, squares, circles, and triangles.

One path splits into multi-colored line bundles of varying width, length, and opacity that grow staggered or flow continuously along the outline — for neon trails, data lines, hand-drawn multi-line outlines, and speed lines with end dots.
aescripts-ray-dynamic-color-2: AE swatches dynamically linked to scene color values: color Shape, text, and other Color Properties in one click, updating all linked items when the swatch changes. Pulls palettes from existing scenes, freely Link/Unlink, handles Shape Fill and Stroke separately, swaps two color properties, and assigns swatches randomly or cyclically; imports/exports ASE and integrates with KBar and Overlord.

The same illustration or motion graphics instantly switches between complete brand palettes with all linked fills and strokes staying consistent; swatches can also scatter randomly or cycle, creating orderly multi-color variation.
aescripts-ray-dynamic-texture: Stores textures with layer settings, effects, keyframes, expressions, and layer styles as reusable palettes, then applies to single or multiple selected layers in one click; supports Alpha/Luma Matte, Set Matte, and inverted mattes, and can save commonly used effects, shapes, and expressions from the timeline as master controllers, exact layer copies, or quick texture replacements.
Quickly covers multiple graphics with unified paper, grain, hand-drawn, or animated textures, clipped by outline or luminance; switching one palette item changes the material look in batch.
aescripts-textevo-2: Applies delayed text animation by character, word, or line, with main parameters in a single Pseudo Effect, stackable for more complex variations; supports forward, backward, random, center-out, and outside-in directions, plus a compact panel with horizontal/vertical options and a preset system.
Titles enter staggered by character, word, or line — expanding from the center outward, closing in from the edges, or popping out in random order; stacking effects builds richer kinetic typography.
aescripts-text2spreadsheet: One-click export of text layers in an AE project to a clean spreadsheet with only readable text and no fragile technical data, for clients, proofreaders, translators, or AI to edit and re-apply; tracks renamed/moved layers, auto-finds new text, and manages multiple languages or revisions in added columns; supports UTF-8, multiline text, CSV/Excel XML, folder and layer name filters, duplicate exclusion, and detailed change status after import.

The layout stays unchanged, but typos, client revisions, or multilingual translations across the whole project can be replaced at once, quickly producing consistent text versions in different languages.
aescripts-decomposetext: Splits a single text layer into separate layers by character, word, or line. Either keeps the original exact position with an Expression (each layer still holds the full text but hides unneeded parts), or uses approximate positioning without expressions so each new layer keeps only its actual character, word, or line.

Each character, word, or line of a paragraph becomes individually selectable for scattered, falling, per-item rotation, and differently timed entrance layouts; original typography position is kept as much as possible at split time.
aescripts-captioneer: Creates editable animated caption timelines in After Effects and Premiere Pro by picking MOGRT presets from subtitle sources; supports offline Auto-Captions speech transcription, SRT, all languages, RTL text, and custom cursors/captions. Uses built-in styles or imports your own and marketplace MOGRTs; the AE version builds captions via an Essential Graphics pre-comp, editable from the Properties panel with timing adjusted directly in the Timeline.

Quickly turns speech into segment-by-segment or word-by-word social captions, karaoke highlights, and branded animated titles; the style depends on the chosen MOGRT, keeping the whole video consistent.
aescripts-geolayers-3: Searches and draws countries, cities, roads, buildings, lakes, rivers, landmarks, and administrative areas directly in AE, rendering editable map assets from online data sources. Mapcomp zooms, pans, pitches, and rotates in 3D, with custom map styles, automatic multilingual labels, route animation, 3D buildings, and CSV/TSV import for data-driven Shape Styles; pairs with Helium, FreeForm Pro, Plexus, or Trapcode Mir to build 3D landscapes from real elevation.

News maps zooming from global to street level, travel routes, highlighted regions, data-heat palettes, dimensional buildings, and mountain terrain — with all labels and vector features still animatable and designable in AE.
aescripts-grid-builder: Arranges text, shapes, vectors, footage, or pre-comps in the timeline into animatable rectangular, radial, path, or spherical grids, controlled by a Pseudo Effect on a single null. Drag-and-drop reorders items in the Extension without changing layer stacking; Face Screen keeps elements facing the camera, Path Mode orients along path tangents, and Spherical Grid smartly chooses shortest paths between targets with a single slider.
Assets form flat matrices, ring menus, cards along curves, or spherical media walls around the camera; cards stay facing the viewer and smoothly focus selected items as the whole grid rotates.
aescripts-pins-boxes: Builds modular layouts that auto-update with text or element size using Pins and Boxes. Pins are Shape Layers attached to a parent layer's bounding box edges, moving as it resizes; other objects parented to a Pin keep relative positions. Boxes wrap a set of Pins with a Shape, Solid, or Pre-comp, auto-scaling and positioning as they move, nestable for complex hierarchies. Bounds, Scale, Anchor, and Offset are percentage-controlled; supports MOGRT, plugin-free playback, and scripting API.

When text grows, wraps, or changes in Premiere, background frames, dividers, icons, and neighboring info auto-expand while keeping spacing — for responsive lower thirds, caption cards, info cards, and UI panels.
aescripts-kbar3: Build custom AE toolbars for your workflow; buttons can run Effects, Animation Presets, Menu Commands, Extensions, Expressions, Scripts, Scriptlets, or Shell Commands. Open up to four toolbars and use keyboard modifiers for alternate actions; supports drag sorting, horizontal/vertical layout, text and emoji, 600+ built-in icons, custom PNG/SVG, and batch import/export/sharing.
Doesn't change the image itself; turns frequently used effects, scripts, and commands into recognizable one-click buttons, with toolbars switched per task like animation, rigging, or export.
aescripts-gifgun-2: One-click or batch output of multiple comps from AE to GIF, WEBP, WEBM, or MP4, optimizing short loop animations with palettes, dithering, frames, and quality; auto-adjusts frame rate, size, and quality to approach a target file size. Saves platform or client settings as shareable JSON presets, supports alpha/matte; the same license includes a standalone desktop app and offline browser app for drag-and-drop video.
Turns AE animation into small looping motion for websites, email, slides, and social, with transparency preserved, or space-saving WEBP/WEBM output.
aescripts-zorro-the-layer-tagger: Adds reusable text tags to AE layers, selecting or isolating groups by tag like photo management; one layer can carry different classifications per purpose without relying on timeline adjacency or parenting. Also supports Layer Color Labels for quickly finding character parts, effect layers, text, or items to fix across multi-comp, heavy-layer projects.
No visual effect; it lets related layers scattered across large comps be selected or soloed instantly, reducing repeated searching and manual marquee selection.
aescripts-move-anchor-point-4: Moves the Anchor Point precisely to corners, centers, or any preset position via a customizable grid without shifting the layer's on-screen position. The modular interface keeps only needed controls, saves custom Moves and Z-Space presets; Search Matching batches anchor moves for different layer types by name conditions.
The frame stays in place, but the pivot for rotation and scale moves to the object's center, edge, or corner — for hinge, swing, pop-out, and direction-specific reveal animation.
aescripts-rift: Moves, sorts, staggers, or randomizes time properties — In/Out Points, Source Start, Markers, Keyframes — across multiple layers in a compact panel; affects only frames before/after the playhead or a range, with relative or absolute values. Sequence arranges within a total time using Linear, Ease In, Ease Out, or Ease Both, with Expo for nonlinear intensity, plus fixed Offset Stagger or ranged Randomize; input fields recognize seconds, frames, minutes, hours, and milliseconds.
Multiple layers or keyframes form tidy relays, gradual acceleration/deceleration, fixed-spacing staggers, or random time spread without dragging each layer manually.
aescripts-auto-crop-3: Crops a comp to the visible content bounds with pixel precision based on all layers' alpha channels; analyzes only the current frame or the full time range to find the smallest size that never cuts animation. The native plugin crops the current comp or batch-processes Project Panel selections, optionally expanding bounds first to include off-screen layers; cropping pre-comps referenced by multiple comps auto-corrects all instance positions.
Removes excess transparent area around the comp and hugs actual pixels, so animation is never truncated across the full timeline; visual content and positions essentially stay unchanged.
aescripts-gpudog-pro: Real-time GPU effect pack (WebGPU/Metal): glitch, distortion, color grading, generators, pixelation, fractals, and many other high-speed effects; Pro includes a live WGSL shader editor for custom effects.
aescripts-foldspace: Creates, edits, and animates GPU-accelerated 3D curved surfaces in AE; each surface is defined by 16 freely placed 3D control points, and one effect builds unlimited overlapping or intersecting independent surfaces. Front, Back, and thickness sides each use any AE layer as texture, with Diffuse, Specular, Shininess, and Opacity; surfaces or control points can attach to AE layers to inherit animation, with native Camera/Light support. Roll Modifier quickly rolls surfaces into tubes or spirals via Angle, Tilt, and Radius.
Flat images bend into book pages, flags, arches, scrolls, tubes, and spirals; multiple surfaces assemble into lit dimensional objects, with different materials on front, back, and sides.
aescripts-physicdesk-2: Creates, plays, and records 2D physics scenes live in an AE panel, with Dynamic, Static, Motor, Elastic, Soft Body, Keyframed/PhysLink object modes and Pivot, Weld, Spring, Piston, Wheel, Rope/Chain joints; adds particles, portals, magnets, repulsion, explosions, shattering, and audio-band driving. v2 adds Liquid Simulation with splashes, foam, white water, and drain areas; collision Squash & Stretch; Goal Solver for target-hitting trajectories; and Path Spring for elastic following along hand-drawn paths. Results export as AE native keyframes, Expressions, or editable Shape Layers.

Handles rigid-body collision stacks, mechanical linkages, swinging ropes and chains, jelly soft bodies, cartoon impact deformation, exploding objects, music-reactive particles, and fluid scenes from thick cartoon liquid to fine splashes and foam.
aescripts-super-morphings: One-click object-to-object morphing without manual Shape Path mapping; multiple objects morph into each other sequentially or simultaneously, with Trails or Slicer modules and centralized result control. Hold Ctrl/Command for Linear Morphing with fixed linear interpolation.

Icons, logos, or abstract shapes smoothly re-form into the next target, optionally pulling out ghost-like morph trails or splitting into pieces before reassembling — for scene transitions and info graphics.
aescripts-alphaforge: Procedurally creates animated Track Mattes, full-color Graphic Elements, or transitions between two clips in a comp without manual keyframing per Shape; 200 presets cover Grid, Wave, Scatter, Wipe, Radial, and more. Dynamic mode randomly recombines Count, Timing, and Motion with a locked seed; Signature mode saves finely tuned designs. 20+ parameters span Duration, Stagger, Easing, Transform, Effects, Echo, Color, and 3D Camera, with non-destructive rebuilds — output stays native editable AE layers.

Frames are quickly revealed and wiped by regular grids, waves, scattered geometry, radial shapes, or echo-trailed elements; one brand palette generates many consistent but non-repeating transition variants.
aescripts-pigment: Generates, refines, and previews harmonious palettes from any color with eight Harmony algorithms, plus 30 built-in palettes, favorites history, and a smart eyedropper that captures comp colors; colors Shape Fill/Stroke separately or adds Fill Effects, and Project Sync links project-wide assets to the palette with auto-updates. Imports/exports .pigment, simulates color-blind vision, and supports keyframes; Pigment Ramp applies the current palette as a customizable 9-color linear/radial gradient.
Quickly builds consistent brand palettes, swaps the whole project's colors live, previews what color-deficient viewers see, or turns multi-color swatches into smooth linear and radial gradients.
aescripts-gradienthub: Browses 600+ built-in gradients as visual thumbnails, applying them to Colorama, Shape Layer Gradient Fill/Stroke, Gradient Overlay/Inner Glow/Outer Glow, and proGradient or Color Shift; the Studio mixes, edits, creates, or loops gradients. Custom presets sort into two-level subfolders with auto-generated thumbnails; reads Photoshop .GRD, CSS linear-gradient, and SVG Linear/Radial Gradients directly, preserving brand definitions without re-entering color stops.
Quickly swaps vector fills, strokes, glows, and color mappings to sunset, neon, brand, or looping animated gradients, comparing visual results directly from large thumbnails.
aescripts-motionspice-2: A motion-asset browser panel docked in AE with 120 built-in AEP/FFX effects across 14 categories, searchable in Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean, with hover previews and one-click application at the playhead. Auto Color unifies palettes via Tint or Hue Shift, Snap Drop aligns to markers or layer in-points; Capture saves your own comps, layers, effect presets, and expressions as searchable cards, and a Media Library manages audio, images, video, and frame sequences.

Quickly adds ready-made motion graphics — flashes, glitches, lines, transitions, light rays, and text animation — while your own animations and media live in the same thumbnail-previewing asset system.
aescripts-reach-pro: A smart search bar that finds, runs, and favorites AE Commands, Effects, Presets, Scripts, Expressions, and built-in features, plus a named/savable Expression Editor with JavaScript formatting and a Color Palettes Manager. The panel also integrates Shape/Stroke tools, Pathfinder, Bones Rigging, 2D/3D Align, Camera Rig, Project Cleanup, and a GIF Maker, with an optional AI Assistant that reads comp context and previews before applying.
No fixed style of its own; one panel quickly handles shape paths, bone animation, camera rigs, color palettes, alignment, and project cleanup.
aescripts-ae-actions: Records Timeline edits, Transform, Properties, Keyframes, Effects, Timing, Layer Order, Comp Settings, and Project Actions into Action Sets whose steps can be inspected, reordered, disabled, and edited. Replays on the current comp, selected layers, specified comps, or all comps, with Absolute/Relative/Proportional values, keyframe offset modes, Track Matte replay, database search, and .aeact/.aeactlib sharing. The AI Beta turns natural-language requests into editable, verify-then-apply Action Sets.
No fixed look; ideal for consistently replaying a complex set of layer settings, effects, keyframes, and timing adjustments across many layers or comps.
aescripts-folder-fanatic: Creates, manages, and reuses custom AE Project Panel folder structures, filing assets into place with one click via Rulesets; existing project hierarchies can be imported as reusable structures. Sets Label Colors and protects core folders that must not move — for applying personal or team organization conventions to new projects repeatedly.
Doesn't change visuals; organizes cluttered comps, footage, and project items into a consistent, color-coded, easy-to-browse project folder tree.
aescripts-rendersmith: Centers Proxy, PreRender, and Final Render in one panel: Easy Proxy/PreRender batch-renders in the background and auto-links back, Ghost Mode temporarily hides heavy layers to speed preview, Final Render follows existing Output Modules with live progress and auto versioning (_vXX) to prevent overwrites. Quality Guard scans the workspace for known incompatible plugins and falls back to AE's internal renderer; Safe Mode retries after aerender crashes, and Auto Backup creates one-click-restorable AEP snapshots before structural changes.
Doesn't change the artwork style; it makes proxies, partial pre-bakes, and final output faster and more traceable in heavy projects, reducing bad frames, overwrites, and crash damage.
aescripts-markr: One-click animated Underline, Highlight, Scribble, Strike, or Half-box emphasis elements for text; once created, they keep following the Source Text's content, size, and position changes, so you never re-adjust decoration after editing words.
Dynamic underlines, hand-drawn scribbles, or highlighter blocks draw under text, with strikethrough and half-box options — for titles, emphasis, and social captions.
aescripts-plumebus: Solves and renders 3D volumetric smoke and fire directly in the AE timeline with GPU real-time performance; Emission, Forces, Simulation, Rendering, and Lighting parameters are keyframable and recompute in place when scrubbing — no baking or external round-trips. Supports multiple emitters, 3D layers as colliders, native AE lights/camera, volumetric light scattering, and motion blur; emits from tracked nulls, text, shapes, or animated 3D layers, and syncs bidirectionally from a separate Real-Time Editor.

From thin gun smoke and cigarette wisps to dense explosion fireballs, fog, tire burn smoke, volume smoke that flows around objects, and smoke transitions or trails rising from text or logos and lit by lights.
aescripts-glaze: Generates refractive glass with real edge thickness from any layer's own alpha in one click — no 3D or track mattes; set a Background Layer and adjust Thickness, Refraction, Chromatic Aberration, Frosted Roughness, Glass Blur, and Reflection live. Five modes — Solid, Liquid, Chaos, Crystal, Real Glass — cover smooth, droplets, vortices, gem facets, and thick-edge optics; the built-in Studio HDRI loads your own environments, and lowering refraction while raising reflection makes Chrome/Metal.
Text, shapes, logos, or UI panels become thick transparent glass, soft liquid lenses, frosted glass, abstract vortices, or multi-faceted crystal, with highlights from mirror-chrome to satin metal.
aescripts-etchx: Converts AE/Premiere Pro footage into six illustration systems — Engraving, Cross-Hatch, Charcoal, Dry Ink, Scratchboard, and Technical Pen — with eight presets each (48 total). Unlike frame-by-frame re-inking sketch effects, lines follow characters, fabric creases, and camera motion to reduce flicker; adjust Density, Scale, Flow, Detail, Contours, Paper, Color, and motion adhesion, and separate primary strokes, secondary hatching, outlines, fills, and paper for later compositing.

Footage becomes stable, motion-following copperplate engraving, dense cross-hatching, loose charcoal, broken dry ink, high-contrast black scratchboard, or precise technical pen linework — not per-frame jumping filter lines.
aescripts-xdog-studio: Uses Extended Difference of Gaussians (DoG) edge processing to turn footage, stills, pre-comps, and motion graphics into finely controllable illustrated line art. Adjust Line Detail, Edge Width, Threshold Response, Posterization, Flow-guided Smoothing, Color, Saturation, Brightness, and Blend; GPU support via CUDA/OpenCL on Windows, with CPU fallback — currently Windows-only.
From clean directional linework, black-and-white comic ink, and manga screen tone, to simplified-color Toon, pencil Sketch, bold outlines, or experimental edge abstraction.
aescripts-risograph: Simulates a real digital duplicator with a multi-pass GPU pipeline, not a single vintage texture overlay. Seven halftone screens — Dots, Lines, Stipples, Blue Noise, Bayer, Voronoi, Diffusion — with independent Ink Plates, Dot Gain, Opacity, Overprint, Coverage, and Ink Pooling; adds Misregistration, Drift, Ghost Impression, Roller Marks, Reticulation, Fading, Specks, and Uneven Transfer. Includes 29 press presets, 11 machine profiles, DPI, and Ink Kits, with procedural paper, original artwork retention, or transparent ink layer output.

The frame looks like real risograph printing: limited color plates, visible halftone dots, and absorbent paper fiber, with misregistration, ink pooling, fading, roller marks, ghosts, and uneven transfer — from clean posters to worn zines.
aescripts-pathsmear: Stretches layer highlights along mask-path directions for non-radial, directional light streaks; one- or two-way, with Threshold, Length, Falloff, Direction, Tint, and Blend Mode. Inner, Outer, and Overall Glow each adjust Radius, Intensity, and Decay, plus direction-field smoothness, samples, dynamic sampling, and Ignore Alpha; GPU real-time with 8/16/32-bit support.

Highlights flow along a hand-drawn mask path in the specified direction, forming curve-following neon light trails, speed streaks, electric energy beams, and focused halos rather than center-out bursts.
aescripts-meltflow-blur: GPU-accelerated melting-style blur centered on a specified Point, with adjustable region position, size, aspect ratio, rotation, and edge falloff; Preserve keeps original colors, Inward reverses the melt direction. Flow selects five turbulence maps with animatable phase and seamless looping; Scatter spreads, Diffusion adds grain noise, and Wind directs the blur.
The image drips, melts, or gets dragged outward from a local center — or sucks inward; turbulence, grain, and wind create liquid bleeding, hot-melt transitions, and directional abstract blur.
aescripts-reflow: With Source and Target specified, a single Transform Slider deterministically dissolves text, logos, or images into particles and reassembles them into another layer, freely scrub-previewable. Particles live in true 3D space, responding to comp camera, depth of field, and one-click null controllers; Scatter, Swirl, and Turbulence shape motion, and Timing staggers by Brightness, Saturation, Color, or Alpha. Particle shapes can be Circle, Line, Arrow, Curved Trail, or any Layer Sprite; multithreaded rendering supports up to 200,000 particles.
The source layer shatters into dots, lines, arrows, or custom images that scatter, rotate, burst, or stream in 3D depth, then precisely reassemble into another text, logo, or image.
aescripts-particleshapes: Turns Shape Layers into particle animation built from AE Standard Elements with 12 presets and no third-party plugins required for delivery. Emitter sets count, birth time, and position; Style controls size, entry/exit, color, opacity, and shape; Behaviour/Forces set speed, direction, rotation, drift, and gravity. Bakes to 3D keyframes to speed up RAM preview, and morphs 3D Position/Rotation into 2D animation — Z Position maps to Scale, 3D Rotation to shape ratio — for import into Lottie Creator.
Particles of circles, polygons, or custom shapes burst, float, fall with gravity, or orbit the main animation — editable MG accents for logos, icons, and info graphics.
aescripts-soft-flow: One-click auto-generated soft-body deformation for any Shape Layer, without manual keyframing or Graph Editor work; responds to Position, Scale, and Rotation animation with Drag, Inertia, Overshoot, Follow Through, and Settling. Separately tune Softness Intensity, Reaction Speed, and Damping, from subtle elasticity to strong jelly wobble; supports Rectangle, Circle, Polygon, Custom Path, Text Outlines, and Imported Vectors, with live preview, presets, and no third-party dependencies.
Logos, titles, icons, UI elements, and character shapes drag softly, overshoot, and settle when moved, scaled, or rotated — from fine elasticity to exaggerated jelly/bubble wobble.
aescripts-amalgam: Bundle: double-exposure effect plus smooth transition plugin, works in AE and Premiere Pro.
Two images blending into each other as a double exposure
aescripts-luma-shifter: Centralizes all luma-matte transitions in one place, switching between clips with a few clicks inside AE — no more searching for footage online.
Wipe transitions following a grayscale pattern
aescripts-corridorkey: Packages Corridor Digital's open-source CorridorKey project as a ready-to-use AI keying plugin for AE, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and Nuke. The new Tiling Mode processes 256x256 tiles only, using less memory for higher effective resolution; Auto Crop skips large transparent areas via mask bounding boxes, and QuickMatte accepts a custom alpha hint to guide the model.
Builds detailed alpha mattes from green-screen people or objects, preserving hair and semi-transparent edges as much as possible for background replacement and compositing.
aescripts-maskmotion: A native C++ AE plugin giving each mask region inside one source layer its own independent transform. Assign masks to regions, then animate Position, Anchor, Scale, Rotation, and Opacity separately — no duplicated source layers, keeping the timeline clean and the original artwork easy to edit in one place.

Multiple mask regions in one illustration, collage, or photo each move, rotate, scale, and fade independently — the frame acts like separate moving parts while the timeline keeps a single source layer.
aescripts-maskpro: A panel for managing AE masks: one-click select, delete, copy, and paste chosen masks, with optional keyframes; freeze/defreeze masks, convert between Shape and Mask, pre-compose from mask or layer bounding boxes, generate mattes, or split multiple selected masks into separate layers for finer control.
No fixed style; it quickly builds and reorganizes mattes, roto regions, and animatable masks, cutting repetitive manual work in complex composites.
aescripts-extrude: Extrudes live, still-editable Text, Shape, and Mask Paths into 3D with 2D Directional, Vanishing, and Full 3D (follows native AE camera) modes; controls front/back extrusion and pivot separately, and transitions smoothly between convex and Inner Extrusion. Shadows use solid or a 32-color radial Gradient Editor; GPU-accelerated with 32bpc, Multi-Frame Rendering, and Apple Silicon support, built-in anti-aliasing, and stable handling of intersecting/overlapping paths, Merge Paths, and Mask Add/Subtract/Difference. Most AE Text Animators and path-aligned text keep working. Limits: shape primitives must convert to Bezier paths first, camera mode lacks depth of field, native motion blur needs CC Force Motion Blur post-process, and some shape effectors like Wiggle Paths or Pucker & Bloat are unsupported.
Editable text, shapes, or masks form dimensional thickness with high-quality gradient shading, flipping smoothly from convex to concave and changing with AE camera perspective.
aescripts-3d-modeler: Extrudes Solids, Shapes, Text, or transparent layers into 3D volumes in AE with one click, and builds cubes, full/truncated pyramids, origami, and other geometry. After generation, select any surface and extrude inward/outward with Depth/Offset, or carve and modify surfaces locally with masks; supports Bevel, Chamfer, Color, and Rotation controls with per-face or grouped textures, plus an animatable Origami Cube and Wired Mode.
Flat text, logos, graphics, or cutout images become dimensional 3D models — textured boxes, carved relief surfaces, pyramids, origami boxes, and wireframe geometry.
aescripts-gridder-2: Inspired by Cinema 4D's Mograph Cloner, arranges selected AE layers into adjustable Rectangular, 3D, or Circular grids, with Circular mode extending into Spirals. Expression Mode creates custom controls for each grid type, linking array parameters to other layers or properties so spacing, count, and arrangement stay procedurally adjustable instead of a one-time static alignment.
Large layer counts form tidy rectangular walls, 3D matrices with Z depth, circular radials, or spirals extending inward/outward — for icon walls, photo matrices, and procedural layout animation.
aescripts-progradient: The successor to freeGradient — a dynamic Gradient/Texture generator. Free Base Modes provide Linear, Radial, Angular plus Offset Animation, Scale Repeat, Loop, Mirror, Invert, and Opacity Ramp; Pro Modes add Magnet (simulating magnetic field lines), Contour (fills along normal of closed Alpha/Mask/Text borders), Along/Cross gradients along Bezier mask paths, and sampling one horizontal pixel row from any photo, video, or pre-comp. Stripes split into segments with random offsets; OKLAB prevents luminance dips, and HCL controls vivid hue paths.
Smooth looping ribbons, mirrored gradients, magnetic field lines, contour bands hugging text and shape outlines, colors flowing along curves, and organic random stripe textures sampled from footage.
aescripts-instantrecipe: Captures a layer's full treatment as a single plain JSON Recipe — ordered built-in/third-party effects, keyframes with Bezier handles, expressions, masks, text styling, layer styles, switches, even camera/light; hidden values like Curves, Gradient Colors, and Text Animators persist via the AE preset mechanism. Applying supports Flat replacement, Add overlay, or Merge updating same-name effects, item by item; Position, Mask Shape, and Style Size scale proportionally for different comp sizes. Panel has GIF hover previews, search, tags, and favorites.

No fixed look; it turns a whole finely tuned visual treatment, animation, and rig into a previewable, searchable, shareable one-click recipe applied consistently across horizontal, square, and vertical versions.
aescripts-easecopy: Copies and pastes keyframe Ease and Value separately: Paste Eases doesn't overwrite target values, Paste Values keeps existing easing. It analyzes the target animation and scales the speed curve by magnitude, auto-flipping on opposite motion direction — not a hard per-value paste; Pass-through Mode matches crossing speed at middle keyframes to avoid velocity bumps on 3+ keyframes. Processes multiple key sets at once, and runs without a panel via KBAR, Command Frame, standalone scripts, or keyboard shortcuts.

Doesn't change the image style; lets animations with different properties and distances share the same hand-tuned acceleration/deceleration rhythm while keeping each one's position, scale, or other values.
aescripts-preflight: Scans nested comps before delivery renders with 45 checks across six categories — text, comp, color, audio, layers, and output — catching typos, unmuted solos, silent tracks, proxies, and draft output that AE never warns about. Results classify as fixable, needs-review, or suggestion; clicks jump to the exact layer and frame, fixes clear live, skipped items save with the project, and target frame rate, resolution, and duration can be set.
No visual style; it prevents delivery files from retaining typos, missing frames, silence, transparency edges, proxy footage, or wrong render settings.
aescripts-stash: Replaces AE's native Project panel with a modern visual panel: comps, video, images, and vectors show thumbnails directly, with fuzzy search filtered live by natural keywords like unused, missing, and portrait. Save searches as auto-updating smart folders, view only assets used by the active comp and nested pre-comps, keep layouts in separate tabs; missing-file alerts with relinking, usage counts, drag-and-drop, previews, and an adjustable zoomable grid view.
Doesn't change the final look; large AE projects become asset browsers where thumbnails, search, tabs, and smart filters quickly locate sources.
aescripts-shortcut-studio: Consolidates frequently used AE expressions, scripts, and presets into one searchable, sortable, filterable library — no more digging through folders; each shortcut gets a custom name, icon, color, description, and search tags, applied with a double-click.
No fixed visual style; it organizes your accumulated expressions, scripts, and presets into a quickly searchable and applicable panel.
aescripts-mochaimport-v6: Bridges any mocha version (including the one bundled with AE) to After Effects: one-click stabilized pre-comps for tracked regions, ideal for cleanup, relighting, beauty work, and object insertion, with edits auto-warped back to the original perspective. Tracking data drives expressions, fixing the whole range by editing a single keyframe or adding a few; moves masks, layers, and effect control points by position, scale, rotation, shear, and perspective, plus advanced stabilization smoothing, multiple corner-pin conversions, and curved Bezier warps.
Stickers, mattes, light effects, and cleanup content stay locked to mocha's planar perspective; shaky shots can be stabilized or smoothed, then worked on like a still image in the stabilized view.
aescripts-markers-command-center: Automated marker management panel with AI assistance; supports clip-level markers since v1.5.
aescripts-voxmark: Computes the comp's full audio mix first, then sends it to OpenAI Whisper, Groq Whisper, or AssemblyAI for transcription, turning narration into frame-accurate comp markers at word or sentence granularity. Auto-detects or specifies language, splits long sentences by character count, identifies speakers with color coding; converts bidirectionally between SRT and markers, stages and restores markers for unlimited comps, and jumps to subtitles from a navigator page.
Doesn't change the visual style; narration becomes timeline-aligned text markers or SRT subtitles — great for voiceover captions, interview organization, and locating clips by dialogue.
aescripts-jack: Native audio processing in one dockable panel for AE and Premiere: Denoise clears background noise live while keeping natural voices, EQ Curve shapes frequencies, Compressor controls attack, release, knee, and makeup gain, Reverb adds space, Voice Filter makes phone, 8-bit, walkie-talkie, or chipmunk voices in one click, and Duck auto-lowers music while talking; the new Dereverb removes room echo, and settings save as custom presets shared across both apps.
From clean, clear interview voices to EQ'd and compressed mixes, spatial reverb, or character voices like phone and walkie-talkie.
aescripts-lottiepacker: Lottie production and delivery tool: the built-in Bodymovin engine batch-renders multiple comps directly to JSON without a separate export extension. Smart validation flags AE properties unsupported by target players in real time, checking separately against Lottie Android, iOS, Windows, or Web; also batch-extracts comps into clean standalone AEPs with shape cleanup, timeline trimming, and comp isolation to tidy sources before output.
Adds no visual effects; it ensures the same Lottie animation reproduces correctly on the target app or web player and organizes delivery sources into independent projects.
aescripts-gpudog-deep: Builds GPU effects with nodes in the browser-based Den studio, previewing live with your own footage via WebGPU, then syncing saved results to AE over a local connection — every custom parameter becomes a truly keyframable Effect Controls entry. No-code chaining of noise, distortion, sampling, color, and loop nodes, with one-click WGSL conversion for further coding, or GLSL, Shadertoy, and ISF import; samples other layers and video, remixes community graphs, and collaborates with MCP AI agents on shaders, with AE rendering and footage preview staying local.
Design your own GPU visuals — flow-field warps, spectrum trails, pixel sorting, procedural noise, color mapping, custom lenses, and glitch looks.
aescripts-sandbox: Puts HTML5, Three.js, GSAP, Pixi.js, and p5.js animation engines inside an AE/Premiere panel, combining Gemini, OpenAI, or Claude to generate and edit code-driven animation in natural language — 3D models, physics simulation, kinetic type, and data visualization. Imports JSON, CSV, and TXT for AI-parsed chart animation; live interactions record as PNG sequences, Canvas mouse trails send back to AE as null keyframes, and a character-binding mode tags SVG parts semantically.
Web-technology-driven 2D/3D procedural animation, particle and physics interactions, kinetic typography, data charts, and interactive visuals that respond to mouse input.
aescripts-ae-gpt: Lets AI do more than answer: it reads the active comp's layers, effects, properties, and expression context, then in Agent Mode plans, writes, and runs multi-step ExtendScript to build scenes, add effects, animate, or fix errors from natural language; Chat Mode offers tutorials, debugging, and ready-to-use code. Switch between OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini, and auto-detect Ollama local models like Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, and Qwen for offline execution with data never leaving the computer; some cloud providers also log in with existing subscriptions.
Not tied to one visual style; it creates and modifies editable AE layers, animations, effects, and expressions directly from text requests.
aescripts-motionamigo: Launches Claude Code or Codex inside an AE CEP panel, using a remote MCP server for 300+ tools covering comps, layers, shapes, keyframes, masks, and expressions, letting the agent write to the timeline from natural language. Predefine named styles — font family, weight, size, tracking — for the AI to follow; generated comps, text, shapes, masks, and expressions stay natively editable. Uses existing Claude or ChatGPT subscriptions (no per-token billing), but the cloud MCP executes tool calls, so a continuous connection is required.
No fixed finished style; turns text requests into still-hand-tunable AE scenes, graphics, typography, keyframe animation, and expressions.
aescripts-fusion2ae-3d-bridge: Transfers 3D scene data from DaVinci Resolve/Fusion to AE: the Fusion side exports a .f2ae intermediary file that the AE panel reads to rebuild the scene automatically.
aescripts-aec4d-pro: Imports all or selected objects from Cinema 4D into a new or current AE comp, rebuilding Shape Layers, nulls, cameras, and lights; afterwards, selecting just the changed C4D objects overwrites the corresponding AE layers — no full-scene re-import. Resolves tokens and relative paths from Render Settings, imports materials, stills, and multi-pass renders, and supports text layers, stage objects, camera film offset, workspace/current time, and comp markers.
No fixed style; keeps C4D scene layouts, camera animation, lights, text, and multi-channel renders registered and continuously updatable in AE.
aescripts-stmapper: Brings the industry-standard ST Map workflow natively into AE: reads ST maps from SynthEyes, 3DEqualizer, and other tools to undistort or re-distort footage; also reads 32-bit float UV passes from Cinema 4D, Blender, and other 3D renders to re-texture models without re-tracking or re-solving geometry. Creates blank ST maps at any resolution, stacking Transform and Warp into a single reusable coordinate map that bakes complex deformation stacks.
Re-samples the frame precisely by the XY/UV coordinates recorded in red/green channels — reproducing lens distortion, mapping new artwork onto 3D surfaces, or applying baked compound warps.
aescripts-hardcorrupt: Slices layers into blocks, horizontal bars, or vertical columns, then applies pixel shifts, region swaps, jitter, and pixelation, filling damaged areas with solid, cross, diamond, checkerboard, dot, outline, or scatter patterns. Luma Gating attacks only highlights or shadows with softened boundaries, RGB Split shifts the three channels separately, luminance and color noise add dirty signal; Temporal Freeze simulates encoder macroblock freezing, and Auto Seed varies frame-by-frame without keyframes. Output switches between normal, matte preview, or transparency-only damaged pixels; currently Windows-only.
Large-block digital compression breakdown, misplaced pixel regions, and frozen macroblocks, with red/green/blue channel tearing, color noise, and hard glitch erupting only in highlights or shadows.
aescripts-instalut: Captures the active comp at the playhead directly to generate live visual thumbnails for your entire LUT collection; syncs dynamically when switching comps or scrubbing — no opening the Lumetri menu to sample each look. Organizes by tags, parent folders, favorites, name, or text search, and compares two LUTs with a slider split-screen; one click applies the native Apply Color LUT, the grade survives path changes or panel removal, and an auto adjustment layer is optional when no layer is selected.
Browses different cinematic grades, film simulations, and stylized LUTs side by side on the same actual shot, with split-screen to inspect the color difference between two looks.
aescripts-voxel-buddy-pro: Raymarches true 3D voxel volumes directly in comp space with GPU — no waiting on fluid simulations; supports AE 3D cameras, lights, and the new primitive layers, with image, video, or comp content driving voxels. Adjust density, falloff, color, solid/gas mix, and shadows, then deform with keyframable 3D Noise, Wave, Twist, Taper, Pinch/Inflate, Offset, and Wipe; raise Step Count for smooth sampling or use Overscan for out-of-bounds distortions.
From blocky sculptures, pixelated dimensional objects, and procedural fragmentation to lit volumetric clouds, flowing noise, twisted voxels, and dimensional dissolve transitions.
aescripts-voxel-sorter: Explodes source pixels into a 3D block field you can tilt, move the camera through, and light: luminance decides depth, color becomes geometry, and flat video instantly gains weight and shadows. Then shifts voxel color and structure along 3D sort axes, pulling half-pixel-sorted, half-sculptural geometry trails from top-to-bottom or front-to-back; the Blend parameter eases in/out, and Pro adds in-plugin AI depth plus motion blur.
Somewhere between a Minecraft block model, blueprint wireframe grid, and damaged JPEG; the image is carved into a miniature voxel world, then pulls colored geometry ribbons along 3D axes.
aescripts-cloudlight: Turns AE Lights directly into cloud generators: light position controls cloud position, multiple lights create multiple randomized clouds, each reflecting its light's color. Fine Shape and Shading controls adjust texture feel, choose different Billow puff styles, set blend modes for overlapping cloud layers, and deform freely; simple animation parameters build animatable skies and atmosphere layers without leaving AE.
Fluffy dimensional clouds shaped by one or more colored lights — soft white clouds, heavy shadowed layers, colorful fantasy clouds, and slowly drifting sky mist.
aescripts-ko-bandfill: A native procedural banded-pattern plugin: 20 geometries share one control set for backgrounds, transitions, gradients, and graphics, with variation and distortion parameters for endless possibilities.
aescripts-convex-hull: Convex Hull in AE: uses an adjustment layer or selected layers to auto-generate the minimal convex polygon wrapping them.
A polygon outline enclosing all elements
aescripts-centerline: Extracts true center skeletons from hand-drawn scans, logos, architectural line art, or calligraphy bitmaps — not the double-sided outlines of typical Auto Trace. Zhang-Suen thinning strips to single-pixel ridges, Schneider's algorithm fits low-node cubic Béziers, then Ramer-Douglas-Peucker removes redundant anchors; bridges pixel gaps, restores dynamic stroke width from the original distance field, and adjusts thickness locally with up to eight control points. Results export as native Shape Layers or SVG paths for smooth Trim Paths write-on.

Heavy pencil drawings, double-line logos, blueprints, or calligraphy become clean single lines running along the exact center of strokes, preserving natural width and writing on smoothly stroke by stroke.
aescripts-fontobj: Type text and pick a font in the AE panel, set Size, Extrude, Tracking, and Export Scale, and get a clean real OBJ mesh via OpenType parsing; unlike AE text or 2D shapes, the geometry gives more predictable 3D lighting and material results — especially for the Substance workflow in AE 2026. Optionally exports each letter as a separate OBJ for advanced per-character animation, and auto-imports back into the project or current comp.
Dimensional text with real mesh, thickness, and sides that accepts 3D lighting and Substance materials; per-letter export lets each character rotate, scatter, or animate independently.
aescripts-depthion: GPU-accelerated AE plugin that creates fake thickness by duplicating and stacking layers; a control null uniformly adjusts slice count, Tilt extrusion direction, Spin rotation extrusion, and Back Scale. Advanced controls include bevel, per-instance opacity, and side brightness, quickly producing many dimensional looks from flat text or graphics.
Flat layers stack along depth into dimensional thickness with shaded sides — rotating, tilting, tapering the back, and beveling as you like.
aescripts-stack3d: Turns flat logos and artwork into AE Advanced 3D Shapes: AI, EPS, SVG, and PDF convert directly to shapes; PNG, JPG, and PSD call Auto-Trace. Splits by fill or per Shape Group, then batch-sets extrusion depth, bevel, Ambient, Diffuse, Specular, Shininess, and Metal, with separate coloring for Front, Bevel, Side, and Back. Builds a precisely centered null rig from the union bounds of all layers with Z Anchor at the thickness midpoint; Clean Palette simplifies redundant vertices and smooths jaggies. Stack Sequence runs the full pipeline — convert, split, dimensionalize, rig, and environment light — in chosen steps.
Logos, motion cards, broadcast titles, and vector illustrations become dimensional artwork with real thickness, bevels, per-face materials, and a centralized pivot.
aescripts-maskpin: A native perspective-pinning effect that starts from mask regions instead of dragging whole-layer or comp corners: pick a target mask on a multi-mask layer and four pins snap in place, or use actual four-point mask vertices dragged directly in the Comp viewer. Includes mask outlines, original vertices, corner pins, and connector frames in the output, each with adjustable color, width, opacity, interaction/export size, and square, circle, triangle, plus, or X shapes; for screens, phones, posters, signage, and HUD mockups — no planar tracking, CEP, or pre-comps needed.

Content precisely conforms to the angled perspective plane defined by a local mask; optionally outputs technical breakdowns or interface HUD frames with mask outlines, vertices, and four-corner control frames.
aescripts-chatty: Dynamic chat conversations inside AE: text, emoji, media, audio, avatars, and customizable styles for social short-form video dialogue performances.
Chat message bubbles popping up one after another
aescripts-repin: Uses any 2D/3D solid's four corners as a planar coordinate system, or reads an existing Corner Pin on the solid, to immediately un-perspective and stabilize tracked angled footage into a new working comp; retouch, overlay UI, or add elements on that plane, then seamlessly RePin back into the main comp. A live visual calibration grid uses squares and circles to tune solid resolution, fixing Corner Pin aspect ratio without knowing screen dimensions beforehand; consistent sizing persists across shots of the same device, results carry no cross-comp expression dependencies, and delivery does not require RePin installed.
Flattens angled or perspective phones, screens, and signage into a front-facing stable frame for design work, then precisely pins back to the shot's original motion and perspective.
aescripts-kineto: Describe a pendulum, bouncing logo, loading indicator, character gesture, or info diagram in one natural-language sentence; Kineto generates an animated SVG, previews it in the panel, then imports it as native Shape Groups with correct anchors and layers. Position, Scale, Rotation, and Opacity are real keyframes — reshape, retime, and recolor freely, not flattened video. Choose Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Grok, or connect OpenAI-compatible local endpoints like Ollama or LM Studio; an optional Visual Critique Loop renders the result for a vision model to inspect and improve before it enters the comp.
Generates clean vector animated icons, looping loaders, logo/text reveals, small character motions, and explainer animation from prompts — every element still editable layer by layer.
aescripts-voicelab: Type a script, pick a voice, and drop narration directly onto the timeline or Project Bin from the AE/Premiere panel; the free Kokoro model runs fully offline locally — no account, API key, or subscription, text and audio never leave the computer, and output is commercially usable without attribution. Bring your own ElevenLabs key for premium voices, swap an existing edited audio clip's voice in place, or generate SFX from text descriptions. Supports nine languages/accents: US/UK English, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian, and Brazilian Portuguese.
Get draft narration, polished AI voiceovers, multilingual localized voices, character re-voicing of existing lines, and environment/action sound effects generated from text.
aescripts-justscrollit: Creates customizable film-end credit rolls inside After Effects; Smart Import auto-formats plain-text name lists into the industry-standard two-column credit layout, or start from blank or a template. Output generates a new freely editable comp, with re-layouting, other name-list formats, image inclusion, exporting the list for editing outside AE, and reduced scrolling flicker.
A movie-credits list scrolling smoothly upward with roles and names neatly aligned in columns.
aescripts-curveconductor: Procedurally drives the timing rhythm of multiple properties from one editable control curve; editing the curve syncs all referencing properties live — no per-property Bezier handle comparison. Marker Mode specifies curve application ranges with layer markers and uses multiple curves on one property; Velocity Matching eases smoothly into/out of native AE keyframes, or edit only specified keyframe segments, drive full multi-keyframe motion paths, or blend curves for smooth-plus-crisp dynamics.
Multiple layers or properties share one rhythm curve, updating in sync from a single edit — unified easing.
aescripts-retrobounce: One-click classic DVD screensaver wall-bouncing or solitaire-card gravity cascades applied to objects. Driven by AE expressions and Effect Controls sliders, with speed, gravity, and color adjustable anytime; Bounce mode loops seamlessly from the first frame and rotates the palette at each wall hit, Gravity mode offers elastic physics across multiple layers simultaneously, plus adjustable echo trails and a sync outline mode.
Objects bounce between frame edges like the DVD logo, changing color at each hit, or fall in batches and rebound elastically with echo trails.
aescripts-lapath: Creates always-adjustable round-corner sliders for specific vertices on Shape or Mask paths. Arc recognition decides whether existing curves get radius adjustments or sharp corners split into points, extending consistent vertex handling across multiple animated keyframes to preserve path topology; live sliders give interactive previews, one-click restore brings back the original path, all keyframes, and speed graphs via preserved metadata, and multiple paths on one layer can be set up with organized controllers at once.
Individual sharp corners of shapes or masks are precisely rounded into smooth arcs — animatable and fully restorable.
aescripts-rectcontrol: Deformable rectangle control for UI/SaaS animation: animate width, height, alignment, corner rounding, and concave/convex curvature separately, and generate Apple-style squircles. A nine-point grid one-click creates parent or child nulls following nine rectangle regions, pinning inner/outer elements and gradient fill/stroke endpoints dynamically; works with text, images, solids, pre-comps, and general shapes, and moves anchors without moving the layer. One-click converts Overlord-imported Figma rectangles preserving fills, strokes, and corner radii, and controls keep working for collaborators without the extension.
Rounded-corner UI panels whose size, alignment, corner curvature, and surrounding elements all respond to deformation together.
aescripts-lightson: Quickly adds lights and lens flares built from Shape Layers, built-in AE effects, and expressions — no third-party rendering plugins. The custom UI provides global settings to blend into the scene; effects add as comps, tunable via Essential Properties with keyframes and animation, or open the light comp to freely hide, add, and mix light layers. All expression controls and content stay open and editable, and recipients don't need LightsOn installed for delivery.
Animatable, disassemblable, and mixable lens flares, flare spots, and radial rays blended into the scene.
aescripts-gradientfix-pro: Fixes and rebuilds static and animated gradients in AE: resolves the black-and-white gradients or lost gradient data after Bodymovin/Lottie JSON import, quickly rebuilding smooth gradient animation.
aescripts-fontreplacer: Scans an entire AE project or the current comp to batch-replace one or more fonts, with live preview and single-step undo. Handles per-character mixed fonts, Source Text keyframes, and font names inside expressions, auto-mapping Bold/Light weight counterparts, and swaps only the font family while keeping size, tracking, color, animation, and expressions. Recommends similar fonts by name and visual metrics, fixes misspelled names, searches installed Adobe Fonts, Google Fonts, Fontsource, or Fontshare directly, and packages project fonts into a folder with location and replacement-history CSV output; common source-to-target rules save as cross-project templates.
aescripts-faux-lock: Lets layers be click-through in the Composition panel while remaining normally selectable/editable in the timeline — solving the frustration of adjustment layers, guides, and masks always blocking your clicks.
aescripts-justpaste: Pastes images or vectors from browsers, image viewers, screenshots, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, and other apps directly into the current AE comp, or pastes multiple images, video, audio, PSD, AI files copied from Finder/Explorer. Auto-names and copies assets next to the .aep or to a chosen folder, building Project Panel folders and layers in sync; preserves animated GIFs from the web fully, and in AE 2026 converts SVG or raw SVG code into editable Shape Layers. Options place layers at top/bottom/above-below selection, align time to the playhead or selected layer, and use filename templates with numbering, overwrite, or skip on name conflicts.
aescripts-import-from: Opens the import window directly in the project folder or your custom favorites folders with one click — no digging through paths every time; also opens folders in Explorer directly.
aescripts-alignall: Aligns and distributes 2D and 3D layers in AE (the built-in align panel doesn't support 3D).
aescripts-layerq: Saves each composition's layer visibility as named, reusable Layer Sets; settings are stored in Comp Markers and persist across sessions. Use AE's native Solo for live preview, or hide other content with Set Solo's Shy Mode to focus on editing; nested pre-comps are processed recursively across the whole composition tree. ALL can render every combination at once, SEL only outputs the selected ones — the tool copies the necessary compositions to a temp folder and adds them to the Render Queue automatically; each set can have its own Output Module, Render Settings, file name template and output folder, and it also supports queue-only and accumulating multi-shot batches across compositions.
