aescripts-timepilot-pro: Jumps back and forth between layer In/Out cut points, keyframes and layer/composition markers using context-aware Smart Jump; Hybrid mode evaluates all three at once and goes to the nearest event. The panel's Live Radar shows the playhead, timecode, work area, composition bounds and markers — click a track to send the playhead precisely; there are also frame/ten-frame nudges, work area to fit selected layers and trimming the composition to the work area. Editing tools can align layer In/Out to the playhead while preserving internal timing, or auto-trim empty space based on first/last keyframes; marker management supports quick adding, name search, clearing and Duration-based Protected Regions that guard animated timing.
aescripts-brand-keeper: Keeps client brand guidelines inside a native AE panel, organized into four pages — Colors, Type, Assets, Notes — for primary/secondary swatches, font families/usage/weights/sizes, logos and other assets, global rules and per-composition notes. Click a swatch to copy its HEX, click Import next to an asset to drop it into the current composition; all brands live in a local global Library that works offline and can switch between multiple clients across AEPs. Brand setups can be exported as .bkbrand files for teammates to import, passing along colors, fonts, assets and notes while client data never leaves the machine.
aescripts-moti-wizard: When an already-animated Illustrator/Photoshop artwork needs to be changed, update the source right at the playhead: swap the PSD/AI file, grab a fresh snapshot of PSD redraws, or jump back to the original file for editing — no need to rebuild the AE layers.
aescripts-batch-comp-normalizer: Normalizes selected compositions or a whole folder with seven groups of batch tools. Normalize Size scans the animated visible range of the work area, auto-excluding full-bleed backgrounds, cropping content, adding padding or forcing a fixed size; Effect Sync, Text Sync and Color Sync pull specific effect values, full font/paragraph/stroke/spacing styles, and text, Shape and effect colors from source layers and sync them across compositions. Text Find/Replace supports case, whole-word matching, layer name filtering, auto-scaling text with alignment preserved; Cleanup removes disabled or empty layers, empty text, disabled effects, guide layers and orphaned nulls, while Time Tools batch-adjusts duration, frame rate, work area, layer offset/trim/extend. Major operations offer Analyze preview, progress and reports, safe testing on duplicated compositions, and skip locked layers or properties containing keyframes/expressions.
aescripts-ae-work-manager: Logs hours and produces project cost reports right inside After Effects — no more spreadsheets or external timers.
aescripts-vaeriable: Type or load values directly in the timeline and solve arithmetic, algebra and cross-multiplication (handy for ratio conversions).
aescripts-2dfbend: Automatically slices any selected layer into a given number of Segments and builds a controllable bending rig, no manual complex setup needed; great for circular compositions, folded surfaces, curved UI, creative distortions, dynamic transitions and 360° structures. The full version creates independent controllers for multi-segment bends, adjusts front/back opacity, refines seams with Mask Expansion, restricts start/end segments, slides curvature Offset with precise curvature control, and can duplicate controllers, stack multiple bends and animate every parameter.
A flat layer is sliced into equal sections and folded into arcs, rings or multi-segment folded surfaces
aescripts-3d-extruder: Creates high-quality extrusions with the classic auto-stacked 2.5D layer method, so the result exists in real AE 3D space and interacts correctly with other 3D layers. The standard precomp architecture can be modified in depth, Edit Mode temporarily simplifies the structure, and Draft 3D speeds up timeline previews; the material engine simulates shadows, specular highlights and reflections that change with the extruded object, control lights or reflector boards. Includes 10 presets, plus saving custom presets, duplicating versions or copying extrusions across compositions, quick reflection centering and expression repair.
Text or graphics stack into a thick extruded body through many 2.5D layers, with highlights and reflections that follow lights and reflector boards
aescripts-3d-flip-board: Creates a fully animated 3D split-flap board from a folder containing each frame with one click, for text displays or scene transitions. Animation can be driven by keyframes or markers and adjusted through a centralized Pseudo Effect; offers four auto-flip modes: Bi-direction, Forward, Backward, One Flip. The download includes a sample project — just select the frame folder and target composition to generate.
An airport or station-style split-flap board flips through frames, switching text, numbers or images on markers
aescripts-3d-flip-book: Creates a 3D page-flipping book animation with one click, perfect for albums, magazines or portfolio page turns.
A 3D book flips through its pages one by one
aescripts-3d-letters-animator: Generates customizable 3D titles with adjustable font, material, lighting and direction, animating letters in one by one.
3D letters fly in one by one to compose a title
aescripts-3d-primitives-generator-3: Generates four types of controllable 3D primitives — Cube/Cuboid, Cylinder, Pyramid, Prism — from native AE Shape Layers, Solids and Pre-comps with one click; lightweight and independent of external 3D software. Each face is its own composition, so colors, patterns, textures or gradients can be applied per face, with size and shape driven by centralized sliders; Cube, Pyramid and Prism also offer full Taper control. Multiple primitives can be assembled into more complex models, and version 3 improves expression performance, layer naming and label colors for easy portability to other projects.
Native AE layers form cubes, cylinders, pyramids or prisms with per-face materials, taperable and assemblable into models
aescripts-3d-to-2d-screenspace: Converts the position of a 3D layer into a matching 2D screen-space null, so 2D text labels can track 3D objects easily.
aescripts-aaf-relinker: Automatically relinks missing footage to files even when names or durations differ slightly — especially useful after AAF imports.
aescripts-accelcurve: Analyzes the easing of selected keyframes and applies it to other animations with one click, and can edit motion curves with three or more control points beyond AE's traditional two-point curve; applying a multi-point curve automatically creates intermediate keyframes between two selected keyframes to preserve the curve shape. Shift-click adds control points, Alt-click removes them; includes 24 three- and four-point curve presets, and custom curves can be grouped, sorted, renamed, moved between groups and exported/imported. The interface switches between horizontal/vertical layouts with adjustable chart size, and can show both Velocity and the Acceleration Graph that AE natively lacks.
Animation speed doesn't just ease once but follows three or more control points through multiple rises, pauses and re-accelerations
aescripts-add-time: Inserts or subtracts a specified amount of time in the project at the playhead, in seconds or Frames; the tool fully copies and shifts affected keyframes, adjusts composition length and layer In/Out points so manual timing edits don't break animation. It recurses into related subcomps and deeper nested compositions to keep everything in sync, adding green Add Time or red Subtract Time markers along the way; guide layers and locked layers can be ignored.
aescripts-advanced-composition-grids: Draws non-rendering Guide Shape Layers at the top of a composition with one click, offering 10 parameterizable composition grids: rule of thirds, proportional squares, diagonals and center cross, safe margins, hexagons, a true 120° isometric grid, golden rectangle, Rows & Columns with Gutter, Golden Spiral/Phi Grid, the Diagonal Method with Reciprocals and Rebatment, plus Center & Symmetry guides. Size, spacing and toggles stay editable in Effect Controls, and color and line weight can be changed in the Shape Groups; it remembers the last used type and a single Undo removes it.
Adjustable, non-exported composition guides — rule of thirds, isometric, golden spiral or column grids — overlaid on the comp
aescripts-advanced-mask-editor-2: A centralized toolset for advanced AE Mask editing that works with animated masks and provides 50 Animated Presets. Includes common commands like duplicating masks, horizontal/vertical flip, 90° rotation, vertical mirror, Solo Mask, Free Transform Points, Cut, and converting masks to Shape Layers, cutting repetitive steps in rotoscoping, symmetrical shapes and heavy path cleanup.
aescripts-advanced-selection: Batch-filters and selects layers by layer type, blend mode, name, label color and more — a real time-saver when organizing large projects.
aescripts-colorflow: Creates, names and sorts custom palettes and applies colors to Text, Shape, Solid, Footage, Comp or composition background with one click, including the Base Color of 3D models and Parametric Mesh imported in AE 2024+. Picks colors from compositions, images, paused video frames, Effects or Expressions with de-duplication, and pastes colors from Adobe Color, Coolors, CSS/JSON or plain text containing HEX. Provides Complementary, Triadic, Analogous, Tetradic and light/dark Shades; Live Color Link centrally controls all linked colors through a ColorFlow Master Null with expressions, or you can Unlink & Bake. Label Flow selects, solos, inverts selection, toggles Shy and auto-organizes large timelines by label.
aescripts-quicklink-items: Quickly finds and replaces missing footage items in a project, saving the pain of manual re-linking one by one when applying ready-made templates.
aescripts-layer-name-tag: Auto-arranges the pre-comp layers in the current composition into a neat grid of 2, 3 or 4 columns with Gutter options of 20/40/60/80 px, then creates a text label above each precomp reading its source name, with adjustable position, size and color. Labels stay linked to the Timeline Layer Name and the Project Panel Asset Name — renaming either updates both instantly — perfect for turning 20–30 similar-looking modules, kits or render setups into an instantly readable visual map.
Many precomp thumbnails arranged in a regular grid, each topped with a label that auto-updates when the source is renamed
aescripts-solaritext: Creates a fully editable 3D split-flap board from any selected Text Layer with one click — no prefabricated cards, image folders or manual setup. The V3 Fixed Rig Engine supports large boards with a cleaner, more scalable card structure; Airport/Wall Grid Mode builds rectangular display walls with automatic blank filler cards. Animation can start Simultaneous, Sequential or Random, with Random Seed for reproducible results; Fast Preview Mode is for design, spacing and timing, while Full 3D Mode offers real camera, light and shadow interaction. Rebuild Timings works without rebuilding the board, and a Baked Copy renders more easily while the original editable rig is preserved; supports multi-line and multi-language text.
A large airport or station-style flap wall flips out multi-line text in sync, sequential or random rhythm, cards affected by 3D camera and lights
aescripts-cleanup-master: Edits complex characters, frame-by-frame animations and Mask Paths inside a single Shape Layer directly from Comp Viewer vertex selection, avoiding dozens of split layers. Includes onion skinning of previous/next frames, Shape Clipping Masks, Stroke-to-Shape with Taper and various Caps/Joins, group Solo/Hide/Reveal, creating follower nulls from selected vertices, parenting Shape Groups directly to nulls, and adjusting group stacking within the same layer. It can delete vertices while keeping animation, convert shapes to masks linked to the original path, create Shade Groups similar to group precomps; Tweak Paths propagates single-frame path fixes across all work-area keyframes, and you can isolate selected paths, copy/paste full or partial Shape States, align or fold vertices and keyframe selected paths.
aescripts-mcloner-pro: A high-performance layer cloning system that generates, distributes and animates large numbers of copies in real time, with Live Update continuously reflecting changes in sources and controllers. Offers Radial, Linear, Grid and more distributions, with multi-source blending, replacement, exclusion and Shuffle; Path Mode arranges and moves clones along multiple masks in 2D or 3D, while Effectors drive dynamic interactions by distance/proximity. Also includes Delay, Sine Wave, Spiral/Arc control, orientation and base Transform, Cylinder and Kinetic Text modes, color/gradient, and OBJ/GLB 3D model integration; system tools can reset parameters individually or fully clear Controllers, Groups, Targets and Clones.
Large numbers of shapes clone along grids, radial, cylinder or complex mask paths, pushed by nearby effectors with delay or wave-like sequential animation
aescripts-layerstash: Stores Text, Shape, Solid, Adjustment, Null or Precomp layers — with all attributes, keyframes, effects, expressions and text animators — in a database, then loads them into any AE project with one click. Organize and search with Client/Project Profiles, or export selected layers or a whole profile as .layerstash files for team import. Premium Group Mode stores multiple selected layers as a single group, preserving and reconnecting Parenting Chains, Track Mattes and cross-layer Expressions within the group on load; Duplicate Comp Hierarchy creates genuinely independent precomp hierarchy copies instead of native Ctrl/Cmd+D still sharing the same precomp. Also restores details like Layer Styles, Blending Modes, layer timing and Shape Adjustment Layers.
aescripts-typemonkey: Auto-generates, typesets and animates kinetic typography from control-panel parameters. Each word is evenly distributed across the comp or work area, with a parented Camera pointing at each word in sequence; the timeline doesn't rely on traditional keyframes — move markers to quickly change the rhythm, and Marker Sync aligns to existing marker layers to sync music or narration. Manually adjust word size, position, rotation and opacity, apply multiple text transitions specified or randomly, and control camera interpolation, Auto-Rotate, Auto-Frame and Motion Blur; supports preset save/load, Kuler palettes and third-party TextMods. The automatic Build/Clean workflow suits iteration, plus MonkeyTools for layer visibility, locking, scene splitting and duplicate marker cleanup.
Words appear in space one after another while the camera advances, rotates and auto-frames between them on marker rhythm, forming kinetic typography synced to music or narration
aescripts-control-lmfx: Groups layers and effects into sets that operate across the currently active compositions, centrally controlling whole-group visibility and behavior, and batch-adjusting parameters of the same effect across multiple selected compositions. The FX Manager shows which effects are enabled project-wide and which layers use a selected effect; Timeline Preset Filters quickly display only the needed layer types. The panel also integrates Quick Palette/Palette Manager, Pre-Compose and quick un-packing, Recolor Keyframes, FPS Editor, Expression Tool, Render Layers, layer/composition renaming and custom project folder sorting. Duplicate Compositions can duplicate or just group while auto-updating comp() names in expressions; Quick Actions also cover common operations like Null and Track Matte.
aescripts-depth-scanner-2: Uses AI to auto-estimate a depth map from video, usable for depth-of-field blur, volumetric fog, fake 3D parallax and more; the second generation improves flicker between frames.
The frame turns into a black-and-white depth-layered map
aescripts-dust-transition: A GPU-accelerated dust/disintegration plugin that dissolves footage into millions of pixel-sized particles. Offers three transitions — Linear, Noise and Image-based: control linear wipe angle/feather, noise scale/contrast, or use a black-and-white image and precomp luminance to precisely shape the disintegration. Particles can be distorted by multiple Noise Algorithms with Wind and Gravity, colored with Gradient Ramp, Blend Mode and color noise, and Shine simulates sand sparkle; up to 20 stacked layers add dust detail. Supports 3D space, AE Camera depth of field, particles dissolving toward the camera, MSAA, visible probability and Dust Size control; Draw Mode outputs the particle layer and remaining original separately for flexible compositing.
The image disintegrates into fine dust along linear, noise or custom luminance shapes, blown by wind and gravity with gradient colors and sand sparkle in 3D depth
aescripts-switch: Replaces footage or compositions throughout a project while automatically preserving original scale, position, masks and parenting — swapping template images won't break your layout.
aescripts-mad-painter: A GPU-accelerated plugin that generates painterly brush strokes on video with pure algorithms — no generative AI; adjust different Brush Sizes and control Paint Styles to turn dynamic footage into hand-painted/oil-painting imagery built from dense strokes. Windows requires a CUDA or OpenCL GPU; macOS supports Intel and Apple Silicon with macOS 12+; machines without hardware acceleration cannot use it. Also compatible with Premiere Pro for video artistic stylization without frame-by-frame hand painting.
Live footage is repainted into a dynamic oil painting of directional strokes, from fine short brushes to thick, swirling Van Gogh-style texture
aescripts-jlitch: Turns compression errors and frame feedback into glitch art — tunable from slight digital noise to full psychedelic distortion.
The frame looks like a corrupted video, with color blocks dragging out psychedelic patterns
aescripts-pathblurfx: Computes a vector field from a Mask Path and blurs the image along the curve direction for motion-blur-like flow trails, melting smears of text and shapes, or streaks that ignore alpha and pull pixels into continuous lines. Set Blur Amount independently at the path start and end, shift Start/End Blur Positions along the path with positional falloff, and smooth sharp direction changes. Dynamic Sampling keeps sample density consistent as blur length changes, avoiding sparse or uneven quality in long trails.
The image bends and stretches along any mask curve, forming speed trails that follow the path's turns, melting strokes or continuous light threads unclipped by alpha
aescripts-bao-bones: Rigs characters with IK bones inside After Effects — the skeleton is built in three steps and you can start posing, making walk cycles fast.
aescripts-fluxion: A GPU particle plugin that builds a Vector Field from one or more masks so particles flow naturally along the mask direction; adjust field width, Falloff, Scale and Sampling Density, flip the flow or let particles continue past path endpoints. Emitters can be Mask, Box, Sphere or Point with rate, lifetime and Seed control; includes 9 built-in particle shapes plus Custom Layer Particles, adjustable speed, size, opacity, rotation and random variance, and Size/Opacity over Life curves. Physics include Gravity, Wind and Air Resistance, with three types of Turbulence controlling intensity, speed, density and Seed; supports 3D, AE Camera Focus Distance depth of field, Motion Blur, 8 blend modes and Simulation Scale time control.
Particles flow like smoke plumes or glowing dust along an invisible field formed by one or more masks, perturbed by turbulence, wind and gravity into 3D depth
aescripts-lorenz-system: Computes the Lorenz System in the current composition and creates the 2D projection of this chaotic dynamical system directly as AE Paths, easy to color and animate with Stroke, Trim Paths or other native Shape/Mask tools. The download includes a sample project and commented Script Source Code so you can modify the algorithm or extend its uses; official compatibility lists up to AE 2020/CC 2017–2019 — an older but editable math visualization script.
A line endlessly orbits two lobes, tracing a butterfly-like Lorenz strange attractor with intricate, never-quite-repeating chaotic trajectories
aescripts-autocaption: Uploads audio or video to a server for transcription with Deepgram Nova-3 and OpenAI Whisper Large v3 into editable native AE text layers; supports automatic language detection and 99 languages. Choose word-by-word, 2–3 chars per layer, 2–5 chars by rhythm and meaning, or full sentences, output as single or multiple layers, and apply 30+ styles with editable fonts, colors, timing and animation; also supports Typewriter, Wiggle, Pulse, Float, per-word timecodes, RTL and SRT import/export. Requires internet; 200 MB max per file.
Editable social-style subtitles that pop word by word, highlight key words, add speech bubbles, or apply typewriter, wiggle, pulse and float animations
aescripts-extendo: A rare edge-extension plugin for AE that rebuilds missing detail around keyed edges, great for fixing roto edges.
aescripts-type-realign: Keeps text position intact when switching text layer alignment, so changing left/center/right layouts doesn't require repositioning.
aescripts-rxxr: Generates ASCII character and pixel-style tech glitch effects with built-in style presets and gradients — great for hacker/terminal looks.
The frame is composed of dense characters and pixel blocks
aescripts-raytracing-relight: Uses depth maps and normal maps for real-time 2.5D ray-traced relighting of live footage — add, change or completely replace light without reshooting or re-rendering.
Light added in post correctly lands on object surfaces
aescripts-mb-liquid-glass: A GPU-accelerated liquid glass material plugin with adjustable refraction, blur, highlights and shadows — fast for iOS-style transparent glass UI.
A translucent glass layer refracts the image underneath
aescripts-high-pass-for-ae: Brings Photoshop's classic High Pass Filter into After Effects with GPU acceleration, extracting high-frequency image detail. Beyond sharpening with blend modes, it can build Detail Masks, adjust or isolate Skin Detail, make Texture Tiling, and other frequency/texture-driven compositing. A name-your-own-price plugin with native Apple Silicon support; official compatibility lists up to AE 2024, covering CS6 through CC/2020–2024.
aescripts-3d-wizard: Uses AI inside AE to convert 2D images into 3D models, and can edit the generated result with text prompts (Windows only for now).
aescripts-fractalmapper: A GPU-accelerated Fractal/Kaleidoscopic mapping plugin that draws any image or video into animatable Mandelbrot, Julia Real/Imaginary and other fractals, with Power of Z changing the formula's appearance. Morph interpolates continuously between the original image and the fractal result, ideal for transitions into or out of infinite structures; Transformation adjusts the fractal itself and the Source Image within it independently. Also offers Hue/Saturation/Brightness/Opacity coloring, Edge Repeat kaleidoscoping, and Number of Passes recursion for stacking more complex glitch and abstract patterns. Official compatibility stops at AE 2021.
The source gradually deforms and dives into Mandelbrot or Julia's infinite self-similar structures, with edge repeat forming kaleidoscopes and multi-level recursive glitch patterns
aescripts-mirai: An AI assistant that generates AE scripts and expressions from natural language descriptions, with support for Gemini, OpenRouter and other models.
aescripts-pluck: Drag a .aep onto the panel to read out all its Compositions without opening the source project — inspect size, FPS, duration and search/filter, then import only the one or more Comps you need. Pluck auto-resolves Precomps and Footage Dependencies, mirrors the original Project Folder Structure, de-duplicates/relinks existing footage, and warns about potentially broken Expressions; optional Auto-sort, Flat or custom subfolders with Label Color. v1.1 can copy referenced footage into the current project folder and relink, with Smart Folder Matching, filename collision policies, whole Image Sequences and >10 GB confirmation. The reverse Pluck Off exports a selected Comp as a self-contained .aep or ZIP with Comp/Project/Date token batch naming.
aescripts-project-doctor: A one-panel health check for large projects: relink missing footage, clear duplicate assets, browse and mark media — restoring order to messy projects.
aescripts-kease: An easing curve tool supporting curve adjustment across single and multiple keyframes, quickly unifying the acceleration/deceleration feel across entire animations.
aescripts-puzzlemotion: A block-based animation system: drag directional blocks onto a visual timeline and snap them together to generate animation — no hand-keying keyframes or touching the curve editor.
aescripts-clonespace: A GPU-accelerated layer cloning plugin that clones and distributes layers into arrays in 3D space for dimensional repeating graphics.
The same layer is cloned into a neat array in 3D space
aescripts-aquon: A GPU-accelerated 2D fluid plugin simulating water-like flow and diffusion — perfect for ink-bleed and liquid motion graphics.
Colors push and bleed into each other like water
aescripts-lightsweeppro: Builds a True 3D Signed Distance Field from text or alpha, then simulates light sweeping around the beveled surface with real thickness — not a flat bright band on top. Four Bevel Profiles — Round, Flat, Sharp, Mesa — shape glass, metal, plastic or machined edges; Radial Chromatic Aberration, Fresnel warm/cool dispersion and Edge Glow plus seven presets complete looks like Chrome, Prism and Halation. Luminance Mode sweeps light along the luminance contours of any photo or product image. Normal-driven Fractal Noise adds brushed metal, stone and organic micro-textures, while Spin Speed/Angle Jitter moves automatically without keyframes. Everything lives on a single layer with no precomposing; supports 8/16/32bpc and MFR, but officially Windows-only, AE 2024+ recommended.
Light slides along the 3D bevel of text, logos or product luminance contours, with chrome edge reflections, iridescent dispersion and fine direction-responsive surface texture
aescripts-deepcopy: One-click duplication of a precomp (including its nested compositions below) into a fully independent copy — editing one never touches the other.
aescripts-dynamic-shadow-3: The Visual Shadow engine adds shadows, light and Reflections to one or more selected objects and auto-adjusts the angle based on the layers' positions, simulating natural sunlight with minimal settings. Includes over 19 Shadow Styles and 12 Light Styles — preview first, then apply, adjusting shadow, lighting and reflection parameters afterwards. A 3D Shadow mode builds directional 3D shadows and basic reflections from any Shape; ideal for quickly adding consistent ground shadows to text, icons or flat product shots rather than full physical ray tracing.
Multiple flat objects cast directionally consistent shadows of varying length based on relative position, with sunlight highlights and reflections as if lit in one space
aescripts-pause-cleaner: Auto-detects silent segments in audio tracks and creates a new composition with the blanks removed — rhythm-cutting voiceover videos without manual chopping.
aescripts-ballpoint: A GPU-accelerated Ballpoint Texture Engine that redraws every video frame as dense, dynamic-detail-responsive ballpoint pen lines, evoking doodles on old notebook paper, Technical Drawing, Punk Zine or Forensic Diagram. Built-in Stroke Styles like Robocop, Curls and Web range from mechanical staccato lines to loose organic scribbles; all elements can be keyframed, many parameters respond brush-sensitively, and Complexity, Flow and Texture can be adjusted on the timeline, with support for line-reveal animation. Presets provided with live preview; requires OpenCL/OpenGL hardware support, macOS 12+ with Intel/Apple Silicon.
The video is redrawn live as dense ballpoint sketches on yellowed paper, with mechanical scribbles, curls or webs, animatable for progressive reveal
aescripts-rescanx: Rebuilds the frame as scan-line contour imagery, producing the electronic scan look of topographic maps, thermal imaging or surveillance monitors.
The object becomes rings of glowing scanning contours
aescripts-foldcraft: Cuts regular media, text, alpha-channel assets or keyed/green-screen footage into movable layers and builds Paper-fold/Origami Animation with occlusion, flips and overlapping relationships — not a flat wipe. Standard, Text, Alpha and Green Screen modes handle titles, logos, transparent icons, people or objects respectively; Texture, Borders, Blending, Jitter and Timing controls adjust between clean geometric folds and handmade paper texture. Suited to title packages, logo reveals, product shots, social clips and origami transitions, and works in both After Effects and Premiere Pro.
Text, logos or keyed people are cut into layered paper sheets that fold, occlude and unfold one by one, with adjustable paper texture, borders and handmade jitter
aescripts-free-compose: Creates Photoshop-like expandable/collapsible layer groups inside the original composition timeline without actually pre-composing, so layers stay directly accessible and nothing gets clipped by precomp bounds or breaks existing Expressions/Parenting. Nested Groups are supported, moving the Group Control Layer moves the whole group along the timeline, effects can be added/removed from the group layer with nested-order sync, and masks apply to the whole group — computable before or after effects — while inner layers can still be adjusted like Track Matte content. It can also toggle whole-group Visibility/Audibility/Lock remembering original state, stretch group timing, duplicate groups, set Track Mattes, and re-anchor by the average position after animation.
aescripts-comp-o-rama: Drag multiple Composition Presets or custom specs into the queue to batch-create all compositions with one click. Includes 30 built-in Social, HD, 4K, Cinema, Broadcast, Animation and High Frame Rate formats; build your own presets, favorite common ones and organize with nested folders via drag-and-drop. Smart Naming provides 14 built-in tokens like {preset}, {index}, {width}, {height}, {fps}, {project}, plus Custom Tokens, so whole batches auto-name on the same pattern. Bulk Edit changes Width, Height, FPS, Duration and Background Color across multiple queue items at once, and can Match Current Composition. Full queues can be saved as Brand Pack, Social Bundle and other templates for one-click rebuilds of the same delivery set in other projects, plus a Project Report and full Undo.
aescripts-oscilloscope: Turns images, audio or paths into glowing analog oscilloscope traces with adjustable beam thickness, phosphor trails and flicker.
Green glowing lines draw waveforms on a black background
aescripts-safest-zone: Keeps platform UI, crop areas or client restrictions visible as Safe Zones when designing Social Videos, Ads, Thumbnails and Campaign Variants. Built-in presets for common social platforms can be previewed before adding to the selected composition; select multiple layouts at once to Duplicate Compositions per safe frame with matching guides auto-applied. Any Shape Layer can become a reusable Custom Preset for brand templates, rare placements or one-off specs. Color, Opacity, Guide-layer Status and Lock State update in bulk across selected compositions; custom presets support inline rename, name colors and drag-drop sorting.
aescripts-colorvsn: Uses color mapping to swap grayscale information for intense color palettes — a grading tool for bold pseudo-color, thermal-imaging styles.
A grayscale frame gets swapped for a bold color map
aescripts-fractal-terrain: Generates animatable, customizable 3D terrain directly inside After Effects using high-quality Fractal Noise as height data and ray-casting. Supports composition Camera/Lights, projects 3D layers as textures onto the terrain, and GPU-optimized post effects include Depth of Field. Beyond basic mountain ranges, create Lava Field surfaces, Lunar Surfaces without atmosphere, animated Offset Ripple Waves, or valleys with step plateaus and volumetric fog via Base Terrain, Flatten Band and Fog. Supports Windows 10+, macOS 11+ Apple Silicon; GPU backends include Metal, CUDA and OpenCL.
Rolling mountains, volcanic lava fields, lunar surfaces, rippling water or fog-filled valleys generated directly, crossed by AE cameras, lit and depth-of-field blurred
aescripts-fluid: A GPU-accelerated 2D Navier–Stokes fluid simulation that reads any Layer's Alpha Contour as a fluid emitter; a second independent emitter can use a different color for dual-stream collision and color mixing. Any Alpha layer can also serve as a Collider with Bounce and Friction control, and Invisible Colliders route flow with hidden boundaries. Animating the Source Point converts its movement speed into Emission Velocity, with Tail Length, Velocity Dissipation, Front Bombe and Wake Width reacting to speed; Mask Paths can be pasted as Source Point keyframes. Physics include Gravity, Wind, Buoyancy, Vorticity, Swirl, Viscosity and three-level fBm Turbulence; five Color Modes, pseudo-volumetric Shading, Bloom and four quality levels balance preview and render, and the simulation is resolution-independent from the comp.
Text, logos or moving points release continuous smoke streams and liquid trails; two colors can collide and mix, flowing around transparent obstacle shapes with friction and bounce
aescripts-scenestasher: Saves selected layer and keyframe states as buttons, then returns to that time point and selection with one click — handy when fine-tuning long segments repeatedly.
aescripts-stipple: Rebuilds video with GPU-physics-simulated stipple patterns that stay temporally consistent — ideal for non-flickering newspaper halftones, illustrated pointillism and custom sprite animation.
The image is rebuilt from dots of varying density; dots flow continuously with the footage's motion instead of jumping frame by frame
aescripts-light-volume: Renders Point Lights and Spotlights inside an AE Composition as visible volumetric light cones truly located in 3D space, with multiple lights working simultaneously. Fine control over Light Softness, Falloff and Source Size, plus Distortion to blend hard beams naturally into haze; the Dust module spawns suspended particles only in brighter volume regions to add air thickness. A Depth Map Input can limit the light-fog Render Area so foreground objects or external 3D depth data correctly occlude the beams. Fully GPU-accelerated, suited to stage spotlights, God Rays, indoor window light and dusty haze lighting.
Point and spot lights form 3D beams with softness, falloff and slight distortion in the air; dust appears in bright areas and objects in the depth map occlude them
aescripts-face-director: Animates Facial Expressions, Eye/Head Direction and Neck Height on existing footage to fix expressions that don't fit the scene, keep mouth and eye continuity across cuts, rescue actors from laughing, or push features to exaggerated extremes. Drag facial features directly in the Preview Window instead of relying only on numeric sliders; Puppet Mode assigns another Layer as the Driver Video and transfers its facial performance to the target. Supports After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and Nuke on macOS/Windows.
A live actor's smile, mouth closure, gaze, head direction and neck height can be re-directed in post, from invisible performance fixes to extreme face warps
aescripts-pixel-sorter-4: The original pixel-sorting plugin: reorders pixels into streaks by brightness and other conditions for glitch art and digital-tear looks.
Frame pixels get pulled into long color streaks in one direction.
aescripts-pixion: A particle system driven by layer pixels: particle behavior follows frame brightness and color, creating effects where images converge into form or shatter apart.
The image is assembled from countless particles
aescripts-voxpattern: A GPU-accelerated plugin that generates geometric pattern arrays directly in 3D space — for tech-style backgrounds and dimensional graphic walls.
aescripts-overact: Adds Overshoot or Bounce to existing AE keyframes controlled with animation language directly — no tuning of Frequency, Decay or Gravity. Specify overshoot/bounce count and total frame count, then adjust Amplitude, later-period Dampen, settle-last or bounce-last, Time Dilation, Peak Easing, Peak Timing and Peak Dampen; Enable decides which keyframes of a property get the expression, and multiple properties can be processed at once with presets saved.
Objects shoot past their target and settle in waves of unequal length, or bounce on landing; peaks can be early, late or heavily eased for exaggerated, deliberately non-physical character
aescripts-quickimporter: Replaces the standard import dialog with high-speed fuzzy search tolerant of typos to find assets among thousands of files; hover an icon to audition audio, open videos in Media Player preview, and image sequences merge into a single search result. Supports Favorites, Recent folders and path autocomplete, with a license shared between After Effects, Premiere Pro and Audition. Thumbnails follow macOS Quick Look for many formats; Windows only JPG/PNG. AIFF has no audio preview.
Produces no visual effect; shortens the find-and-import workflow for large asset libraries with search, auditioning, preview and image-sequence grouping
aescripts-vectis: Draws pseudo-3D bezier lines with depth from any path, stroke width automatically varying with Z depth and camera distance.
Lines have a sense of depth, thinning in the distance and thickening up close
aescripts-ray-projector: Detects edges from the Source Image's Transparency or Color Intensity, converts them to Contours, then extrudes along a specified Distance/Direction into a real 3D Model. The model is shaded with a Semi-transparent Material and Spherical Reflection Map, with six built-in Reflection Maps or any AE layer as a Custom Environment Map; Gradient Coloring can also stack along the Extrusion Axis to separate front/back depth. The result transforms in 3D space and responds directly to the AE Native Camera. GPU-accelerated, great for turning logos, text outlines or image boundaries into glassy, reflective light pillars and orbitable 3D extrusions.
Transparent or high-contrast contours extrude into semi-transparent reflective volumes, the sides shading by depth gradient while environmental highlights move across the surface with the AE camera
aescripts-led-architect: Calculates resolution, panel count, power draw and weight of LED walls, and generates compositions with reference lines and test charts with one click — for stage wall content.
aescripts-interlaced-glitch: Reproduces the real interlaced recording characteristics of old analog and early digital cameras, including Interlacing Artifacts, Scanlines, subtle signal flaws and imperfect motion; adjust item by item from millennium-era home camcorders to soft, time-worn Lo-fi images rather than applying a fixed overlay. Fully supports Multi-Frame Rendering for modern AE render pipelines.
Moving edges carry interlaced combing and unstable motion; scanlines and subtle signal defects cover the frame, evoking early DV/analog camcorder lo-fi nostalgia
aescripts-chr0ma: Replaces the built-in hue/saturation with Oklab color science, so brightness perception stays consistent while grading — no dead grays or fluorescent weird colors.
aescripts-compstronaut: Navigates AE like a browser: go back/forward to the comps and time positions you were at, so you never get lost bouncing between deeply nested compositions.
aescripts-keystone: An animator's arranging toolbox: align, stagger in sequence, sort, stretch keyframes and color labels — fast clean sequence animation.
aescripts-textflex: Splits text animation control per character, word or line, creating flexible text entrances/exits without keyframing.
aescripts-torn-paper: Turns any masked layer into realistic torn-paper edges for collage and handmade styles — no hunting for assets or slow Photoshop brushing.
Rough fibrous edges of torn paper
aescripts-power-cylinder: Wraps a layer into a controllable 3D cylinder with elliptical deformation, unfolding, self-shadows, reflections and depth of field — for scrolls or cylindrical label animation.
A flat texture rolls into a glossy 3D cylinder
aescripts-stylex: Uses AI to convert video into cartoon, sketch, painting or halftone styles — no frame-by-frame processing for rotoscoped looks.
Live footage is replaced with illustration or anime brushwork
aescripts-root: Collects assets scattered across your computer into a clean, self-contained project, auto-finding missing media and organizing folders — delivery and backup become easy.
aescripts-slitscan: A native plugin producing slit-scan effects — frames from different times stretched into long strips, creating experimental time-smeared imagery.
The frame is dragged by time along one direction into flowing strips
aescripts-jpeg-glitch: Breaks the JPEG compression algorithm directly to produce realistic compression glitches — for screen corruption and digital damage looks.
Blocky compression artifacts and shifted color blocks appear on the frame
aescripts-despill-maestro: Removes green-screen spill color reflected onto subjects while protecting skin tones and clothing colors, adjustable from light correction to aggressive de-saturation.
aescripts-reka-grid: A feature-rich grid generation plugin that arranges graphics into matrices with various animation variations — clean graphic walls and layout motion.
Graphics in a neat grid change in sequence
aescripts-animateparallax: Places layers in Z-space depth visually, quickly building camera moves with real parallax depth (photos to 2.5D).
A still image is split into layers whose foreground and background move at different speeds
aescripts-pixel-encoder: Converts video into coarse pixel animation with 10 built-in modular presets and a chaos engine — retro low-res digital texture.
The frame turns into coarse colorful pixel blocks
aescripts-maskpngscatter: Scatters a PNG or layer in hundreds of copies randomly within a mask area — particle-like decorative elements or pattern fills.
Small motifs densely fill a specified shape
aescripts-wave-the-path: A GPU-accelerated plugin turning any path into flowing wave animation — sound waves, water ripples and abstract curve motion.
Lines undulate up and down like waves
aescripts-motion-extractor: Keeps only the moving parts of the frame and erases the static background, turning mundane footage into poetic dynamic abstraction.
Only the outlines of moving objects float against a dark background
aescripts-loopflow: Animates parts of a still photo (water flow, clouds, hair) into seamless looping video — the so-called cinemagraphs.
Only the water or clouds in a photo flow slowly
aescripts-polymorph: Replaces or attaches any layer in a comp to another layer — shapes, text, footage, nulls all work; swapping assets keeps the original animation.
aescripts-split-blur: A blur plugin with kaleidoscopic and rotational character — blurring while producing painterly layered strokes for dreamy atmospheric backgrounds.
aescripts-expression-kit: Manages 140 ready-to-use Expressions in seven categories with one click, opening Live Previews that play fast/slow and letting you tune each set's specific parameters before applying. Filter by Property Type and Difficulty, favorite Favorites/Recent; content includes 23 per-character Text Animators, kinetic text, Gravity/Bounce/Elastic Physics, and Motion Expressions for Position, Velocity, Direction and more. Stagger offsets selected layers automatically by Frames, Freeze locks expressions to a specified frame; the Expression Manager scans the whole project and shows Valid/Error/Disabled states, batch-enable/disable or paste to all/selected layers. A built-in Editor directly modifies and saves code.
aescripts-m-s-halftone: A halftone dot processing plugin — apply and go, no layer mapping needed, simulating print dots and comic style.
The image is composed of halftone dots of varying size
aescripts-superpose: Auto-generates clean plates, removing moving rain, snow, crowds and other objects from locked-off footage to restore a clean background.
aescripts-holora: Produces holographic laser-like color shifting by viewing angle — rainbow stickers, metallic laser-textured titles or packaging.
Rainbow metallic luster flows across the surface with the angle
aescripts-diffusae: Uses generative AI interactively inside AE to create or rewrite imagery; the second generation adds a cross-frame stabilization model so motion no longer flickers.
aescripts-aura: Generates high-density procedural waveforms on the GPU in AE 3D space, emitting along paths, masks or multiple layers with SVG export — for abstract line fields, flowing surfaces and geometric intros.
Fine lines, ribbons or points flow along 3D wave surfaces; a camera can travel through with depth-of-field layers
aescripts-nexanim: A new animation system that separates animation 'progress' from 'values' — changing values doesn't distort curves, and syncing multiple animations becomes easier.
aescripts-versioner: Manages multi-language or multi-version content within a single project — tag layers to a version and switch with one click, no duplicating the whole project.
aescripts-effect-remover-pro: A fully offline Effects management panel that scans effects used in compositions and instantly searches the effects on selected layers. Remove permanently item by item, temporarily Hide/Disable for A/B testing, or re-Show/Enable; one-click Remove All, Hide All, Show All with Ctrl/Cmd+Z undo on all batch operations. Favorites save common effects for direct application to selected layers, persisting across sessions; the list supports Auto and Manual refresh.
Adds no particular visual style; compares before/after by temporarily disabling, re-enabling or permanently removing effects, and cleans heavy compositions' Effects Stacks
aescripts-quickopen: A panel for quickly opening, managing and saving project files, with customizable save naming and workflows — fast switching when juggling multiple projects.
aescripts-project-font-pro: Scans all Text Layers in the whole Project, Selected Comps or the Active Comp, listing usage counts and containing Compositions per Font with one-click jumps to the target comp. When replacing, lock specific Fonts or narrow scope with Layer Name/Regex Filters, then choose to change only Typeface, Weight, Size, Color or Alignment; Missing Fonts can also be searched centrally and replaced in one pass. Grab Layer Style extracts Font, Size, Color, Stroke, Alignment, Leading and Tracking from a reference text, applying only the checked items to specified fonts. It counts affected layers after filtering before executing, reducing collateral damage in whole-project edits.
aescripts-naturamp: Generates unevenly distributed natural gradients that feel more organic than AE's built-in ones — soft backgrounds without harsh linear banding.
A gradient with irregularly blended color intensity
aescripts-loop-this-wiggle: Generates perfectly seamless loopable wiggle motion — via expression or baked directly into keyframes — for looping background motion without seams.
aescripts-transformer: An animation tool for perspective deformation and multi-screen arrangement of footage with many built-in presets — video walls, scrolls and dimensional typographic layouts.
Multiple screens arrange and rotate in 3D space
aescripts-toothpaste: Pastes SVG directly from the clipboard into AE as shape layers — moving icons from Illustrator or Figma without exporting files.
aescripts-lingoflip: Uses context-aware AI to translate a project into any language, generating one composition per language while the original files stay untouched.
aescripts-copy-face: Replaces a single face in a video locally with AI; each Clip currently supports one face only. The new face can come from another Image Layer, a verified .cpf file, or directly from a Text Prompt; with layers/CPF, check alignment first via New Face — the reference face should be centered and fill the frame. Instant Model is the default for fast, realistic face swaps; Style Model excels at cartoon or stylized characters, and One Frame Preview swaps frame by frame for quick checks. The plugin computes in batches of about 50 Frames, so the first frame and each batch start may wait one to two minutes.
Keeps the source video's head motion and timing while swapping one person's face for a realistic or stylized face from a reference image, verified face file, or text prompt
aescripts-volna: An advanced stroke plugin with built-in arrows, noise distortion, gradients and blending tools — line growth and indicator arrow animation.
Lines grow along paths with hand-drawn jitter
aescripts-stretch: Uses two masks to control image stretching direction, extending the frame along or across the masks — for morphing or filling gaps.
The image is stretched between two lines
aescripts-textlab-pro: Integrates Text Quality Analysis, Batch Operations and Styling. Counts text layers project-wide, reports Scale/Anchor Issues, average reading time, colors, Expressions and Effects; previews six Safe Zones — 9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5, 2:3, 3:4 — marking each layer Safe, Risky or Outside. Fix All Issues one-click resets selected text to 100% Scale, centered Anchor, removes whitespace; also Match Size, Auto Rename, Find Placeholders, Case Converter, and Fit Comp to Text/Shape including Stroke/Layer Styles. Styling offers eight basic animations, 15 FFX thumbnail presets, Style Sync, up to three Outline layers, per-character Colorful/Gradient/Alternate palettes, and Wave/Sync/Traveling Stroke Reveal.
aescripts-number-maker: Creates dynamic Text Numbers still editable through Layer Controls. Values animate in three modes — By Time, By Speed or By Marker — or read any layer property directly with Follow Property; Map Range remaps source Input Values to a specified Output Range, refined with Multiplier and Offset. Format with Prefix, Suffix, percentages or other Symbols for Counters, Timers, Progress Bars, UI/HUD, Infographics and data-driven animation. The interface adapts per mode, and everything stays editable from Effect Controls after creation — no regeneration needed.
aescripts-frankenstein-finder: Expands an entire AE project into a searchable composition and layer tree; double-click to jump straight to layers even when buried in deeply nested compositions. View Position, Scale, Rotation, Opacity live, rename multiple layers sequentially or add prefixes/suffixes, batch-apply and duplicate transforms, and isolate items with Shy while precisely restoring the original visible state; also provides cross-composition text editing, alignment, anchor, parenting and project health audit tools.
aescripts-ae-sheets: Indexes and manages AE text layers in a spreadsheet-style panel, editing language columns side by side; round-trips TSV and Google Sheets/Excel, or connects Google Gemini/OpenAI translation with your own API key. Includes 64 language settings with per-language font, size, tracking, leading and RTL, and font mapping preserves matching weights and styles across Chinese, Arabic, Devanagari and more. Auto Resize, Dynamic Anchor and Pinning keep text fitting the layout after language swaps; batch multi-language comp generation duplicates only shared nested comps with truly changed text, preserving originals and avoiding project bloat.
aescripts-keyless-zoom: Drives AE procedural cameras with start, end and time parameters — no manual keyframing. Intelligent Zoom to Fit auto-frames selected 3D layers, computing bounds even across rotations, orientations, scales or multi-null parenting chains; Overscan 1.0 matches the exact bounding box. Offers Zoom In, Zoom Out, Zoom to Fit, live interactive preview, and four easings — Smooth, Snappy, Cinematic, BounceBack — with intensity and overshoot control. Bake converts only the actually animated segment to keyframes, preserving gaps between segments and removing control nulls for later manual refinement.
aescripts-facepro: An AI portrait retouching plugin that auto-detects one or multiple faces, generating pixel-level skin masks that exclude hair, eyes, eyebrows, lips and background; alternatively use Skin Color or an external Mask, with mask inspection and fine-tuning. Dedicated models remove spots, pimples and small scars using surrounding skin context, softening texture while keeping detail; also whitening, de-shining via local exposure and texture correction, and skin-specific Hue, Saturation, Lightness, Density and Contrast controls.
Clean skin that naturally keeps pores and fine detail, reducing blemishes and shine while evening out tone; extreme color parameters also allow stylized portraits
aescripts-workflower: A layer workflow toolkit: build groups, apply adjustment layers only to selected layers, duplicate layers, merge masks and pre-render.
aescripts-aftercodecs: Exports ProRes, H264, H265 and HAP directly from AE/Premiere/AME without installing QuickTime, and supports large-scale batch output.
aescripts-goodbye-greenscreen-2: A fully local C++ AI human matting plugin — no manual masks or keyframes. Automasking handles Portraits, Full-body and groups of people with seven model choices for long hair and complex backgrounds, BiRefNet being the current default; Clean Plate Matting composites the original footage with a same-scene clean background like an enhanced Difference Matte; Color Mode is an AI Color Keyer that only picks a Screen Color. Matte Refinement is available, outputting Result, Matte, Warped Background or Matchpoints. Supports AE/Premiere with no image upload; Windows recommends NVIDIA 8GB VRAM, Apple Silicon needs macOS Sequoia+ with at least 16GB RAM.

Automatically separates portraits, full bodies or groups from the background, preserving fine edges like long hair; a same-scene clean plate or single screen color can also produce a usable alpha matte
aescripts-logoswap: Uses AI to remove a logo in the frame or replace it with another brand's — handy for producing multi-brand ad versions.
aescripts-color-grade-prompter: Uses text descriptions or reference images to auto-grade with AI, and exports the result as a LUT for reuse in other software.
aescripts-bullet-time: Uses AI frame interpolation for silky slow motion and speed changes that hold together even on large movements.
aescripts-ai-color-match: Analyzes a reference frame and automatically applies color correction to target footage, matching Exposure, Contrast, White Balance and other characteristics — ideal for unifying shots from different cameras, settings or lighting, or replicating a loved scene's grade. Computation runs on the local GPU, frames never leave the machine, and Match Strength is adjustable; supports After Effects and Premiere Pro. Standard is 8bpc; 16/32bpc and .cube LUT export come with Pro.
The source shot's exposure, contrast, color temperature and overall tone are pulled toward the reference frame, making multi-camera or cross-time footage look like one grade
aescripts-neural-enhancement-suite: Integrates multiple local AI image enhancement tasks. Guided Colorize colors black-and-white stills, or modifies color images in Keep Color mode, guided by Hints with settable position, color and influence; official consistency guarantees for stills only in this mode. For video coloring, switch to Example Colorize, sampling from up to two reference Layers with per-layer Influence. Low Light Enhancement's Overall Exposure lifts underexposed frames, HDR Recover pulls back only shadow detail; Superresolution upscales with AI supersampling. Supports GPU Acceleration, Lower Precision, CPU Fallback, Model Offloading and Computation Tiles, balancing quality against speed and VRAM/RAM usage.

Adds specified or reference colors to black-and-white images, rescues shadow detail in low-light and high-contrast footage, or upscales low-res frames; guided still coloring can paint exact regions with color points
aescripts-mask-prompter: Generates masks with AI from text descriptions, boxes or clicks for rotoscoping, with the Segment Anything model built in and everything computed locally.
aescripts-sound-prompter: A fully local C++ AI audio plugin that analyzes video content to generate Sound Effects, with optional Music; Text-to-Sound produces stereo effects or music from a text prompt, while Text+Video Mode aligns results to on-screen events. Positive/Negative Prompts come from effect-linked Mask names, excluding content like Music. Output auto-writes .wav; in AE it lands above the composition's Effect Layer, in Premiere Pro drag it in manually from the output folder. Supports live action, 3D renders, motion design and AI clips with NVIDIA GPU acceleration; Text+Video XXL needs about 18GB VRAM, and unregistered output contains gaps and beeps.
Generates synchronized WAV tracks — ambience, impacts, vehicles, birds, explosions, rhythms and music — from on-screen action or text descriptions
aescripts-universal-template-autofill: Scans any AE template to find every editable text, image and video field, then fills them all from one panel or CSV/XML — fast mass production of multiple versions.
aescripts-expresscode: Brings a VS Code-grade editor into AE for writing expressions, with autocomplete, live error checking and a library of common code snippets.
aescripts-ae-notepad: Notes and to-dos with timecodes inside AE/Premiere — click to jump back to that moment, great for client feedback (PDF export available).
aescripts-wrap-it-for-after-effects: Brings 3D camera projection into AE: load Alembic geometry, unwrap models to UVs or wrap textures back onto models — for scene extensions and material extraction.
aescripts-fractal-noise-browser: Turns 250+ fractal/noise settings into visual thumbnails with live previews — pick one and apply, no slow manual parameter tuning.
Various organic textures, smoke and grime feels
aescripts-editmonkey: Batch-animates and staggers dozens of text, video or graphic layers at once — saving days on repetitive typographic layout animation.
aescripts-face-3d: Uses AI to turn a portrait photo into a true animatable 3D model — head turns, parallax camera moves and relighting from a flat image.
A flat portrait gains 3D rotation and depth
aescripts-portal: See the main composition while working inside a precomp, with the main comp's position/rotation/scale conversions applied — no jumping out to verify details.
aescripts-cut-n-pack: Slices Solids, Shapes, AI/EPS vectors, Footage and Text layers into independent parts by Masks, preserving position, rotation, scale and auto-organizing names; also creates content-fitting precomps by Mask, layer Bounding Box or both, preserving position, time, properties and Parenting. Can generate featherable layer masks on a Shape Layer from shape element bounds, convert text to individual per-character shapes, split AI/EPS vectors, and shatter Solids or Footage with default masks.

Single texts, vectors, shapes or footage are cut into independently animatable parts, or fit into optimized precomps hugging visible content — for shattering, reveals, character animation and procedural repetition
aescripts-proximitypro: Uses one null as an effector that automatically drives changes in nearby layers by distance — a C4D-effector feel without writing expressions.
Elements enlarge or scatter as a controller approaches
aescripts-chronokeys: Ties keyframes and layer durations together: when a precomp's duration changes, keyframes stay put and neighboring layers shift along too.
aescripts-delay-motion-pro: Creates stable delay-follow animations (later elements catching up a beat behind) that chain automatically and coexist with parenting hierarchies without conflict.
A string of elements follows one after another like a whip
aescripts-aepathfinder: Brings Illustrator's Pathfinder into AE — merge, split, trim and animate vector shapes across layers.
aescripts-universal-audio: One click makes audio play through all nested compositions — reference audio audible at any level with markers, handy for animating to narration or music.
aescripts-power-null: Creates and positions nulls by clicking or dragging directly in the Composition Viewer, snapping live to layer edges, corners and Anchor Points, or one-click center placement. Selected layers parent to the new null instantly; selected Properties link to new or existing nulls, with independent controls for multiple properties of the same type. Optionally use a Shape Layer instead of a null, link Path Properties to control-layer masks, connect Source Text to Marker Comments, plus anchor centering, custom naming, dockable panel, keyboard mapping and KBar support.
Doesn't directly produce visuals; quickly places precisely snapped controllers at on-screen positions and wires layers or properties into a centrally operable rig
aescripts-maskshapeconverter: Bi-directional Mask/Shape conversion in AE: select layers with masks and create shapes; for the reverse, convert a shape to a Bezier Path first, then select the target layer last before executing. The new version supports path keyframes, Shape Merge settings and direct conversion of non-Bezier paths; shapes stay 3D when the source is a 3D layer, and Alt/Opt-click sets the generated shape as a Track Matte.
aescripts-super-lines: Quickly builds flowing line animations with instant experimentation — abstract line decorations and transition elements.
Clusters of curves flow and weave through the frame
aescripts-xoscillator-pro: Generates organic animation — heartbeats, bounces, layered ripples — with 30+ oscillation algorithms, no keyframing, and live waveform preview.
aescripts-flowers-bloom: A complete toolset for flower and shrub growth/bloom animation, with a built-in species database — natural-feeling decorative animation.
Flowers and branches gradually grow and bloom
aescripts-color-llama: Sets paired 'this color becomes that color' mappings to recolor — for brand colors or unifying footage from different cameras — and exports as a Cube LUT.
aescripts-tracker-solver: Reverse-infers 3D positions in camera space from a few position keyframes on a 2D layer — turning planar tracking results into volumetric placement.
aescripts-soundbox: Picks and adds sound effects directly inside AE — no digging through folders and dragging files — fast SFX for motion graphics.
aescripts-textexploder: Splits a text layer into separate layers by character, word or line, with each letter's original position precisely preserved — no expressions or animators.
aescripts-orbit-script: Adds orbiting motion to any layer with adjustable radius, speed, angle and optional facing-center — satellite orbits or circular arrangements.
Elements revolve around a center along circular orbits
aescripts-reveal-matte: Generates a mask along a moving object's path, erasing the layer below along the trail — handwriting or trajectory reveals.
The frame gradually appears along the object's moving trail
aescripts-the-positioner: Aligns and pins layers to comp or other-layer edges with auto-scaling, so layouts adjust as content changes — responsive layout made easy.
aescripts-photo-mosaic: Builds a frame from thousands of small photos (photo mosaic) — recognizable from afar, all tiny photos up close.
A big image is pieced together from countless small photos
aescripts-square-peg: Sets corner radii independently on the four corners of shape layers — UI components and asymmetric rounded shapes without hand-drawing paths.
aescripts-ae-3d-rig: Composed of six AE 3D helper scripts. Camera Rig centrally controls camera position, rotation, Zoom, Focal Length, built-in motion and Shake, with one-click Orthographic View switching; Light Rig builds Key/Fill/Back three-light rigs controllable as a group or individually, with color, direction and intensity, supporting Classic 3D and C4D Renderer. Element 3D Boilerplate auto-creates solids for unselected, image, text or mask layers and assigns Element 3D, Texture, Custom Text or Custom Mask. Background one-click builds a colorable 3D background; Z Stacker aligns by center or top, stacking selected layers along Z with spacing and Padding multipliers; Shape to Mask converts Shape Layers, creating per-group layers on Ctrl/Cmd-click.
Quickly builds a centrally controlled 3D camera, three-point light rig, clean background and Z-stacked layers, plus textures, text and mask sources for Element 3D
aescripts-superzoom: Auto-sorts, aligns, warps and comps multiple photos shot at different focal lengths into one cinematic continuous zoom toward the subject (Windows only).
Seamless push-in from a wide shot to a subject close-up
aescripts-camera-3d-toolkit-pro: One-click cinematic 3D camera moves with built-in parallax, autofocus, depth-of-field blur, camera shake and speed ramps.
Cinematic camera moves with depth of field and subtle shake
aescripts-linkup-pro: Opens a real browser panel inside AE with a built-in AI assistant and an AI Agent that can act directly on the project — no window switching for research.
aescripts-varifont: Enables Variable Fonts in AE — animate weight, width and other axis parameters directly.
aescripts-react: AE's version of C4D's clone + effector system — after duplicating layers, effectors drive property changes by ordering or falloff.
Array elements react in sequence across an effector's range
aescripts-longshadow: Specializes in long shadows with fine control over every aspect — the classic diagonal drop shadow of flat design and icon styles.
A graphic drags a long shadow diagonally behind it
aescripts-keyboardfx: Generates customizable physical and virtual keyboards with typing animation — great for tutorials and phone operation demos.
Keyboard keys light up one by one as typing progresses
aescripts-batch-shot: Batch-extracts PNG stills from video footage in AE with a percentage slider for frame selection and watermarking — fast thumbnails and proposal images.
aescripts-effect-matte: Adds an adjustable mask shape directly on a layer — no separate track matte layer — handy for subtitle bars and partial reveals.
aescripts-geometric-filter: Approximates video into geometric color blocks with a neighborhood-matching algorithm, cutting along contours and similar regions — AI-style transfer with a handcrafted feel.
The frame is broken into geometric color planes
aescripts-discotext: Applies the trim-paths concept to live text layers — trim, offset, stagger and duplicate text without converting to shape layers first.
aescripts-crossphere-bokeh: A lens blur plugin with fully adjustable bokeh shapes — any layer can be the bokeh shape — for cinematic defocus and dreamy bokeh.
Background highlights blur into beautiful bokeh balls
aescripts-contrastup: Enhances contrast on video or images with local and global algorithms, handling Shadows, Midtones and Highlights separately while keeping a natural look and avoiding flicker artifacts. GPU acceleration works live in AE and Premiere Pro, with CPU fallback when no suitable GPU is found; supports Multi-Frame Rendering and has been refined for natural histogram adjustments, 16-bit processing and temporal consistency.
Darks, midtones and highlights of flat or low-contrast footage each gain separation, with a natural, frame-stable contrast rather than a hard black/white clip
aescripts-aeviewer-pro: A media browser for AE/Premiere that previews projects and asset files and applies imports with one click; the Pro version adds packaging tools for template authors.
aescripts-super-3d: An extension panel for After Effects 24.1+'s native 3D: one-click GLB/GLTF model import, built-in 3D Primitives and Parametric Models with adjustable size, depth and Bevel; Extruder, Lathe and Tube Generators convert 2D shapes to 3D. Control each texture's Scale, Position, Rotation and material properties in-panel, create custom materials with adjustable Base Color, Metallic, Roughness and Normal Intensity; also replace models or textures on existing even-animated layers, duplicate materials, import GLTF Sequences, custom model/material libraries, and convert 3D layers to Solids for effects.
Builds or imports textureable 3D models right in AE, extruding or lathing flat vectors and generating tube geometry along paths, with PBR parameters for metal, roughness and normal detail
aescripts-chartist: Builds highly customizable bar and line charts with CSV import for hundreds of data points, direct value pasting, multiple lines and automatic dates; configurable grid, axis ticks, negatives, legends, RTL layout, rounded bar corners and gradients, line smoothing/fill/point markers. Bars can be built from Shapes, Comps, images, video or text, with images/video/Comps as textures. Animations grow from any direction with positional animation, and lines have three animation styles; the expression-free, keyframe-based architecture is driven by a single Master Comp and supports branded presets.
From clean business bar charts, smooth line and area charts to branded infographics using custom objects or image textures; multiple series, legends and RTL layouts supported
aescripts-nodekit: A complete system to create, lay out, connect and animate node-based diagrams — flowcharts, relationship webs and tech-style connection graphics.
Lines connect dots to form a network diagram
aescripts-draew: Captures the current Composition View as reference inside an AE panel and draws frame-by-frame with vector brushes, converted live into editable Shape Layers. Provides Onion Skin, pressure-sensitive Calligraphy, straight lines, Eraser, Simplify/Smooth, and live Stroke, Fill, Alpha settings; Frame Duration sets how many frames each drawing stays in the timeline. Output as a Shape Layer Stack with one layer per drawing, or merged into a single Shape Layer with per-frame keyframes; Automatic/Manual modes support draw-and-send, and Smart Jump & Grab advances the CTI by the set frame count, grabbing the next frame with consistent coordinates and comp size.
Draws editable vector strokes directly on the composition view with onion skin and per-frame hold times for hand-drawn animation, storyboards, annotations and animatics
aescripts-shy-bar: Shows, hides, selects and solos layers by type, property, state or time condition with one click — no manual AE native Shy setup. Filter text, shapes, precomps, audio, video, 3D, Missing Assets, and layers containing Masks, Effects, Expressions, Markers, Motion Blur or specific keyframe types; time conditions cover CTI, work area, comp start/end and identical in/out points. Seeker Sleuth searches layer names, effects, comments, markers, expressions and comp markers; a responsive interface offers multi-label colors, Track Mattes, Parents, keyframe navigation and customizable buttons.
Doesn't change the rendered frame; temporarily shrinks a big comp's timeline to only layers matching type, property, time, name or label conditions for focused inspection and editing
aescripts-circuitfx: Randomly generates circuit board graphics — traces, chips, resistors and capacitors — for tech backgrounds and HUD elements.
aescripts-tweaks: 30+ tools for Path, Shape and Layer work. Points/Paths increase path complexity, make rotating Tornados, Breeze and Swallower attract/repel deformations; Handy Particles build rain, star-bursts and more with custom Shapes. Shapes/Layers offer Magnetism, Repulsion, Layers Spinner, Drop Shadow control and Faux Depth with scaling, delay, falloff and distance blur. Spreaders dynamically arrange layers in rectangle, circle, spiral, cross, pyramid, X, hex/octagon patterns; Upward simulates hoisting objects with gravity, traction, rope rigidity, elasticity, wind, swing amplitude and damping. Also bakes Expressions to Keyframes, splits Shapes, creates grids and converts Primitives to Bezier Paths.
Creates shape devouring/repelling, tornado paths, custom-shape particles, magnetic scatter, faux-3D depth arrangements, geometric arrays and rope-swing hoisting physics
aescripts-voodoo: Creates Controller Handles for Puppet Pins that are easy to find, adjust and keyframe in the comp — no more expanding layers to hunt for pins. The unique Sequential Pin Parenting builds parent-child chains in order so the pin rig transfers Position, Scale, Rotation and even Skew precisely — from simple chains to complex character deformation control; a Toggle uniformly Shows/Hides Handles and controller size is adjustable. Official tutorials also cover Crop & Precomp, Reset, and note Element 3D compatibility.
Hard-to-manage Puppet Pins become visible control handles on screen, building puppet deformation rigs that chain position, rotation, scale and skew
aescripts-after-keying: Post-green-screen cleanup that rescues lost hair detail and adds one-click atmospheric depth to blend subjects into the scene.
aescripts-foxretimer: Applies AE's built-in Time Remapping curves to an entire composition, retiming layer Start Times, In/Out Points, existing keyframes and nested precomps together. Reverse full animations, mirror curves into exits, or loop with auto-duplication of layers and keyframes as needed; Retime Nested Layers creates corresponding curves for each nested layer, and Add Inbetween Keys adds keys at retiming nodes to better match the original curve. Due to Bezier math limits, complex curve reconstruction may vary slightly.
aescripts-foxreveal: One-click growth/reveal animation for complex graphic paths — line-drawing effects in seconds.
Lines and shapes gradually draw themselves along their paths
aescripts-deekay-tool: An AE character animation extension by Motion Design School and Deekay: one-click character creation and storage. The Rigging System provides an optimized rigging flow with flexible limbs; Assist centralizes common shape and animation tasks; Animate builds and customizes walks, runs, dances, jumps, swims, flights and more with intuitive controls. Also adds IK expressions to any three selected layers and builds Puppet Pins into controllers.
Quickly generates and adjusts character limb motions — walk, run, dance, jump, swim, fly — while keeping editable rig controls
aescripts-flowpath: An advanced tool for moving layers along motion paths — multi-path, multi-layer sync, loops and ping-pong, all expression-driven without baking keyframes.
aescripts-pixel-repeat: Repeats pixels cyclically in one direction, producing dragged streaks and glitch-art style frames.
Frame pixels are duplicated into long streaks
aescripts-fluid-map: Generates animatable fluid grayscale maps with three noise types — Directional, Swirl, Turbulence — each with adjustable XY displacement, noise scale, flow angle and intensity, plus looping animation, locally sharp streamlines, contrast and random seeds; colorize with Colorama or CC Toner.
Black-and-white fluid textures of directional flow, swirls or turbulence with locally sharp streamlines that loop seamlessly
aescripts-typemonkey-3d: The 3D extension for TypeMonkey — converts existing kinetic typography to a 3D version with one click (requires TypeMonkey).
Text flips and advances through 3D space
aescripts-modulation-2: Produces signal-modulated distortion with waveforms, color modes and an adjustable low-pass filter — for scanlines, analog interference and abstract glitch visuals.
The frame is cut by signal ripples, forming scanlines, color shifts and electronic interference
aescripts-blend-scatter: Blends or scatters nearly all AE properties across selected layers. Blend interpolates evenly between the top and bottom layers' values without changing endpoints; Scatter randomizes different results between the two end values, with Copy batch-duplicating a specified count first. Supports Position, Scale, angle, colors, effects, Time Remap, 3D and Layer Styles; Auto Select grabs the same properties for all selected layers, and animated source properties get matching keyframes — no expressions anywhere.
One set of layers' size, position, angle, color or effect values eases from first to last, or forms different random arrangements within a range each time
aescripts-sf-caddy: Load replacement assets into the panel, then click a button to switch to that item and add a keyframe on the timeline — ideal for marker-scheduled character lip sync; not limited to mouths — swap gestures, glasses or any asset. Supports replacing animated items inside precomps and reversing animations, with adjustable panel, button size, background color and button names.
Character mouth shapes, gestures, props or other replacement assets switch per time point frame by frame, creating lip-sync and pose-switch animation
aescripts-ae-global-renamer-2: Batch-renames Project items, layers, effects, text layer content, layer/composition markers, Expressions, and sub-items like Masks, Puppet Pins and Shape properties project-wide. Unlimited search/replace groups, Regex, prefixes/suffixes, case conversion, per-item or all-at-once application, duplicate-only handling, and sequence numbers with zero-padding and custom increments; naming rules can insert layer name/index/comments, comp names, project names, dates/times or ordinals, with presets saved, backed up and shared.
Doesn't change animation appearance; unifies naming across different item types in the whole AE project with one search/replace, prefix/suffix, field-template and sequence rule set
aescripts-pathprep: Batch-converts parametric shapes (rectangles, ellipses, etc.) to Bezier paths and bakes transforms — ready for editing or clean vector duplication.
aescripts-sliced-box: Quickly creates animated 3D sliced boxes — layered, offset, expanding box animations with built-in presets.
A cube is cut into several layers offset front and back
aescripts-essential-namer: Quickly adds common layer properties to the Essential Graphics panel with custom naming — handy when handing MOGRT templates to editors.
aescripts-splitgrid: Pick row/column counts and the comp is laid out into a split-screen grid automatically, dividers and shape layers included — fast multi-screen layouts.
The frame splits into a neat multi-panel grid
aescripts-neural-warp: Analyzes one layer's motion and warps another Source Layer to follow it — no manual tracking. Instant Mode maps the current Target Frame straight from a Reference Frame with Quality, Details and Confidence controls; Precomputation Mode analyzes the whole layer and builds temporally consistent deformation data, and Consistency keeps objects recognized even after brief occlusion at extra VRAM cost. Set a Neutral Reference Frame, Stiffness, Warp Resolution, Smooth Warping and Fix Borders; Draw Density shows high-match areas suitable for placing objects, and Overlay Grid checks full-frame distortion first. The precomputed Cache is only directly usable on the same machine — cross-machine renders must move the Cache along or recompute.
Graphics, textures or comp elements flexibly follow non-rigid motion in another clip, stretching naturally with people, cloth or surfaces instead of flat corner tracking
