aescripts-projection-3d: An advanced tool for camera-projection texture mapping and photo parallax animation — flat photos become camera-movable 3D scenes, plus 3D object conversion and one-click water.
A still photo becomes a 3D scene you can dolly and orbit through
aescripts-autocollapse: One click turns on Continuous Rasterization for every layer in the whole project (including deeply nested and locked comps) — fixing blurry scaled vector assets.
aescripts-mask-null: Auto-computes the center of a selected Mask and creates a live-linked Null — controlling the mask's position, scale, rotation and opacity via the null, keyframing the null to animate the mask. Bake unlinks and deletes the null; Shape creates a Shape Layer matching the original mask's shape and position with one click.
Masks move, scale, rotate and fade like ordinary layer controllers; bake away the null for delivery or convert to a matching shape layer
aescripts-text-at-marker: Triggers custom per-character, per-word or per-line text animations on Delay or Layer Markers, using directly editable Keyframes with Easing, Overshoot, Bounce or other Expressions — no complex Range Selectors. Numbers in markers specify how many characters animate each time, with Default, Reversed, Outwards, Inwards, Random and User Defined orderings numbered by layer name; ignore markers, respond only to specific prefixes, offset timing, stop at the last marker and stack multiple effects. Marker Utilities batch-create, rename, move, delete and evenly distribute Layer/Composition Markers within the work area; requires AE 2020+ with the JavaScript Expressions Engine.
Text enters character-, word-, line- or group-wise on marker rhythm — from both ends inward, center outward, reversed, random or custom order — for kinetic type, beats and narration sync
aescripts-cyclops: Includes AE nulls, motion paths and layer bounding boxes in the frame — behind-the-scenes process showcases or case-study sharing.
The production view with motion paths and layer outlines overlaid on the frame
aescripts-mask-layer-splitter: Separates every mask on a selected layer into its own layer; Shift duplicates, locks and tags the reference layer first, Shift+Ctrl/Cmd removes the reference after splitting. Also batch-renames per character or by a common base name with zero-padded sequence numbers, creates precomps cropped to content bounds, and staggers selected layer start times in ascending, descending or random order; KBar supported.
aescripts-crazy-shapes: A set of Shape/Mask Path rigging and animation tools. Use in-path Expressions for keyframe-free loops, controlling Squash & Stretch, Waves and Path Stretch with a few sliders; or semi-automatically add Path Delay, Elastic and other Secondary Actions following the primary motion. Supports five ways to link Path Points to nulls, resetting layer transforms and path coordinates, showing points, converting parametric shapes to paths, hiding unneeded internal groups and cleaning Expressions. One-click Bake to Keys when done, convenient for exporting web or app animations.
Existing vector illustrations gain waves, elastic delays, squash and stretch along paths and secondary wobble following the main motion — no extra effects or layer stacks
aescripts-edl-importer: Drag EDLs exported from Avid, DaVinci Resolve, Premiere and other NLEs into AE — source media is searched and linked automatically with exact timecodes and cut points maintained. Build a single sequence, per-shot compositions or a sequence with nested comps, with customizable composition specs and clip Handles; also imports EDL Markers, CDL data, Resolve pure-marker EDLs and Premiere CSV marker lists.
aescripts-matte-tool-2: Integrates 20 Matte and layer tools: build Merge, Subtract, Intersect and Exclude matte combinations with clear icons; one-click Precompose/De-compose; crop compositions, single layers or layer groups by current frame or work-area animation content; split objects with closed masks or rectangles with open cut lines, and separate independent parts within transparent layers. Also composes selected layers into a single image, removes green/blue screens and other colors with auto or manual color picking, creates two-point linear transparent gradients, dynamically reveals lower layers in Shape-defined areas, and Merge/Explode Shape, Explode Text, Explode Illustrator layers.
Quickly builds merge, subtract, intersect and exclude mattes between layers, or splits objects by masks/transparent regions; also green/blue screen keying, linear fade and animatable local reveals
aescripts-ai-relight-pro: Relights footage in post with AI — place unlimited AE lights with frame-stable results and swap an entire scene's lighting without reshooting.
Light added in post wraps naturally around object surfaces
aescripts-timemarker: Quickly adds custom Markers at the current time of the composition or selected layers, with Comment, Color, and Duration defined in milliseconds, seconds, frames or the total span of selected keyframes. Selecting keyframes creates Split Markers spanning their full range, auto-commenting with duration when empty; Composition Split Markers enable Adobe Responsive Design – Time's Protected Region so nested compositions don't drag internal keyframes when time-stretched — great for protecting intros and outros. Timestamps count from the Layer In Point, displayable in ms, seconds or frames, optionally as Guide Layers.
Doesn't change frame content; measures animation timing with colored, commented, span-markers and pins down selected keyframe segments when composition length changes
aescripts-super-liquids: Applies your own drawn liquid elements to static or moving objects, quickly producing frame-by-frame-style liquid trails. Create effects in horizontal or vertical orientation, and every result is made of Shape Layers with Shape Modifier support for further editing; custom and random colors are also supported, and liquid animation can be generated from a single selected layer.
Moving objects drag cartoon liquid, slime or splash trails with a frame-by-frame hand-drawn rhythm, still adjustable in shape and color inside AE
aescripts-keyless: Animates any property without keyframes, automatically applying Penner easing and controls — especially suited to MOGRT templates.
aescripts-vision: Uses AI to detect objects in the frame and draw tracking boxes with labels — surveillance frames, sci-fi HUDs and dystopian styles.
Moving objects are automatically boxed and labeled with text
aescripts-light-patterns: Generates animated light patterns (like stage-light gobos) with built-in controllable movement modes for atmospheric lighting.
Light patterns flow across walls and surfaces
aescripts-circle-rig-pro: Arranges layers into circular, radial or spiral arrays with effectors, loopable wiggle and time delays — ring carousel animation.
Elements arrange evenly around a circle and act in sequence
aescripts-quick-depth: A plugin that quickly estimates a depth map from any footage; the third generation adds cross-frame stability and quality improvements for depth-of-field, fog and fake 3D.
The frame turns into a black-and-white depth-layered map
aescripts-cell-division: Turns layer edges into transparent droplets that fuse and split, with 21 built-in styles — organic, gooey division effects.
Shape edges melt into droplets that stick together
aescripts-influx: An all-around import plugin letting AE/Premiere/AME natively read previously unsupported formats and codecs like MKV — no pre-conversion.
aescripts-cuttananir: A write-on animation toolkit that cuts text apart and writes it out segment by segment following stroke order.
Characters appear stroke by stroke as if written by hand
aescripts-expressionuniversalizer: Converts expressions in a project so they run in any language version of AE — fixing Chinese-version AE reporting errors on English-template expressions.
aescripts-slice-it-up: Procedurally and non-destructively slices a layer into strips — parameters stay editable after slicing — for slice transitions and split layouts.
The frame is cut into offset strips
aescripts-character-builder: Builds rigged character motions quickly from a character library without a separate Rigging Tool. Officially lists over 100 human characters (including religious figures like Jesus and the Virgin Mary), over 6 animal characters and 20+ handheld props; characters can switch between 6 viewing directions. Supports Duik Bassel-spec structures and handles characters built by other Rigging Systems; the trial offers one character only.
Quickly assembles human or animal characters viewable from six directions, with handheld props and ready-made rigs for explainer animation and character motion
aescripts-anchor-pro: One-click anchor movement to any layer position (including 3D layers, split dimensions and transform effects) — the essential step before rotation and scaling.
aescripts-moire: One-click moiré interference patterns in modern or retro styles, often used to boost the shoot-the-screen realism of CRT/VHS looks.
Fine interference ripples emerge over the frame
aescripts-loopy: Quickly creates Cycle, Ping Pong, Offset or Continue loops for keyframes, Paths, precomps and audio/video footage — choose loopIn, loopOut or both, restricting the range to specified keyframes. Process multiple layers, properties and even different types at once, set a Keyframe Modifier and preserve existing property expressions; Alt-clicking Cycle creates only Time Remap matching the trimmed length for cropped AV/pre-comp layers without loop expressions. Includes KBar 3 icons and import settings.
Keyframes or footage repeat seamlessly as replays, back-and-forth, accumulating cycles or continued speed; cropped clips and precomps can quickly become retimable assets
aescripts-automation-blocks: Composes your own one-click automation tools with a block-based interface — turning repetitive project workflows into single-button runs.
aescripts-smooth-rounder: Generates Shape Layers with smoother corners than AE's regular Ellipse or Rectangle rounding — superellipse-style modern UI icons. Ellipses and rounded rectangles control Width, Height and Roundness; rectangles add Corner Radius; every control takes Keyframes for directly animating curvature. Results remain standard Shape Layer objects, so Fill, Stroke, Dashes, Trim Path, Repeater and Zig Zag keep working natively.
From soft superellipses and squircles to curvature-continuous rounded rectangles; animating morphs smoothly between roundness levels, not just corner radius
aescripts-uber-key: When editing a Mask or Shape Path that has multiple existing keyframes, turn on Uber Key to adjust nodes or curves on the current frame, and turning it off applies the same edit to the remaining path keyframes; pre-selecting specific keyframes updates only that range.
aescripts-ae-camera-morph: Builds a Morph Rig between all or selected AE Cameras in ascending or descending order, interpolating any AE camera parameter and chaining multiple cameras; spatial motion can be Linear or an adjustable Bezier Path. The Morph button creates or updates the whole rig with one click, supporting single-node and parented cameras.
Multiple cameras' views and parameters fuse continuously; the camera can travel seamlessly along straight or adjustable bezier trajectories
aescripts-ae-flame: Generates keyframable Fractal Flame math patterns inside AE, applied from Effect → Render → AEFlame. This version is a direct CS4/CS5 port of Andrew Davidson's original open-source plugin — officially flagged as not widely tested, beta-quality and unsupported; compatibility lists only CS3–CS6.
Multi-layered symmetric, swirling colorful fractal textures with a fiery feel, animatable into abstract energy flows
aescripts-ae-purger: Clears AE cache and memory from a simple panel — handy before previews acting up, long sessions or renders to free resources quickly.
aescripts-ae-voice-recorder: Records voice and audio directly inside After Effects — for narration, temp voice, notes and client comments.
aescripts-aeinfographics: Creates animated charts with live previews from connected spreadsheets or manual data — data visualization and infographic videos.
aescripts-aep-to-mogrt: Batch-adds properties to the Essential Graphics panel and outputs multiple MOGRTs — mass production and organization of motion graphics templates.
aescripts-aep-version-updater: Opens, saves and closes multiple AEPs in sequence, updating files to the currently installed AE version; handles files, whole folders and subfolders, skipping items updated within the last seven days after interruption, overwriting originals or creating new files with a custom suffix. Detects corrupt, too-old or overlong-path items and writes a TXT Log; the Stubborn Item List reveals, force-updates or renames problem files. TurboMatic Renaming temporarily renames non-latest-numbered versions, Auto-Save and _AME AEPs to .aep-old to shorten the queue — officially not recommended for asset libraries.
aescripts-aepipeline: Auto-builds VFX shots, versions, renders and matte workflows — reducing repetitive setup and naming mistakes.
aescripts-aetogsap: Exports AE animations into web-ready GSAP format — for interactive sites, product pages and front-end motion.
aescripts-ai-depth-of-field: Uses AI to understand the spatial layout of a shot and applies depth-consistent Bokeh Blur in post; blur only the background, only the foreground, or both, with five Blur Settings shaping different depth looks. Supports Windows, Apple Silicon Macs, and After Effects/Premiere Pro. The official page doesn't claim standalone Depth Map output.
The subject stays sharp while foreground or background gradually defocus into natural bokeh by scene depth
aescripts-aiimagegen: Connects to Replicate from inside AE to generate images from text, reference images or composition screenshots — concept art and asset iteration.
aescripts-aivideogen: Generates footage directly from AE by connecting to Replicate's multiple video models — concept animation, fill shots and AI asset production.
aescripts-align-3d: Quickly aligns and evenly distributes layers in 3D space — for organizing 3D typography, card arrays and depth scenes.
aescripts-align-to-path: Attaches one or more layers to single or multiple unanimated Mask Paths, preserving the current Position Offset and auto-orienting along the path. Motion Path Completion walks layers through all paths in alphabetical order, or blends contributions via each path's own 0–100 slider; editing the original Mask and pressing Update recomputes positions while keeping existing keyframes. The tool creates a locked, hidden, Shy null per path; Mask Layer Scale/Rotation does not reflect onto the path.
aescripts-alignlayers: Quickly aligns selected layers along the X, Y or Z axes — for organizing 2D layouts and object positions in 3D scenes.
aescripts-am-dropdown-effect-helper: Automates Dropdown Menu Control creation and option management — for quickly building switchable-state templates and rigs.
aescripts-am-pins-to-corner: One click places the four control points of Corner Pin and Power Pin at the composition's corners — the starting point for screen replacements and perspective matching.
aescripts-am-select-and-set: Filters the timeline by 10 layer types and 19 properties — name, index, label, blend mode, 3D, visibility and more — with all-or-any matching and restriction to image/video types. After selection, batch-rewrite allowed layer properties; Shift preserves and adds to existing selection, Alt/Option inverts the current comp's selection.
aescripts-am-typewrite-text-2: Adds a typewriter effect to new or existing text layers with one click, controlling and keyframing cursor, blink speed, text color and cursor color via a Pseudo Effect in Effect Controls. Supports multi-line text and right-to-left languages; multi-line RTL text currently builds cursor-less versions only, and text-color keyframes need After Effects 17.0+.
Text appears character by character with optional custom cursor, blink rhythm and text/cursor color changes — for dialogue, subtitles and terminal-style typing
aescripts-anchor-point-gravity: Processes AE layers by planar position, depth and gravity relationships. Anchor Point Mode moves the anchor to a specified position or depth; Position Mode moves the layer's Position while keeping the anchor's on-screen or depth display position unchanged. Extrusion Depth can be included, and Extents fetches layer rectangle bounds to correct content. Gravity Mode adds a Parent Null to selected layers, with an Expression deciding whether children rotate with the parent when it turns.
aescripts-anchor-sniper: Moves anchors quickly to 9 fixed targets or custom targets with 20+ positioning combinations; processes multiple layers individually or as a group without disturbing existing animation. True Alpha scanning factors in transparency from masks and effects, positioning by visible pixel bounds; also includes tools for creating a parent null at the target, splitting multiple masks on one layer into their own layers, and precomposing plus cropping to visible range. Supports bitmap, vector, text, shape, video and AE 3D layers.
Doesn't directly alter the visual design; places rotation, scale and rig pivots precisely on layer/group corners, edges, centers, custom points or true opaque bounds
aescripts-animated-textblock: Creates dynamic text blocks holding a specified width, scaling different content to fit the box width, with animatable Tracking, left/right alignment and vertical anchoring; supports pre-formatted text, color linked to text size, and centralized Pseudo Effect controls.
Each line of text keeps a consistent block width, dynamically animatable between tracking, left/right alignment and vertical position
aescripts-animation-stopwatch: Helps animators record and plan timing in frames rather than timecode — for pose blocking, rhythm tests and motion breakdown.
aescripts-animationpatternspro: Stores editable easing types as Animation Patterns and applies them to selected keyframes with one click; frames can still be moved or values changed and re-interpolated, and editing the Pattern itself updates every animation referencing it. Supports multiple Pattern Layers, project-wide sharing, curved motion paths, creating Patterns by copying from existing motion, and Bake/Unbake. Cannot apply to Shape Properties that don't support Expressions, Masks etc., and replaces any existing expression on the property.
aescripts-animography-controller: Manages Animography kinetic-font characters from a single control layer — unified color, timing and style adjustments for text animation.
aescripts-anonymizer: Auto-detects and replaces people's faces with AI random faces, blur or pixelation — for news, documentaries and privacy protection.
aescripts-anytex: Turns complex LaTeX formulas into handwriting animations inside AE — for educational videos, science explainers and technical presentations.
aescripts-ap-batch-relinker: Batch-relinks missing footage from a new source root folder, ignoring special-character differences — for project moves and server path updates.
aescripts-arabictext: Correctly types right-to-left Arabic text with ligature forms in AE — for Arabic subtitles, titles and localization.
aescripts-arc: Quickly sets Ease In/Out on selected keyframes with a single Influence slider — adjust one side only, zero the other, or make it Linear — with keyboard modifiers for mode switching and HUD confirmation. Vertical Mode slows the middle of the curve; Clone/Paste pastes Ease In, Ease Out, both-sided easing or frame values only, accounting for different target values while preserving the curve's relative direction.
aescripts-arrange-project-items-into-fol: Asks for a delimiter character, then auto-creates folders from the common prefix before the delimiter in Project Item names and files items accordingly — e.g. Hero_Diffuse, Hero_Reflection and Bg_Shadow with an underscore delimiter go into Hero and Bg folders respectively.
aescripts-array: Mass-duplicates layers with a specified copy count and per-copy offsets; or offsets the basic properties of selected layers sequentially without creating copies. Also offers basic-property randomization, copy renaming and input validation, running as a dockable panel or a floating window that scales with group expansion.
Quickly forms repeating layer arrays with per-copy increments or random variance in position, scale, rotation and other basic properties
aescripts-arsfader: Controls audio layer Volume and left/right Panning live from the panel without expanding Layer Options or opening the Effects Panel; change all track volumes at once, create Fade In/Fade Out with Markers, and change volume and pan smoothly with buttons.
aescripts-ascii-generator: Converts any text layer into retro ASCII character art — for terminal screens, hacker interfaces and text-based images.
aescripts-ash-syntax-highlighter: Adds code-editor-style syntax highlighting to AE text layers — for FUI, tutorial videos and tech visuals.
aescripts-audioamptovideospeed: Speeds up and slows down video based on an Audio Amplitude layer — music-reactive edits, beat speed changes and dynamic loops.
aescripts-audiotomarkers: Adds markers, splits layers or creates incrementing text based on audio intensity — beat editing, subtitle cues and music sync.
aescripts-auto-audio-mixer: Automatically mixes audio layers of the Active Composition, handling each layer's In/Out Points with two Mixing Options, scoped to the whole Composition or Work Area. Recursively processes nested Comps, extends leftover audio to bridge the next layer or fill the duration, creates transitions between layers, disables interfering sounds, and can skip specified audio by Tag. Sets a minimum volume with Linear, Bezier or Easy Ease interpolation and includes nine AE Audio Effects: High/Low Pass, Reverb, Bass/Treble, Flanger, Chorus and more.
aescripts-auto-backup: When saving an AE project via script, first renames the existing project file to `original.aep.old` as the previous version, then writes the current version — a quick fallback when files corrupt or unstable effects cause trouble. It covers the native Auto-Save gap: every manual Save resets Auto-Save's timer, so frequent saving can leave only stale auto-backups. This is a simple previous-version mechanism, not a full multi-version manager.
aescripts-auto-lip-sync: Analyzes voice recordings and auto-deforms a single mouth image — no phoneme mouth sets or manual keyframes; a step-by-step wizard builds the setup, then auto-adds teeth and tongue animation, with sliders for mouth opening amplitude, deformation amount and open/closed mouth shapes, plus markers for spots needing closer O-shaped mouths. Language-independent, and works for moving characters or objects too.
The mouth opens and closes continuously with volume and speech rhythm, with emphasized round O mouths where needed, plus teeth and tongue motion
aescripts-auto-savior: Offers three ways to protect AE projects: timed saves of the original .aep only, one updated copy per day, or multiple incremental versions per settings. Decide copy count and interval, overwrite or keep history, move oldest files to a Backup Folder or delete them when the limit is reached, and store beside the project or at a custom location; also supports auto-start on boot, immediate save, and pausing unnecessary copies when the project hasn't changed for a minute.
aescripts-auto-transition-builder: Applies different transitions automatically to unlimited layers with 100+ built-in transitions; add custom transitions with Smart Resize, create unlimited Packs, Folders and Presets, and save favorite transition sets for reload next time. Besides Auto Editing, click-to-preview also adds a chosen transition manually with one click.
Many cut points get different dynamic transitions applied fast, with custom transitions auto-fitting the frame size
aescripts-automate-to-sequence: Sets selected layers' in/out points by markers and arranges them on the timeline — photo sequences, beat edits and batch layouts.
aescripts-automated-video-editing: Automatically completes video edits and shot sync to music — event highlights, social clips and quick music montages.
aescripts-automatic-whiteboard: Converts AE text and masks into handwriting animations that can pair with hands with one click — whiteboard explainers, tutorials and process videos.
aescripts-automation-toolkit-pro: Creates panel buttons that run custom functions — for integrating repetitive commands, scripts and workflows into dedicated toolbars.
aescripts-automatte: Batch-splits RGB multimattes into precomps each with transparent backgrounds — for 3D render object masks and per-layer color grading.
aescripts-autoorientcamera: Creates a camera with position, orientation and point-of-interest keyframes so the lens faces each layer in the composition in sequence.
aescripts-autostereogram: Generates animatable autostereograms in AE — for Magic Eye hidden images, depth perception visuals and experimental animation.
aescripts-aw-autosaver: Replaces AE's built-in autosave with more options — custom backup frequency, locations and version-retention strategies.
aescripts-baconizer-for-ae: A free fun plugin by illo whose interface core is a single large button; officially it only claims that pressing it makes boring compositions 'crispier', with a Grill Sound. The product page doesn't disclose which properties or algorithms it actually modifies, so it's not described as a random animation tool.
aescripts-bake-parented-transform: Bakes motion caused by parent hierarchies into keyframes on unparented layers — for export, handoff and removing parent links.
aescripts-bao-distortion-selector: Precisely limits the area affected by Puppet, Liquify and other distortions with adjustable softness — for localized character reshaping and controlled warping.
aescripts-bao-dynamic-comp: Lets multiple AE projects share and update the same set of compositions — reusable intros, brand elements and cross-project templates.
aescripts-bao-joint: Binds a layer to two different parents and builds a deforming joint between them — elbows, knees and soft connections.
aescripts-bao-mask-3d-warper: Uses masks for 3D sculpting and precise 2D distortion — character animation, flat-to-curved surfaces and pseudo-3D objects.
aescripts-bao-mask-brush: Applies custom brushes along mask paths in 3D space with motion blur and squash/stretch support — lines and character animation.
aescripts-batch-search-n-replace-paths: Batch-searches and replaces footage paths across multiple AEPs — for server changes, folder restructures and large project moves.
aescripts-batchprocessor: Batch-processes selected project items — uniform scaling and applying the same defaults — for standardizing large sets of videos and comps.
aescripts-beat-assistant: Analyzes musical beats and produces timing information usable for animation — beat sync, cut points and audio-reactive motion.
aescripts-beatnik: Converts musical rhythm into data controlling animation — logo pops, beat graphics and audio visualization.
aescripts-bendio: Bends bitmap, vector and Shape Layers with start/end points like CC Bend It, but without native effect clipping limits. Set Attach Points on the bent surface and generate nulls that follow the deformation, for wiring other layers into character parenting chains; regions beyond the bend range stay rigid, and continuously-rasterized layers can use Convert To Mask first for a tighter fit.
Layers bend smoothly across a specified segment while both ends outside the bend stay straight; attached objects move with the curved surface
aescripts-bezier-node: Draws Bezier lines between two points A and B ranging from straight to highly curved, with handles auto-updating as endpoints move; bend along X or Y, adjust each end's curvature separately, and use symmetric, multi-line, gradient, Trim Paths, dashed lines and different endpoints. Also includes Arc and Pipe modes with automatic null controllers.
Smooth, animatable curves, arcs or pipes between two points, with multi-line symmetry, dashes and gradient connections
aescripts-bg-generator: Randomly generates a huge number of background combinations from built-in or your own shapes, with ready-made motion, shadows, blur, glow and bevel effects; also set built-in Wiggle, Time and other expressions, or add custom shapes, effects and expressions.
Animatable backgrounds made of many random shapes, stackable with shadows, soft focus, glow and dimensional bevels
aescripts-braw-studio-v3: Imports and adjusts Blackmagic RAW footage natively in After Effects — BRAW editing, decoding and color settings.
aescripts-cartoon-moblur: Generates flatter, more cartoonish trails or smears than native Motion Blur based on Transform animation; Shutter Angle controls length, with solid color or Gradient Ramp options and Opacity Samples quality adjustment. Supports 2D/3D transforms, Parent animation and Bezier motion paths, plus alternative motion sources and adjustment layers affecting all layers below.
Tight solid-color or gradient cartoon trails pulled along the motion direction, like the speed smears of frame-by-frame animation
aescripts-circle-slicer: Quickly slices content in a 1:1 square composition into circular radial segments; place footage in the square comp, pick a slice button and run — the Make by Shape mode builds an adjustable controller.
The same frame is cut into fan-shaped segments arranged around a center — for pie charts, turntables or radial transitions
aescripts-clearplus: Improves foggy, underwater, low-light night and sky footage with dehaze, white balance, shadows/highlights and advanced histogram equalization; recovers darks, lifts contrast and keeps natural balance, with advanced dehaze reducing halos and advanced contrast/histogram modes reducing flicker. GPU-accelerated and works in After Effects/Premiere Pro.
Fog is reduced and shadow detail restored, underwater color cast turns natural, and skies and overall color become more vivid
aescripts-clipferry: Moves layer data between After Effects projects or workstations via the clipboard — for reusing animated elements.
aescripts-cliptoae: Imports Clip Studio Paint animations directly into After Effects, preserving the original project's layers, timing, folder structure and opacity — no need to export image sequences or manage hundreds of intermediate files; perfect for bringing 2D frame-by-frame animation into AE for post compositing, and work can continue when source drawings update.
aescripts-cloners-effectors: Procedurally drives large numbers of 2D/3D layers simultaneously with Cloners, Effectors and Falloff — no per-layer keyframing. Arrange with Linear, Radial, Grid, Cluster, Path or Path Point modes, control position, scale, color and any numeric/color property through seven Effector types, and limit the affected area with draggable Falloff; also supports audio spectrum setups, cloning systems and baked animation.
Many layers form procedural arrays in linear, radial, grid, cluster or path arrangements, with animation swept across by falloff fields
aescripts-codependencies: Moves or copies source assets outside the project directory to a specified location, auto-relinking AE project items to the new files; also analyzes multiple AE projects to build lists of actually-used assets, then removes unused files in a specified directory. Can process only selected items, relink to existing files, remove Proxy links, preserve AE folder hierarchies, and skip assets by extension, path character or file size.
aescripts-collage-pro: Creates continuously adjustable horizontal or vertical collages in AE. Easy Collage auto-splits items into equal-sized rows for quick tidy layouts; Advanced Collage customizes items per row, row and item sizes, ordering and gaps, adding/removing or moving single items and whole rows. Layout is managed non-destructively by a controller with built-in Transform and Delay animations, Shrink/Expand, Freeze/Bake, and can convert to a Static Collage for fully manual editing. Supports Footage and Precomps; items can be positioned/scaled independently inside their frames with a Transform Effect without breaking the overall layout.
Tidy photo grids, editorial collages of mixed sizes, mood boards, social layouts and dynamic slideshows; items or whole rows shrink, expand and move in delayed sequence
aescripts-colloid-animated-typeface: Animography's frame-by-frame animated typeface designed by Oi Vaidas; each capital letter forms from two colored liquids meeting, with hand-drawn droplets and fine splatters, and each character has a different duration so typesetting produces an irregular flowing rhythm. The whole set is vector and scales losslessly; two colors are changeable with three edge styles — Smooth, Rough, Looping Wiggle. Includes A–Z, 0–9, common punctuation, JSX and an organized AEP, controlled via Font Manager for size, tracking, leading, alignment and Time Offset.
Two-color liquids assemble into capital letters frame by frame like ink or slime, with hand-drawn droplets; edges can be smooth, rough or continuously wiggling
aescripts-color-cone: Grades and designs looks with the HCL color model visualized as a double cone; each control point sets a source color, target color and influence radius — small radii precisely recolor, large radii shape the whole atmosphere, and Auto-Radius prevents overlapping points from cancelling out. Its own Color Warp technology keeps large color shifts smooth even in 8-bit footage, and it can harmonize white balance mixing, restore and fine-tune skin tones, animate parameters and export LUTs.
Shapes smooth grading styles with local color picking or wide color mapping, restoring natural skin tones even after large color shifts
aescripts-colour-scheme-generator: Creates five harmonizing, adjustable swatches from the current image; enable or disable palettes, make small corrections with Gamma, and swap Random Seeds to regenerate schemes.
Five coordinated color-block palettes extend from a source image
aescripts-comp-buddy: Simplifies the VFX compositing staples Edge Blur and Light Wrap into one-click operations. Edge Width controls how far the alpha boundary is softened — ideal for removing overly sharp CG renders, also on Text, Shape Layers or any layer with alpha; Light Wrap lets background light color bleed in along the foreground silhouette, helping live action, CG, text or graphics blend naturally into one frame.
Foreground silhouettes no longer look like hard cutouts; edges gently soften and pick up background brightness and color, forming natural light wrapping
aescripts-compcode: Converts selected Compositions or Layers into directly executable After Effects JSX that rebuilds the original design — no coding, output compatible at least back to CS6. Use `//value`, `text:`, `file:` and `name:` Tokens to ask users for values, text, replacement footage and names at runtime, and choose to create a new Comp or apply into the current one, reusing existing Project Items. Includes compPack, which packages multiple scripts into a standalone tool panel with search, branding image and info button preserving the original folder structure. Limited by the AE Scripting API — no Master Properties, some custom data, Gradients, Paint, Rotobrush, Puppet Pins or multi-text styles.
aescripts-compound-matte: Lets a single source layer use an unlimited number of matte layers at once, each combined via Merge, Subtract, Intersect or Exclude. Provides Quick and Complex engines with automatic detection/switching, supports layer opacity and layer effects, and doesn't use Set Matte — in many cases it can replace AE's built-in Track Matte.
aescripts-control-maker: Picks Illustrator icons from built-in or custom folders and imports them as Shape Layer controllers; name and create controllers per selected layer, adjust fill and stroke, Shift creates a single controller at the center of multiple layers, or build controllers for selected Puppet Pins connected by expressions to the matching control layers.
aescripts-copy-paste-markers-2: Fills the gap where AE's interface can't directly copy-paste layer Markers — copies one or more markers to any other layer. Scope can be limited to the marker at the current time, all markers across the composition length, the Work Area, or before/after the playhead — for transferring rhythm points, comments and cues between layers.
aescripts-copymask2layer: Transfers masks from one 2D layer to another while keeping the mask's exact on-screen position; works even when source or target layers are moving, scaling or otherwise transforming, or when mask paths already have keyframes. Version 2 has native RotoBezier mask support.
aescripts-bento: Quickly builds Bento grids with adjustable rows, columns, gaps, corner radii and random sizes, converting cells into masked precomps for multi-screen layouts.
Bento-box-style multi-panel frames with varied sizes and consistent gaps
aescripts-block-swap: Cuts the image into blocks and swaps them randomly, excluding specified areas or mixing in frames from other times — block glitches, scene reassembly and transitions.
Frame blocks are randomly swapped and reassembled
aescripts-borderpatrol: Maintains stroke width and rounded-corner appearance when resizing parametric or Bezier shape layers — precise resizing of icons, UI components and layouts.
aescripts-boringdashes: Creates and controls Shape dashed strokes more simply and efficiently — route maps, infographics and flowing line animations.
Dashes arranged regularly along a path, animatable
aescripts-break-it: Cuts images or objects into animatable shattering fragments — no other plugins needed. Specify Break Sections, draw break locations with Masks, and control each event's timing with Markers; repeat breaking at multiple locations, and adjust Explosion Wave, Force Direction/Intensity, Viscosity, Gravity, particle size and count, and Shatter Spacing per section or fragment. Includes 20+ break patterns, Extrusion Depth for fragment thickness, and foreground/back image insertion so objects reveal interior imagery when cracked open.

Objects explode from specified mask positions by directional force, fragments falling under gravity and viscosity; extrusion depth gives dimensional cross-sections, and collapse can continue at multiple time points
aescripts-bvh-importer: Parses BVH joint skeletons and motion data into AE skeleton animation made of Solids/Nulls — for motion capture and character rigging.
aescripts-cadence: Uses WhisperX to analyze narration and automatically places markers on each word's exact frame — syncing motion graphics word-by-word to speech.
aescripts-colorx: Precisely adjusts hue, saturation, brightness and density for specified colors simultaneously — selective color grading for AE and Premiere.
Only the specified color range changes while the rest of the frame is preserved
aescripts-command-frame: Searches and executes layer, effect, preset, toolbar and script operations from a floating command bar — chaining common AE commands and assigning shortcuts quickly.
aescripts-conform-studio: Integrates precomposing, batch renaming, cropping, extraction and replacing comps with render files to automate VFX conform workflows.
aescripts-cornerpinner: Centrally adds, converts, creates mattes from, rounds, inverts, rotates and precomposes Corner Pins — simplifying screen replacement and perspective matching.
aescripts-credits-are-due: Builds auto-fitting, easily editable end-credit scrolling layouts — for movies, shows and event videos' credits lists.
aescripts-bookmarker: Saves common AE projects as shareable bookmarks usable across computers — one-click opening for templates, tool projects and recent work.
aescripts-breeze: Quickly creates natural wave and wind-sway animation — looping dynamics for flags, hair, plants and soft objects.
Objects undulate softly along a path as if blown by wind
aescripts-btnhook: Converts UI buttons in script panels into callable shortcut operations — functions that normally require clicking can run from the keyboard.
aescripts-calc-ae: Performs timecode and duration calculations inside AE based on the current composition's frame rate — no manual frame/second/common-time conversions.
aescripts-camera-instancer: Creates camera instances in other compositions that follow the source composition's active camera — synced moves and camera switching across comps.
aescripts-carousel-xpress: One-click carousels in linear, 2D circle, 3D circle, exponential or path arrangements — product showcases and card interface animations.
Multiple items showcase in turn along a line, ring or custom path
aescripts-ci-layer-stripper: Automatically removes invisible and unnecessary layers from a project — streamlining delivery files and reducing management burden on large projects.
aescripts-ci-master-thumbnailer: Batch-generates thumbnails for compositions, layers and video footage — visual indexes, shot selection and organizing large AE projects.
aescripts-ci-move-anchor: Repositions layer anchors while preserving existing animated motion paths — moving the pivot without breaking position animation.
aescripts-cineware-proxy: Quickly switches between CINEWARE connections and pre-rendered proxies in Cinema 4D/AE real-time 3D workflows — balancing edit flexibility and preview speed.
aescripts-coco-color-coworker: Centrally creates and manages color schemes and swatches in AE — brand colors, design systems and color consistency across multi-comp projects.
aescripts-construction: Quickly builds cities and 3D buildings in After Effects — urban scenes, building growth and information visualization backgrounds.
A city street scene made of controllable building volumes
aescripts-counter-pro: Creates dynamically updating number counting animations — statistics, amounts, mileage, countdowns and infographics.
Numbers update smoothly — counting up, down or ticking by settings
aescripts-create-pivotal-null: Quickly creates nulls at key layer positions with automatic parenting — new rotation pivots, controllers and temporary bindings.
aescripts-create-trimmed-adjustment-laye: Creates and trims an Adjustment Layer or Null to selected layers' time ranges — no manual In/Out point alignment.
aescripts-create3dshapes: Builds 3D boxes, spheres, cylinders, pyramids, Menger sponges, polyhedra and domino scenes quickly from user layers.
Flat layers assemble into manipulable 3D geometric objects
aescripts-createproxies: Batch-creates proxies for each selected footage or composition project item — better previews and efficiency on large projects.
aescripts-character-swing-rigging: Quickly builds advanced secondary swing for hair, clothing, fur, ears, tongues and more — less manual follow-through and inertia animation.
Character appendages swing naturally with delayed follow on the main motion
aescripts-candlecharts-ae: Builds fully customizable candlestick financial charts quickly in AE — finance videos, stock analysis and data animation.
Red and green candlesticks with price trends generate dynamically along the timeline
aescripts-crossframe: Adapts one master composition live to 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 and other aspect ratios — less duplicate design for social and multi-platform versions.
aescripts-cult-translator: Batch-translates text layers with context-aware AI directly inside AE, preserving formatting — mass video localization and multi-language versions.
aescripts-curl-the-path: Quickly creates curling and uncurling animations on AE paths — lines, decorative graphics, vines and hand-drawn path motion.
Line ends curl into spirals along the path and unwind
aescripts-cursorkit: Quickly builds animated cursor elements — cutting repetitive mouse work in UI prototypes, product demo videos and software tutorials.
Customizable mouse cursors with click or movement animations
aescripts-deep-comp: Expands, navigates and live-edits any nested precomp from the master composition, seeing main-frame feedback directly as you modify.
aescripts-deepclear: Uses AI to enhance video detail, reduce noise and improve contrast — quality restoration for low-light, high-ISO or compressed footage.
Noise is reduced while edges and textures become clearer
aescripts-distributelayers: Evenly distributes selected layers into AE 3D space — quick Z-depth layers, card arrays and depth scenes.
aescripts-divide-and-corner: Splits layers into multiple layers, masks or shapes with custom corners and tiling controls — multi-panel frames and dynamic layouts.
A single frame is cut into independently animatable tiled blocks
aescripts-drag-zoom-pro-for-adobe-after-: Draw a box over the frame to create a zoom with automatic keyframes — quick tutorial close-ups, emphasis zooms and push-ins.
aescripts-dresser: Centrally edits, applies and stores AE layer styles, browsing presets via custom thumbnails — less repetitive clicking and style management time.
aescripts-drive: Drives one layer property with another — position controlling rotation, scale controlling particle rate, etc. — quick parameter linking.
aescripts-drop-and-slide: Builds dropdown menus controlling layers, time remapping and source text, with sliders to switch options — for MOGRTs and template binding.
aescripts-duckflow: Automatically ducks other system audio while AE/Premiere play on Windows, restoring after the timeline stops — no background music interfering with reviews.
aescripts-dupli-kit: Mass-duplicates layers by pattern with control over count, random properties, anchors, label colors and arrangement — procedural arrays and group animation.
aescripts-e3d-mografter-fx: Brings Cinema 4D MoGraph-style Cloner, Fracture and MoText workflows into Element 3D — procedural 3D motion graphics.
Many 3D objects arranged and animated via cloners and effectors
aescripts-ease-stash: Stores keyframe selections with easing into slots for one-click reuse across compositions — consistent animation rhythm everywhere.
aescripts-easy-bake: Bakes expression results into keyframes faster and more controllably than AE's built-in flow — delivery, fine-tuning and dependency removal.
aescripts-easy-bounce: Auto-generates natural bounce and rebound rhythm from a roughly set motion path — quick landings, arcs and object rebound animation.
Objects fall along the path and bounce with decreasing amplitude
aescripts-centermasks: Repositions selected masks to the center of their layers — tidying offset masks, resetting animation bases and batch alignment.
aescripts-croproi: Crops precomp size by Region of Interest while keeping layer positions within the parent comp — no manual coordinate compensation.
aescripts-dividelayers: Evenly staggers selected layers by the current composition time, from their In or Out points — quick sequential timing animation.
aescripts-duplicate-with-connections: Duplicates layers and links all properties of the copies back to the original via expressions — master-synced variants.
aescripts-e-utilities: A collection of Element 3D automation tools — simplifying common setups, scene management and repetitive AE/Element operations.
aescripts-ease-sync: Syncs keyframe easing settings across multiple animations — consistent speed rhythm across different properties and layers.
aescripts-easy-arrows: Auto-orients arrows or other graphics along path direction — flowcharts, map routes and moving-direction animation.
Arrows advance along curves, always facing the path tangent
aescripts-easy-rounder: Controls shape corner rounding dynamically as a percentage rather than fixed pixels — consistent corner proportions across different sizes.
aescripts-easyshape-fx: Adds common visual effects to selected shape layers with one click — quick motion-graphics style experimentation and design variations.
aescripts-elastic-comp-changer: Synchronously changes the duration of compositions, layers and nested precomps, optionally offsetting keyframes — lengthen or shorten whole projects.
aescripts-elementary: Helps integrate various 3D plugins with AE layers — complex 3D animation, shadows and reflections, bridging plugin and native comp workflows.
aescripts-evil-twin-stereo-3d: Extends the normal 2D AE workflow into stereo 3D production — building and managing left/right eye versions without sacrificing existing functionality.
Stereo output with left-right eye parallax
aescripts-express-table: Generates animatable tables in AE from CSV data, with an improved table template workflow — data visualization and infographics.
A table auto-filled from CSV, animatable row by row
aescripts-expression-calculator: Computes the numeric difference of a property before and after applying an expression — designing smart AE templates that compensate offsets or control results precisely.
aescripts-expressionist: Adds syntax highlighting, line numbers, multi-cursor and inline error hints to AE expression workflows — apply expressions to multiple properties quickly.
aescripts-exte: Creates animatable extension lines from two specified points on a shape path — callouts, annotations and outward-growing lines.
