installed-chromabba: Free: quick chromatic aberration / dispersion that offsets the RGB channels for lens character or light glitch.
installed-vectory: Dynamic line-particle animation plugin: connects moving points / particles with lines to create tech-style connection networks (line-based, similar to Plexus).
installed-hydrochrome: Generates abstract flowing background animations: smoothly flowing liquid color backgrounds for backgrounds and atmosphere.
installed-nebulosity: 3D volumetric nebula / smoke effect: generates nebulas, space clouds, and smoke with volumetric depth.
installed-inkbloom: Color ink-bleed animation effect: ink spreads and blooms across the image; for sumi-e and ink-rendering transitions.
installed-bevelizer: 3D text bevel with material texture mapping: adds bevels and materials (metal, plastic, etc.) to text and shapes for dimensional titles.
installed-bang: 3D muzzle flash / sparks gunfire effect (file name qpBang); for shooting VFX.
installed-potok: Fluid gradient coloring effect animation: liquid flowing gradient colors for abstract flowing backgrounds / coloring (Potok means 'flow' in Russian).
installed-glasswork: Realistic glass refraction effect: simulates refractive distortion and texture as if seen through glass (works in AE and Pr).
installed-diopter: Light-refraction blur and haze effect: soft focus with a refractive feel; for beautiful, dreamy atmospheres.
installed-f-s-colorchange: Legacy target-color replacement effect from F's Plugins; the author explicitly names the current ColorSwitch as the replacement. Locates color areas with the Old / source color, then replaces them with the New / target color; suited for local recolor fixes in cel animation compositing. The newer successor adds Replace, Key, and Extract and handles up to 32 colors at once. This entry refers to the old CS6 .aex, not the current ColorSwitch itself.
Selected flat color areas are cleanly replaced with another color while line art and unspecified colors stay intact; handy for quickly recolorizing animation assets.
installed-f-s-selectedblur: Legacy effect from F's Plugins that blurs only the regions matching a specified Target Color; the author states the current SelectiveColorBlur is its successor, about four times faster. Enable the target color and adjust Blur without drawing masks; suited for softening cel color areas, localized textures, or specific color regions. This entry keeps the old CS6 .aex name for scanning existing installs.
Only the matching color areas are softened and diffused while other colors and lines stay sharp: blur limited to a color-based selection.
installed-olm-smoother: Free plugin released by OLM Digital (Japan) that smooths jagged line edges without blurring the image; made for scanned or hand-drawn line art.
Line art edges become smooth while detail stays sharp.
installed-olm-blur: Free blur plugin designed for cel animation: blurs the boundaries between color areas; combined with OLM Color Key it can blur only a specified color without masks.
Boundaries between cel color areas are softly blended.
installed-xcloner: Extremely fast cloner for any layer type, with path-based and object cloning for arrays / group animations.
Many neatly arranged copies, or copies distributed along a path.
installed-l3tt3rm4pp3r2: Plugin that maps footage into character art (ASCII art / textmode); the second generation rebuilt the interface and ships with textmode presets.
The image is composed of grid cells of text characters.
installed-textbox-2: Native plugin that generates a perfectly sized, customizable shape background behind text, auto-updating with the text; applies directly to the text layer, no parenting, masks, or expressions needed.
A fitted color box behind the text.
installed-textborder: Generates a perfectly sized, customizable border around text that auto-updates with the text content.
A fitted border hugging the text.
installed-textdelay: Native plugin that staggers text animation by character, word, or line; unlike the built-in animator, it inherits your easing curves.
Text appears in relay by character or line.
installed-multislicer: Cuts objects into multiple pieces with random displacement; slice count controls split density, for striped misalignment, digital glitch, and shard-like motion.
The image is cut into pieces that are randomly offset.
installed-pixelstretch: Organic, non-linear pixel stretching with sub-pixel precision, stretching along orthogonal directions driven by a luma curve or an input layer.
Pixels are organically stretched into long streaks.
installed-pixelextender: Extends edge pixels along a mask path to fill the frame or change aspect ratio.
Edge pixels are stretched to fill the frame.
installed-mosaicart: Advanced mosaic and tile filter that recomposes the image into collage / tile patterns.
The image composed of tile-like color blocks.
installed-curvetracer: Traces footage with contour lines, from pencil sketches to abstract outlines, for an organic hand-drawn feel.
Hand-drawn sketch made of contour lines.
installed-polytrace: Algorithmic triangulation plugin that turns the image into a low-poly style, fast even on complex input; mask points can act as triangulation control points.
The image is broken into triangular color facets.
recipes-d93560eb2a: Neon-outlined text with glitch displacement, chromatic aberration, and scanlines for a cyberpunk title.
recipes-e49079ee2c: Primary grade for exposure and white balance first, then teal-orange color, vignette, and film grain.
recipes-a1212bf76d: Faded grade plus grain, scratches and dust, jitter, vignette, and slight light leaks for an old-film look.
recipes-vhs: Chroma shift, scanlines, signal noise, tracking distortion, and timecode captions for a VHS look.
recipes-hud-fui: HUD elements, connection networks, holographic scans, and glow for a sci-fi interface.
recipes-9b03c41049: Glowing energy along paths, particle stardust, warping flow, and glow for magic or energy effects.
recipes-f6a1dc6ff9: Rapid zoom plus chromatic aberration and digital block breakage for glitch cuts; fits strong beats in MVs, game highlights, and tech shorts.
recipes-dee2f83976: Directional blur sweeping quickly into the next shot; suits travel videos, short-form video, and matching action-motion continuity.
recipes-ddde8c77e8: Skin smoothing, soft glow / halation, bokeh sparkles on highlights, and warm tones for a dreamy portrait.
recipes-6ce8e90221: Particle sparks, smoke noise, heat-haze distortion, shockwave displacement, and glow for explosions.
recipes-2fa907f029: Weather particles, atmospheric fog, depth of field, and glass water streaks for rain, snow, or fog.
recipes-3e0aac4b91: Caustic light patterns, teal grading, floating particles, and slight distortion for an underwater look.
recipes-b2e822a3cc: Gradient blur top and bottom with boosted saturation and contrast, turning aerial or high-angle street footage into a miniature model look.
recipes-3d-logo: 3D extrusion, material reflections, light sweep, floor reflection, and lens flare for product or logo showcases.
recipes-logo: Write-on stroke along a path, gradient fill, and a glow at the tip for a handwritten logo reveal.
recipes-56e0071122: Audio-to-keyframes driving scale, glow, and particles for song promos, DJ backgrounds, and beat-synced motion graphics.
recipes-360: Polar-coordinate wrap turning panoramas into tiny planets; suits 360 panoramas and horizon footage.
recipes-7925b7c0c1: Scrolling gibberish, green terminal color, character rain, and scanlines for a hacker look.
recipes-8-bit: Pixelation, dithering, limited palettes, and scanlines for a retro 8-bit game look.
recipes-1824245351: Chromatic displacement from the background, with a faint rim light, for sci-fi invisibility, translucent creatures, and heat-haze composites.
recipes-87863bd594: A translucent hologram with scanlines, blue-green glow, and slight displacement for sci-fi interfaces, comms screens, and stage visuals.
Translucent blue-green image with horizontal scanlines and signal jitter.
recipes-e2c0c7d3d2: Flowing displacement and glass highlights shape a translucent viscous surface; suits product transitions, abstract backgrounds, and glass-mimic interfaces.
A transparent surface flowing like liquid, refracting the background.
recipes-b3113970cb: Reduces light and shadow to bold ink lines and printed halftone dots for comic panels, retro posters, and animated titles.
High-contrast ink lines covered with a regular halftone dot grid.
recipes-ec9fb4302d: Maps brightness to thermal false color and sharpens boundaries for surveillance, target-tracking, and sci-fi viewpoints.
Objects outlined in red-yellow-blue false color by temperature.
recipes-c6bdf2c272: Expands dark areas and disturbs the edges for ink-wash intros, oriental-style transitions, and ink-growth animations.
Ink seeping outward along the paper fibers.
recipes-e905fc52a1: Combines block breakage, RGB misalignment, and stutter rhythm for signal loss, surveillance, and digital interference.
The image splits into misaligned blocks with colored signal tearing.
recipes-6ee1e1478c: Diffuses highlights and lowers local contrast for memory sequences, beauty portraits, and dreamlike shots.
Highlights bloom softly; overall low-contrast and hazy.
recipes-a155ffc569: Extracts detail edges and flattens them to monochrome tones for photo-to-sketch, storyboard animation, and hand-drawn reveals.
The image becomes grayscale pencil lines and paper shading.
recipes-19a13b8b95: Shapes light and dark edges into metal embossing with directional light for logos, badges, and industrial titles.
Raised contours with cold, hard metallic highlights.
recipes-f4043248e4: Breaks a layer into shards with extended particle trails for character disintegration, logo dissolves, and teleport effects.
The object cracks from the edges into glowing shards drifting outward.
recipes-51c6e96b06: Repeats mirrored footage into symmetric geometric patterns for music visuals, stage backgrounds, and seamless loops.
The footage mirrors across multiple axes into radial symmetry.
recipes-2e24da2b90: Irregular torn edges, paper-fiber shading, and shadows create realistic torn paper for collage intros and handcraft-style transitions.
Rough, torn paper edges casting a thin shadow.
recipes-845fb3c911: Converts the image to high-contrast green with gain noise for surveillance, military night vision, and low-light search footage.
High-contrast green image with prominent sensor noise.
recipes-ff293a7963: Separates sharpness and fog by depth for 3D scenes, background composites, and atmospheric perspective.
The distance gradually falls out of focus into low-contrast fog.
recipes-340ceb3fac: Extracts object outlines with controllable width and bloom for character energy edges, logo frames, and tech scans.
A clean, bright colored light line forms around the object's outer edge.
red-giant-particular: Industry-standard 3D particle system and the go-to for particles in AE: smoke, fire, sparks, explosions, magical dust, particle fluids, rain, snow, and logo form/disperse effects, with physics forces, wind, turbulence, and flocking; particles can use textures or 3D models.
Dense glowing points or smoke-like continua with depth of field, motion blur, and atmosphere.
red-giant-form: A non-decaying 3D particle grid / organic form generator (particles persist forever, unlike Particular's birth/death). Build holographic figures, music-driven waveforms, particle terrains, abstract creatures, and nebulae.
Grid surfaces or volumetric shapes made of dense particles, often sci-fi holograms and audio-reactive motion.
red-giant-mir: Fast 3D polygon-mesh generator for undulating terrain, flowing wave surfaces, infinite tunnels, low-poly mountains, retro wireframes, and abstract flowing surfaces, often with gradient colors and haze.
Sweeping 3D mesh surfaces or wireframes with soft gradients, sci-fi or retro feel.
red-giant-tao: Generates 3D geometry along a path (mask or layer): flowing ribbons, glowing tube tunnels, abstract sculptures, light-trail tails, and DNA helixes.
Continuous 3D ribbons or repeated geometry extending along curves, optionally glowing.
red-giant-shine: Fast 2D volumetric light / radial rays (much faster than true 3D volumetric light) for text and logo sweeps, god rays, radial beams, and energy glows.
Long rays radiating outward from a bright core.
red-giant-starglow: Multi-directional star glints that make bright spots flare into cross- or star-shaped sparkles: jewelry reflections, water glints, night-scene lights, and title highlights.
Multi-point star glints (up to 8 directions or custom) radiating from highlights.
red-giant-3d-stroke: Animated 3D strokes along mask paths: logo outline reveals, glowing lines flying through space, map routes, and abstract line motion.
Continuous glowing lines twisting and flying through space.

sapphire-s-dissolveautopaint: Turns the starting frame into a brush-painted version that progressively simplifies into a few color blocks, switches to the equally painted next frame, then restores full color and detail.
Two shots convert through simplified color blocks and oil brush strokes
sapphire-s-dissolveblur: Blurs and fades out the foreground while the background recovers from blur into focus during the transition; separate intensities, horizontal/vertical ratios and box, triangle or Gaussian filters per side.
The previous shot blurs away, the next emerges from soft focus
sapphire-s-dissolvebubble: Transitions between shots with bubble-shaped distortion — the foreground is twisted away by bubbly patterns and fades, the background recovers from distortion; adjustable bubble frequency, aspect, noise layers and warp amount.
The frame swells and warps through bubbles before changing shots
sapphire-s-dissolvedefocus: Fades out the foreground through aperture defocus while the background returns from bokeh to sharpness; circle or polygon apertures, roundness and rotation, plus lens noise and highlight gain.
Highlights swell into aperture bokeh as focus transfers to the next shot
sapphire-s-dissolvediffuse: Randomly scatters the two inputs' pixels within a range — the foreground diffuses away, the background reassembles from scattered pixels; separate horizontal/vertical diffusion and edge wrap modes.
The shot breaks into scattered pixels that reassemble into the next shot
sapphire-s-dissolvedigitaldamage: Adds DigitalDamage during the dissolve between shots — spatial and temporal damage strength, block size, freeze frames and other glitch types; higher Dissolve Speed makes short flash-frame switches.
The frame freezes, breaks up and jumps to the next shot through digital damage
sapphire-s-dissolvedistort: Uses each shot's luminance gradient to distort the other — the foreground warps and fades out, the background recovers from warping; amplitudes, smoothing scale and warp direction controllable, background input required.
Two shots swell, twist and exchange along each other's light-and-dark contours
sapphire-s-dissolveedgerays: During the dissolve, rays rise from image edges, strengthen and fade, their centers sweeping across the frame at a chosen angle; length, brightness, dispersion, flicker and dusty atmosphere adjustable.
Long beams shoot from contours, sweep the frame and change shots
sapphire-s-dissolvefilm: Film-style dissolve with adjustable gamma between two shots — highlights persist longer during the overlap than in a plain crossfade; the higher the gamma, the more highlights are retained.
Highlights linger longer during the overlap — film-style fade
sapphire-s-dissolveflashbulbs: Simulates mass camera flashes during the dissolve — dense small flashes for stadium crowds, sparse large ones for red carpets or paparazzi; counts, randomness, size, brightness and shape adjustable.
Dense camera white flashes cover the cut and bring in the next shot
sapphire-s-dissolveglare: Dynamic glare from regions above a brightness threshold during the dissolve; glare size and brightness rise and fall with the transition, with style, aspect, ray count, hue and saturation adjustable.
Highlights swell into colored glare covering the cut
sapphire-s-dissolveglint: Bright regions above threshold produce sparkles during the dissolve — star rays enlarge and brighten mid-transition then retract; horizontal, vertical and diagonal spikes and RGB lengths controlled independently.
Highlights burst into cross and diagonal star rays before the cut
sapphire-s-dissolveglintrainbow: Adds rising and falling rainbow sparkles during the transition; they extend multi-color rays from highlights, combining bright glint shimmer with pronounced spectral dispersion.
Rainbow star rays extend from highlights, brighten and bring in the next shot
sapphire-s-dissolveglow: Bloom that strengthens then fades in each shot's bright areas above threshold during the dissolve; glow brightness, color, range, and horizontal/vertical/RGB channel widths adjustable.
Highlights spread into soft bright fog, cover the cut, then recede
sapphire-s-dissolvelensflare: Connects two shots with an animated lens flare traveling along a straight path — the flare enlarges, brightens and shrinks during the transition; hotspot center, speed, angle, pivot, lens style and optical elements adjustable.
A lens flare sweeps across, brightens, and the shot change happens inside the flare
sapphire-s-dissolvelightleak: Overlays a scalable light leak during the dissolve — leaks can grow small-to-large, large-to-small or reverse, with brightness, hue, saturation, gamma, blend mode and trailing glow controls.
Orange or colored film light leaks expand, burn bright, then switch shots
sapphire-s-dissolveluma: Builds a transition pattern from the luminance of both shots so one shot seems to emerge from the other's bright or dark regions; order decided by luma difference, subtract, multiply, screen or either input, with inversion and smoothing.
The next shot emerges region by region along highlights or shadows
sapphire-s-dissolvepixelmosh: Applies PixelMosh during the dissolve — optical-flow warps and pulses make blocks smear, freeze and misalign along motion; results are intentionally random, and professional intermediates like ProRes are recommended over H.264.
Blocks of the previous shot smear into the next and break-merge
sapphire-s-dissolvepixelsort: Pixel-sorts during the dissolve — along parallel lines, radiating from center or around concentric rings, picking pixels by luma, hue, saturation or a specified channel; for modern digital glitch and music-video transitions.
Pixels are pulled into linear, radial or ring streaks before the shot change
sapphire-s-dissolvepuddle: Transitions between shots with concentric ripple distortion — the foreground warps along ripples and fades, the background recovers from undulation; movable ripple center with adjustable frequency and size.
Like a droplet hitting water, circular ripples spread and the shot changes
sapphire-s-dissolverays: Adds rising and falling radial light or dark rays during the dissolve, the ray origin moving in a straight line across the frame; can emit from bright or dark areas, with flicker texture and evolving dusty atmosphere.
Long volumetric light or dark beams sweep the frame from a moving origin, then the shot changes
sapphire-s-dissolveshake: Switches shots with fast dissolves combined with translation, scale and rotation shakes; random motion reproducible via Seed, mixable with regular waves, with X/Y/Z/Tilt and motion-blur length controls.
The frame shakes, zooms or rotates violently and changes shots amid motion blur
sapphire-s-dissolvespeckle: Dissolves between shots using a speckle-noise pattern — adjustable frequency and aspect, multiple stacked noise layers for fractal texture, and Seed for reproducible variations.
Shots change through dense sand-like dots and mottled grain
sapphire-s-dissolvestatic: Switches between shots with per-pixel random static noise — a TV no-signal snow transition; pixel appearance depends on output resolution, previewing at final resolution is recommended.
Shots switch amid full-frame black-and-white and colored snow noise
sapphire-s-dissolvetiles: Splits the two shots into grid squares and scatters them — the foreground fragments fly outward while background fragments reassemble behind; horizontal and vertical scatter separately adjustable.
The frame breaks into flying squares and the next shot appears from reassembled pieces
sapphire-s-dissolveultraglow: Produces varied optical glows during the transition, with an optional second After Glow layer on top; edge enhancement or dynamic atmospheric noise can be mixed in for more complex bloom than plain Glow.
Multiple soft-light and atmospheric fog layers spread until the cut is covered
sapphire-s-dissolvevortex: Transitions between shots with vortex distortion — the foreground twists and fades out, the background unfolds from the swirl back into place; movable vortex center with approximate rotation angle at frame edges.
The frame is sucked into a vortex, then rotates open into the next shot
sapphire-s-dissolvewaves: Transitions between shots with continuous wave patterns — the foreground undulates and fades, the background recovers from distortion; wave frequency, warp amount and relative direction of the two inputs adjustable.
The frame undulates like soft water waves, then the shot changes
sapphire-s-dissolvezap: Connects two shots with an animated lightning bolt that grows over time, with colored, brightness- and width-adjustable glow on the arc and background; start offset, length and random seed controllable.
A glowing lightning bolt crosses the frame and grows, switching shots in its light
sapphire-s-distort: Warps the source using the luminance gradient of a Lens input, pushing pixels along the image's light-and-dark variations; few large shapes or simple textures work best as lens maps, with optional Matte to limit local warp.
The source looks viewed through arbitrary bumpy glass, refracting, bulging or flowing along the Lens Map's light-dark borders; noise maps give organic heat-haze and liquid displacement
sapphire-s-distortblur: Blurs the source along the luminance gradient direction of a Lens input; simple geometry gives the clearest flow fields; non-blurred warping can be added, lens edges pre-softened, or blur direction rotated for vortices.
Pixels flow and smear along the control map's light-dark slopes, forming localized curved trails
sapphire-s-duotone: Interpolates between two specified colors by source luminance — Color0 for darks, Color1 for highlights; Threshold sets mid-luminance, Softness controls the hardness of the two-color border, with optional inversion and mixing back the original.
The frame becomes a two-color light-dark image — deep blue with off-white, black with brand color: duotone posters, silk-screen prints or album covers
sapphire-s-dust: Generates drifting random dust motes — count, size, brightness, color, direction and flicker rate adjustable; particles live in a pseudo-3D depth box where near ones are bigger and faster, moving along Z toward or away from camera.
Fine dust of varied sizes drifts slowly in front of light or the lens, each twinkling — near-big-far-small parallax adds depth and cinematic air
sapphire-s-edgeawareblur: Blurs regions of similar color while preventing different color blocks from bleeding across strong edges; edge-enhanced watercolor/cartoon mode, natural softening or soft-focus modes — skin smoothing, denoising and stylization.
Large color areas become smooth, but object outlines stay sharp
sapphire-s-edgeblur: Detects edges from an Edge Source or the source itself and blurs only near those contours; edge matte preview, with adjustable edge width, strength, threshold and blur radius.
Only contours and seams are softened, interior detail stays intact
sapphire-s-edgeflash: Spills the foreground's glow into the background and reflects the background's glow back onto the foreground, then composites; this bidirectional edge flash makes composited seams look naturally co-exposed on film.
Foreground contours and background mutually take on each other's light, seams blend softly and brightly
sapphire-s-effect: Hosts the Sapphire Effect Builder: combine multiple Sapphire nodes in a single effect, or load and edit any effect's preset; accepts Source, Mask, and Background together and saves the whole chain as a reusable preset.
The final look depends on the node combination; glow, distortion, grading, texture, and compositing can be chained into one compound effect and reproduced with a single S_Effect.
sapphire-s-flicker-774503058c: Scales source color over time to actively generate flicker — smooth random variation, periodic waveforms or a mix; luma and RGB channels can have different amplitudes, frequencies and phases, with Seed reproducing the same random rhythm.
The frame flickers like a failing lamp, projector or unstable power; RGB can pulse out of sync for color-shifted electronic flicker
sapphire-s-flickermatch: Measures per-frame brightness changes in a specified rectangular region of a second Match clip, then applies the same flicker rhythm to the Source — syncing composites to scene flashes, fires or screen brightness.
The source flickers in sync with another footage's brightness rhythm
sapphire-s-flickermatchcolor: Reads per-frame color changes from a sampling rectangle in the Match footage and scales the Source per RGB channel; beyond brightness sync, also copies dynamic color casts from flashes, fire or screens.
The source brightens, darkens and shifts hue in sync with the reference footage
sapphire-s-flickermatchmatte: Measures average brightness changes of the Match clip inside a specified Matte, then scales the Source proportionally to the base frame's Match Level — copying the reference's brightness flicker; uses the Match's Alpha when no Matte is given.
Inserted logos, text or composite elements dim and brighten in sync with a specified light area of the frame, matching its rhythm without copying color changes
sapphire-s-flickermchmattecolor: Measures average RGB color changes of the Match clip inside the Matte and scales the Source relative to the base frame's Match Color — transferring the reference region's color flicker; matte brightness or Alpha selects the sampling area.
Composite elements sync brightness and color cast with the reference's neon, warning or screen lights — e.g. cycling red, blue and green flashes
sapphire-s-flickerremove: Stabilizes each frame's average brightness to a Hold Level using a rectangular region that should stay constant, removing temporal brightness flicker from uneven film exposure; keyframable Hold Level preserves reasonable brightness changes.
Footage that flickers bright and dark becomes continuously stable exposure
sapphire-s-caustics: Simulates caustic patterns from light passing through or reflecting off curved surfaces - underwater light waves, glass refraction and flowing light spots.
Webs and waves of bright light ripple across the surface like underwater caustics
sapphire-s-flickerremovecolor: Analyzes RGB color channels separately and removes temporal color-cast flicker — for timelapse and footage with unstable lighting.
Unstable color-cast flicker is removed per channel
sapphire-s-flickerremovematte: Uses a Matte to define the sampling region for stabilizing frame brightness — fixing only local lighting jumps while keeping other variations.
Local lighting flicker is smoothed while the rest of the frame keeps its variation
sapphire-s-flickerrmmattecolor: Estimates and removes per-frame color changes within a Matte region — for local neon, stage lights or color-cast flicker in timelapse footage.
Color flicker within the masked area is evened out
sapphire-s-flyseyecircles: Slices the frame into an array of circular lenses, each transforming the image — insect compound eyes, bubble collages and kaleidoscope visuals.
A grid of circular lenses repeats and distorts the image
sapphire-s-flyseyehex: Repeats and transforms the frame in hexagonal cells — honeycombs, insect perspectives and geometric kaleidoscope backgrounds.
A honeycomb of hexagonal cells transforms the image
sapphire-s-flyseyerect: Divides the image into rectangular lenses with independent scale and offset — monitor walls, grid collages and compound-eye effects.
Rectangular lenses tile the frame, each scaled and shifted independently
sapphire-s-getframe: Makes each output frame read a specified source frame — custom time remapping, frame grabs and animatable freezes.
The playhead drives which source frame each output frame shows
sapphire-s-gradient-2c95375b91: Produces a smooth two-color gradient between two control points, blendable with the background — base images, light masks and color-grading layers.
A clean two-color gradient span between two points
sapphire-s-gradientmulti: Generates smooth multi-color gradients from several control points — brand backgrounds, abstract color flows and dynamic mattes.
Several colors blend smoothly across the frame
sapphire-s-gradientradial: Builds an elliptical radial gradient with adjustable center and inner/outer radii — spotlights, vignettes and radial color backgrounds.
An elliptical glow spreads from a movable center
sapphire-s-grid: Generates grids rotatable into 3D perspective, composited with the background — tech interfaces, perspective floors and longitude/latitude webs.
sapphire-s-hotspots: Extracts bright hotspots from the source by luminance threshold — glow mattes, highlight grading and light-driving maps.
sapphire-s-huesatbright: Adjusts hue, saturation, brightness and color shift at once — quick grading and animated color changes.
sapphire-s-hyperpull: Pulls the foreground away along the Z axis then dissolves into the background with color and shake — high-speed pulls and impact transitions.
sapphire-s-hyperpush: Pushes the foreground toward the camera along Z then switches to the background with color shake — fast pushes and rhythmic transitions.
sapphire-s-jitterframes: Randomly samples frames before and after the current time — time-jump effects, surveillance faults and unstable motion.
sapphire-s-kaleidodiamonds: Mirrors the source into continuous diamond patterns — jewel-like geometric backgrounds and seamless kaleidoscope animation.
sapphire-s-kaleidooct: Mirrors the source with right triangles into octagonal patterns — orderly rose windows, dynamic tessellation and music visuals.
sapphire-s-kaleidosquares: Reflects the image into continuous square lattice patterns — tile motifs, abstract backgrounds and geometric loops.
sapphire-s-kaleidotriangles: Reflects the source with equilateral triangles into tessellated patterns — prisms, rose windows and dynamic geometric backgrounds.
sapphire-s-kaleidopolar: Wraps the frame into a disk and mirrors radially — tunnels, flowers and rotating animation like a reflecting tube.
sapphire-s-kaleidoradial: Simulates the sector reflection of two- or three-mirror kaleidoscopes — traditional radial symmetry patterns.
sapphire-s-matteops: Erodes, dilates and adds noise to Alpha mattes — edge cleanup after keying and suppressing green-screen spill.
sapphire-s-matteopscomp: Cleans the foreground Alpha's expansion, contraction and noise, then composites directly over the background — edge cleanup for keyed people.
sapphire-s-median: Median filter that removes isolated bright/dark pixels and salt-and-pepper noise — scan, old-film and dirty-footage repair.
sapphire-s-motiondetect: Compares the current frame with earlier frames to find moving regions — motion mattes, surveillance visuals and afterimage-driving maps.
sapphire-s-nearestcolor: Collects pixels closest to a specified color and outputs the selection — isolating background colors, local grading and building color mattes.
sapphire-s-ociotransform: Converts images between specified color spaces through OpenColorIO — ACES, linear workflows and cross-software color management.
sapphire-s-parallaxstrips: Divides and offsets the frame with multiple 3D refractive glass strips — fashion openers, glass parallax and dynamic backgrounds.
sapphire-s-parallaxstripstransition: Switches two shots with moving 3D refractive glass strips — boutique style and layered parallax transitions.
sapphire-s-quadtone: Interpolates between four specified colors by source luminance — four-color print feel, poster palettes and stylized grading.
sapphire-s-rackdfcomp: Composites two layers using a foreground Alpha with independent defocus amounts — simulating rack focus between fore/background and depth-of-field composites.
sapphire-s-randomedits: Rearranges an entire clip's frames in reproducible random ways — quick montages, glitch cuts and rhythm experiments.
sapphire-s-reverseclip: Reverses the frame order of an entire clip with field-order handling — reverse action, flashback shots and seamless loops.
sapphire-s-reverseedits: Divides footage into segments of specified length and plays each in reverse — rhythmic jump cuts, repeated actions and time-glitch effects.
sapphire-s-shape: Generates circles, polygons, stars and rotating flowers directly — mattes, dynamic backgrounds and procedural graphics.
sapphire-s-showbadcolors: Marks pixels outside the specified legal range — pre-broadcast checks of over-bright, over-dark and out-of-gamut areas.
sapphire-s-sparkles: Generates star glints with controllable density, frequency and size — jewelry, magic, snow scenes and highlight accents.
sapphire-s-sparklescolor: Produces differently colored twinkling glints with density and size control — magic particles, parties and dreamy highlights.
sapphire-s-stripslidetransition: Slices the frame into strips that slide out in sequence to reveal the next shot — rhythmic editing, layout switches and shutter-style transitions.
sapphire-s-texturecells: Generates cell-like grids that can evolve automatically — cell textures, cracks and organic backgrounds.
sapphire-s-texturechromaspiral: Generates spiral noise with chromatic aberration that evolves automatically — psychedelic vortices and colorful abstract backgrounds.
sapphire-s-textureflux: Generates flowing liquid and cell patterns with automatic evolution — liquid flow fields and organic animation.
sapphire-s-texturefolded: Generates folded fabric or liquid surfaces with automatic evolution — dynamic wrinkles, cloth and turbulence.
sapphire-s-textureloops: Generates multiple overlapping rings with automatic evolution — bubbles, coils and abstract circuits.
sapphire-s-texturemicro: Generates electron-microscope-like rough surfaces with automatic evolution — microscopic materials and sci-fi surfaces.
sapphire-s-texturemoire: Generates moiré patterns from two overlapping concentric ring sets with automatic evolution — interference ripples and psychedelic backgrounds.
sapphire-s-textureneurons: Generates neuron-synapse-like moving tendrils with automatic evolution — neural webs, mycelia and biotech visuals.
sapphire-s-texturenoiseemboss: Generates procedural noise with shiny embossed relief that evolves automatically — metal bumps and rock surfaces.
sapphire-s-texturenoisepaint: Generates procedurally painted, brush-stroked noise with automatic evolution — hand-drawn textures and abstract paint backgrounds.
sapphire-s-textureplasma: Generates plasma-like undulating energy textures with automatic evolution — electric currents, energy fields and sci-fi backgrounds.
sapphire-s-textureridges: Generates multi-scale bright ridges with detailed vortices that evolve automatically — terrain, fluid ridges and abstract textures.
sapphire-s-texturespots: Generates randomly warping, animatable spot fields with automatic evolution — camouflage, leopard spots and organic dots.
sapphire-s-texturetiles: Generates repeating hexagonal, triangular, diamond or star tiles with automatic evolution — seamless geometric patterns and dynamic tessellation.
sapphire-s-textureweave: Generates interwoven horizontal and vertical line bundles with automatic evolution — cloth, basket-weave and mesh materials.
sapphire-s-tilescramble: Cuts the frame into rectangular tiles and randomly offsets the source within each cell — broken mirrors, block collages and glitch backgrounds.
sapphire-s-timeaverage: Averages the current frame with several earlier ones — long-exposure simulation, softening fast motion and building continuous afterimages.
sapphire-s-timedisplace: Makes frame regions read different times based on Matte brightness — time ripples, slit-scan photography and local delays.
sapphire-s-timeslice: Slices the output frame so each slice comes from a different frame — slit-scan, multiple moments in one frame and time drags.
sapphire-s-timewarprgb: Gives each RGB channel its own time offset — colored afterimages, temporal chromatic aberration and glitch animation.
sapphire-s-transition: Chains multiple effects in the Sapphire Builder to create custom transitions — designing reusable brand switches and transition presets.
sapphire-s-vhsdamage: Simulates VHS tape interlace combing, luma/chroma degradation and playback damage — retro videotape and horror glitch frames.
sapphire-s-warpbubble: Warps the source using smooth noise — heat distortion and underwater refraction.
sapphire-s-warpbubble2: Warps the source with two overlapping bubble fields — more complex liquid and heat-haze deformations.
sapphire-s-warpchroma: Separates spectral color bands and applies different warps to each — rainbow chromatic aberration and psychedelic distortion.
sapphire-s-warpcornerpin: Warps the source with four-corner 3D perspective — screen replacement, sign placement and planar-tracking composites.
sapphire-s-warpmagnify: Warps the source through elliptical magnifying refraction — magnifiers, water drops and glass lenses.
sapphire-s-warpperspective: Warps the source by rotating a perspective 3D plane — billboard mapping, tilted frames and fake-3D animation.
sapphire-s-warppuff: Warps the source by inflating bright areas and contracting darks along image gradients — emboss swelling, liquid lettering and organic morphing.
sapphire-s-warprepeat: Warps the source by repeatedly sampling and averaging between two transforms — radial smears, rotating ghosts and zoom tunnels.
sapphire-s-warptransform: Warps the source with combined scale, skew, rotation and translation — general geometric corrections and animated morphs.
sapphire-s-warpwaves: Warps the source with a single movable wave pattern — water ripples, flags and heat-haze distortion.
sapphire-s-warpwaves2: Warps the source with two overlapping wave sets — crossing ripples and complex surface undulation.
sapphire-s-wipeblobs: Reveals the next shot with noise-generated slime blobs — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipebubble: Reveals the next shot with a bubbly-distorted border — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipecells: Reveals the next shot with procedural cell patterns — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipechecker: Reveals the next shot with growing or shrinking checkerboard blocks — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipecircle: Reveals the next shot with an expanding or contracting circle — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipeclock: Reveals the next shot with a clock-hand sweeping around the center — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipeclouds: Reveals the next shot with moving cloud textures — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipediffuse: Reveals the next shot with a soft, pixel-diffused border — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipedots: Reveals the next shot with growing or shrinking dot grids — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipedoublewedge: Reveals the next shot with two sweeping wedges — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipeflux: Reveals the next shot with rounded fluid cells — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipefourwedges: Reveals the next shot with four wedges converging into an X — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipeline: Reveals the next shot with a single straight sweeping line — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipemoire: Reveals the next shot with concentric-ring moiré interference — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipepixelate: Reveals the next shot with semi-random pixel blocks — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipeplasma: Reveals the next shot with moving plasma tendrils — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipepointalize: Reveals the next shot with semi-random polygon brush strokes — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wiperectangle: Reveals the next shot with an expanding or contracting rectangle — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wiperings: Reveals the next shot with successive concentric rings — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipestar: Reveals the next shot with an expanding star — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipestripes: Reveals the next shot with sweeping stripes in sequence — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipetiles: Reveals the next shot with hexagonal, triangular, diamond or star tiles — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipeweave: Reveals the next shot with interwoven line textures — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-wipewedge: Reveals the next shot with a single sweeping wedge — graphic wipe transitions and rhythmic editing.
sapphire-s-zblur: Divides the frame into depth layers by Z-buffer and applies different blur amounts per layer — depth-of-field and distance defocus for 3D renders.
sapphire-s-zcomp: Compares two depth maps to determine front/back occlusion of sources — compositing 3D-rendered elements with correct spatial relations.
sapphire-s-zconvolve: Changes convolution core size by Z-buffer — depth-feel bokeh with custom aperture shapes.
third-party-element-3d: Real-time 3D object and text rendering engine inside AE: import OBJ models, animate materials, and build 3D titles and scenes.
third-party-optical-flares: The most popular lens-flare plugin with an intuitive editor for dragging and arranging individual lens elements, beautiful presets, and controls for sun flares and tech glows.
Finely layered lens-flare elements across the frame.
third-party-saber: Free: light saber, energy beam, and neon stroke effects that glow along masks or text.
third-party-heat-distortion: Simulates the wavy distortion of hot air over the frame — engine heat, desert heat haze and energy fields.
The frame ripples as if seen through rising heat
third-party-color-vibrance: Free: monochrome energy tinting for glowing elements — often paired with Saber/Optical Flares to unify color tone.
Elements get dyed with a vivid single color
third-party-twitch: Combines random flicker, shake, blur and color-shift disturbances — building tense, trailer-style rhythmic stylization.
The frame twitches and flashes along the rhythm
third-party-fx-console: Free: summon a search box with a shortcut and type to apply effects and presets, plus quick access to frame snapshots for comparison.
No visual change; an efficiency tool.
third-party-twixtor: Optical-flow slow motion with in-between frame synthesis, cleaner than AE's built-in time warp.
third-party-reelsmart-motion-blur: Automatically tracks motion vectors and adds true motion blur — restoring natural speed trails to CG, timelapse and high-shutter footage.
third-party-neat-video: Analyzes footage noise characteristics first, then reduces noise with temporal and spatial processing while preserving detail — for restoring high-ISO, low-light and heavily compressed video.
Color noise and dancing grain in dark areas drop noticeably while edges and detail stay clean
third-party-mocha-pro: The planar-tracking king: screen replacement, object removal, stabilization, 3D camera solve.
third-party-duik-angela: Free character rigging and animation suite (IK/bones/auto-walk), primarily distributed on rxlaboratory.
third-party-railcut: Brings Premiere-style track editing into AE — trimming, ripple and slip edits with waveform/thumbnail displays, no round-tripping to an NLE.
third-party-motionxpart: Free AE extension panel: one-click dynamic captions from .SRT files, plus accelerator tools for creating layers, comps and common expressions.
third-party-silhouette: Film-grade rotoscoping and retouching software — AI-assisted masking, set-removal and compositing; runs standalone or as an AE/Premiere plugin.
third-party-geotracker-for-after-effects: Brings 3D object tracking into AE — point-placement fits models to live-action objects in the shot, exporting 2D/3D nulls for Element 3D, Stardust and more.
third-party-wander: Searches 40+ stock libraries — tens of millions of images/GIFs/SVGs/icons — directly in AE and drags them into the project, no browser needed.
third-party-samurai-sharpen: Smart sharpening for video — edge-aware masking sharpens only what you want to emphasize (eyes, hair), avoiding skin and shadow noise.
third-party-clickzoom-pro: One-click clean push-in/zoom-out and pan camera moves, plus animated mouse cursors and click sounds — fast for tutorials, voiceover and podcast videos.
The frame pushes smoothly into a focus area
third-party-timemachine: An all-in-one retro stylization and generative art plugin — built-in dithering, ASCII, scanline and vector-drawing engines build CRT, VHS, LED, terminal and print looks.
The frame becomes a dither-dotted or character-composed retro display image
third-party-dehancer-pro: Fully simulates the analog film imaging pipeline — 60+ film profiles, grain, halation and film damage, grading digital footage to cinematic film look.
Digital footage gains film grain and soft halation
third-party-skinworks: Professional portrait skin retouching set (concealer/foundation/highlight in three tools) — smoothing keeps original skin texture even at 4K/8K.
third-party-nobe-omniscope: Professional video scopes — 19 monitoring views including waveform, vectorscope, histogram and CIE for checking exposure and color while grading or on set.
third-party-f-s-plugins: Free open-source AE plugin collection (MIT) by a Japanese developer — stroke, mosaic, noise, lightning, emboss, RGB shift and 50+ small tools (Windows only).
